   126→// GetLogsOnlyRewindPoints finds commits in the current branch's history that have
   127→// condensed session logs on the entire/checkpoints/v1 branch. These are commits that
   128→// were created with session data but the shadow branch has been condensed.
   129→//
   130→// The function works by:
   131→// 1. Getting all checkpoints from the entire/checkpoints/v1 branch
   132→// 2. Building a map of checkpoint ID -> checkpoint info
   133→// 3. Scanning the current branch history for commits with Entire-Checkpoint trailers
   134→// 4. Matching by checkpoint ID (stable across amend/rebase)
   135→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) GetLogsOnlyRewindPoints(limit int) ([]RewindPoint, error) {
   136→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
   137→	if err != nil {
   138→		return nil, err
   139→	}
   140→
   141→	// Get all checkpoints from entire/checkpoints/v1 branch
   142→	checkpoints, err := s.listCheckpoints()
   143→	if err != nil {
   144→		// No checkpoints yet is fine
   145→		return nil, nil //nolint:nilerr // Expected when no checkpoints exist
   146→	}
   147→
   148→	if len(checkpoints) == 0 {
   149→		return nil, nil
   150→	}
   151→
   152→	// Build map of checkpoint ID -> checkpoint info
   153→	// Checkpoint ID is the stable link from Entire-Checkpoint trailer
   154→	checkpointInfoMap := make(map[id.CheckpointID]CheckpointInfo)
   155→	for _, cp := range checkpoints {
   156→		if !cp.CheckpointID.IsEmpty() {
   157→			checkpointInfoMap[cp.CheckpointID] = cp
   158→		}
   159→	}
   160→
   161→	// Get metadata branch tree for reading session prompts (best-effort, ignore errors)
   162→	metadataTree, _ := GetMetadataBranchTree(repo) //nolint:errcheck // Best-effort for session prompts
   163→
   164→	head, err := repo.Head()
   165→	if err != nil {
   166→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD: %w", err)
   167→	}
   168→
   169→	// Use LogOptions with Order=LogOrderCommitterTime to traverse all parents of merge commits.
   170→	iter, err := repo.Log(&git.LogOptions{
   171→		From:  head.Hash(),
   172→		Order: git.LogOrderCommitterTime,
   173→	})
   174→	if err != nil {
   175→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit log: %w", err)
   176→	}
   177→
   178→	var points []RewindPoint
   179→	count := 0
   180→
   181→	err = iter.ForEach(func(c *object.Commit) error {
   182→		if count >= logsOnlyScanLimit {
   183→			return errStop
   184→		}
   185→		count++
   186→
   187→		// Extract checkpoint ID from Entire-Checkpoint trailer (ParseCheckpoint validates format)
   188→		cpID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(c.Message)
   189→		if !found {
   190→			return nil
   191→		}
   192→		// Check if this checkpoint ID has metadata on entire/checkpoints/v1
   193→		cpInfo, found := checkpointInfoMap[cpID]
   194→		if !found {
   195→			return nil
   196→		}
   197→
   198→		// Create logs-only rewind point
   199→		message := strings.Split(c.Message, "\n")[0]
   200→
   201→		// Read session prompts from metadata tree
   202→		var sessionPrompt string
   203→		var sessionPrompts []string
   204→		if metadataTree != nil {
   205→			checkpointPath := paths.CheckpointPath(cpInfo.CheckpointID) //nolint:staticcheck // already present in codebase
   206→			// For multi-session checkpoints, read all prompts
   207→			if cpInfo.SessionCount > 1 && len(cpInfo.SessionIDs) > 1 {
   208→				sessionPrompts = ReadAllSessionPromptsFromTree(metadataTree, checkpointPath, cpInfo.SessionCount, cpInfo.SessionIDs)
   209→				// Use the last (most recent) prompt as the main session prompt
   210→				if len(sessionPrompts) > 0 {
   211→					sessionPrompt = sessionPrompts[len(sessionPrompts)-1]
   212→				}
   213→			} else {
   214→				sessionPrompt = ReadSessionPromptFromTree(metadataTree, checkpointPath)
   215→				if sessionPrompt != "" {
   216→					sessionPrompts = []string{sessionPrompt}
   217→				}
   218→			}
   219→		}
   220→
   221→		points = append(points, RewindPoint{
   222→			ID:             c.Hash.String(),
   223→			Message:        message,
   224→			Date:           c.Author.When,
   225→			IsLogsOnly:     true,
   226→			CheckpointID:   cpInfo.CheckpointID,
   227→			Agent:          cpInfo.Agent,
   228→			SessionID:      cpInfo.SessionID,
   229→			SessionPrompt:  sessionPrompt,
   230→			SessionCount:   cpInfo.SessionCount,
   231→			SessionIDs:     cpInfo.SessionIDs,
   232→			SessionPrompts: sessionPrompts,
   233→		})
   234→
   235→		return nil
   236→	})
   237→
   238→	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, errStop) {
   239→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("error iterating commits: %w", err)
   240→	}
   241→
   242→	if len(points) > limit {
   243→		points = points[:limit]
   244→	}
   245→
   246→	return points, nil
   247→}
   248→
   249→// Rewind restores the working directory to a checkpoint.
   250→//
   251→
   252→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) Rewind(point RewindPoint) error {
   253→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
   254→	if err != nil {
   255→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to open git repository: %w", err)
   256→	}
   257→
   258→	// Get the checkpoint commit
   259→	commitHash := plumbing.NewHash(point.ID)
   260→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(commitHash)
   261→	if err != nil {
   262→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit: %w", err)
   263→	}
   264→
   265→	tree, err := commit.Tree()
   266→	if err != nil {
   267→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get tree: %w", err)
   268→	}
   269→
   270→	// Reset the shadow branch to the rewound checkpoint
   271→	// This ensures the next checkpoint will only include prompts from this point forward
   272→	if err := s.resetShadowBranchToCheckpoint(repo, commit); err != nil {
   273→		// Log warning but don't fail - file restoration is the primary operation
   274→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Warning: failed to reset shadow branch: %v\n", err)
   275→	}
   276→
   277→	// Load session state to get untracked files that existed at session start
   278→	sessionID, hasSessionTrailer := trailers.ParseSession(commit.Message)
   279→	var preservedUntrackedFiles map[string]bool
   280→	if hasSessionTrailer {
   281→		state, stateErr := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   282→		if stateErr == nil && state != nil && len(state.UntrackedFilesAtStart) > 0 {
   283→			preservedUntrackedFiles = make(map[string]bool)
   284→			for _, f := range state.UntrackedFilesAtStart {
   285→				preservedUntrackedFiles[f] = true
   286→			}
   287→		}
   288→	}
   289→
   290→	// Build set of files in the checkpoint tree (excluding metadata)
   291→	checkpointFiles := make(map[string]bool)
   292→	err = tree.Files().ForEach(func(f *object.File) error {
   293→		if !strings.HasPrefix(f.Name, entireDir) {
   294→			checkpointFiles[f.Name] = true
   295→		}
   296→		return nil
   297→	})
   298→	if err != nil {
   299→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to list checkpoint files: %w", err)
   300→	}
   301→
   302→	// Get HEAD tree to identify tracked files
   303→	head, err := repo.Head()
   304→	if err != nil {
   305→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD: %w", err)
   306→	}
   307→	headCommit, err := repo.CommitObject(head.Hash())
   308→	if err != nil {
   309→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD commit: %w", err)
   310→	}
   311→	headTree, err := headCommit.Tree()
   312→	if err != nil {
   313→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD tree: %w", err)
   314→	}
   315→
   316→	// Build set of files tracked in HEAD
   317→	trackedFiles := make(map[string]bool)
   318→	//nolint:errcheck // Error is not critical for rewind
   319→	_ = headTree.Files().ForEach(func(f *object.File) error {
   320→		trackedFiles[f.Name] = true
   321→		return nil
   322→	})
   323→
   324→	// Get repository root to walk from there
   325→	repoRoot, err := GetWorktreePath()
   326→	if err != nil {
   327→		repoRoot = "." // Fallback to current directory
   328→	}
   329→
   330→	// Find and delete untracked files that aren't in the checkpoint.
   331→	// Uses git ls-files to only consider non-ignored files, avoiding walks through
   332→	// large ignored directories like node_modules/.
   333→	untrackedNow, err := collectUntrackedFiles()
   334→	if err != nil {
   335→		// Non-fatal - continue with restoration
   336→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: error listing untracked files: %v\n", err)
   337→	}
   338→	for _, relPath := range untrackedNow {
   339→		// If file is in checkpoint, it will be restored
   340→		if checkpointFiles[relPath] {
   341→			continue
   342→		}
   343→
   344→		// If file is tracked in HEAD, don't delete (user's committed work)
   345→		if trackedFiles[relPath] {
   346→			continue
   347→		}
   348→
   349→		// If file existed at session start, preserve it (untracked user files)
   350→		if preservedUntrackedFiles[relPath] {
   351→			continue
   352→		}
   353→
   354→		// File is untracked and not in checkpoint - delete it
   355→		absPath := filepath.Join(repoRoot, relPath)
   356→		if removeErr := os.Remove(absPath); removeErr == nil {
   357→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  Deleted: %s\n", relPath)
   358→		}
   359→	}
   360→
   361→	// Restore files from checkpoint
   362→	err = tree.Files().ForEach(func(f *object.File) error {
   363→		// Skip metadata directories - these are for checkpoint storage, not working dir
   364→		if strings.HasPrefix(f.Name, entireDir) {
   365→			return nil
   366→		}
   367→
   368→		contents, err := f.Contents()
   369→		if err != nil {
   370→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to read file %s: %w", f.Name, err)
   371→		}
   372→
   373→		// Ensure directory exists
   374→		dir := filepath.Dir(f.Name)
   375→		if dir != "." {
   376→			//nolint:gosec // G301: Need 0o755 for user directories during rewind
   377→			if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
   378→				return fmt.Errorf("failed to create directory %s: %w", dir, err)
   379→			}
   380→		}
   381→
   382→		// Write file with appropriate permissions
   383→		var perm os.FileMode = 0o644
   384→		if f.Mode == filemode.Executable {
   385→			perm = 0o755
   386→		}
   387→		if err := os.WriteFile(f.Name, []byte(contents), perm); err != nil {
   388→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to write file %s: %w", f.Name, err)
   389→		}
   390→
   391→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  Restored: %s\n", f.Name)
   392→		return nil
   393→	})
   394→	if err != nil {
   395→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to iterate tree files: %w", err)
   396→	}
   397→
   398→	fmt.Println()
   399→	if len(point.ID) >= 7 {
   400→		fmt.Printf("Restored files from shadow commit %s\n", point.ID[:7])
   401→	} else {
   402→		fmt.Printf("Restored files from shadow commit %s\n", point.ID)
   403→	}
   404→	fmt.Println()
   405→
   406→	return nil
   407→}
   408→
   409→// resetShadowBranchToCheckpoint resets the shadow branch HEAD to the given checkpoint.
   410→// This ensures that when the user commits after rewinding, the next checkpoint will only
   411→// include prompts from the rewound point, not prompts from later checkpoints.
   412→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) resetShadowBranchToCheckpoint(repo *git.Repository, commit *object.Commit) error {
   413→	// Extract session ID from the checkpoint commit's Entire-Session trailer
   414→	sessionID, found := trailers.ParseSession(commit.Message)
   415→	if !found {
   416→		return errors.New("checkpoint has no Entire-Session trailer")
   417→	}
   418→
   419→	// Load session state to get the shadow branch name
   420→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   421→	if err != nil {
   422→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load session state: %w", err)
   423→	}
   424→	if state == nil {
   425→		return fmt.Errorf("session %s not found", sessionID)
   426→	}
   427→
   428→	// Reset the shadow branch to the checkpoint commit
   429→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   430→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   431→
   432→	// Update the reference to point to the checkpoint commit
   433→	ref := plumbing.NewHashReference(refName, commit.Hash)
   434→	if err := repo.Storer.SetReference(ref); err != nil {
   435→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to update shadow branch: %w", err)
   436→	}
   437→
   438→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Reset shadow branch %s to checkpoint %s\n", shadowBranchName, commit.Hash.String()[:7])
   439→	return nil
   440→}
   441→
   442→// CanRewind checks if rewinding is possible.
   443→// For manual-commit strategy, rewind restores files from a checkpoint - uncommitted changes are expected
   444→// and will be replaced by the checkpoint contents. Returns true with a warning message showing
   445→// what changes will be reverted.
   446→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CanRewind() (bool, string, error) {
   447→	return checkCanRewindWithWarning()
   448→}
   449→
   450→// PreviewRewind returns what will happen if rewinding to the given point.
   451→// This allows showing warnings about untracked files that will be deleted.
   452→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) PreviewRewind(point RewindPoint) (*RewindPreview, error) {
   453→	// Logs-only points don't modify the working directory
   454→	if point.IsLogsOnly {
   455→		return &RewindPreview{}, nil
   456→	}
   457→
   458→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
   459→	if err != nil {
   460→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open git repository: %w", err)
   461→	}
   462→
   463→	// Get the checkpoint commit
   464→	commitHash := plumbing.NewHash(point.ID)
   465→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(commitHash)
   466→	if err != nil {
   467→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit: %w", err)
   468→	}
   469→
   470→	tree, err := commit.Tree()
   471→	if err != nil {
   472→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get tree: %w", err)
   473→	}
   474→
   475→	// Load session state to get untracked files that existed at session start
   476→	sessionID, hasSessionTrailer := trailers.ParseSession(commit.Message)
   477→	var preservedUntrackedFiles map[string]bool
   478→	if hasSessionTrailer {
   479→		state, stateErr := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   480→		if stateErr == nil && state != nil && len(state.UntrackedFilesAtStart) > 0 {
   481→			preservedUntrackedFiles = make(map[string]bool)
   482→			for _, f := range state.UntrackedFilesAtStart {
   483→				preservedUntrackedFiles[f] = true
   484→			}
   485→		}
   486→	}
   487→
   488→	// Build set of files in the checkpoint tree (excluding metadata)
   489→	checkpointFiles := make(map[string]bool)
   490→	var filesToRestore []string
   491→	err = tree.Files().ForEach(func(f *object.File) error {
   492→		if !strings.HasPrefix(f.Name, entireDir) {
   493→			checkpointFiles[f.Name] = true
   494→			filesToRestore = append(filesToRestore, f.Name)
   495→		}
   496→		return nil
   497→	})
   498→	if err != nil {
   499→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to list checkpoint files: %w", err)
   500→	}
   501→
   502→	// Get HEAD tree to identify tracked files
   503→	head, err := repo.Head()
   504→	if err != nil {
   505→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD: %w", err)
   506→	}
   507→	headCommit, err := repo.CommitObject(head.Hash())
   508→	if err != nil {
   509→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD commit: %w", err)
   510→	}
   511→	headTree, err := headCommit.Tree()
   512→	if err != nil {
   513→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD tree: %w", err)
   514→	}
   515→
   516→	// Build set of files tracked in HEAD
   517→	trackedFiles := make(map[string]bool)
   518→	//nolint:errcheck // Error is not critical for preview
   519→	_ = headTree.Files().ForEach(func(f *object.File) error {
   520→		trackedFiles[f.Name] = true
   521→		return nil
   522→	})
   523→
   524→	// Find untracked files that would be deleted.
   525→	// Uses git ls-files to only consider non-ignored files.
   526→	var filesToDelete []string
   527→	untrackedNow, untrackedErr := collectUntrackedFiles()
   528→	if untrackedErr != nil {
   529→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: could not list untracked files for preview: %v\n", untrackedErr)
   530→		return &RewindPreview{
   531→			FilesToRestore: filesToRestore,
   532→			FilesToDelete:  filesToDelete,
   533→		}, nil
   534→	}
   535→	for _, relPath := range untrackedNow {
   536→		if checkpointFiles[relPath] {
   537→			continue
   538→		}
   539→		if trackedFiles[relPath] {
   540→			continue
   541→		}
   542→		if preservedUntrackedFiles[relPath] {
   543→			continue
   544→		}
   545→		filesToDelete = append(filesToDelete, relPath)
   546→	}
   547→
   548→	// Sort for consistent output
   549→	sort.Strings(filesToRestore)
   550→	sort.Strings(filesToDelete)
   551→
   552→	return &RewindPreview{
   553→		FilesToRestore: filesToRestore,
   554→		FilesToDelete:  filesToDelete,
   555→	}, nil
   556→}
   557→
   558→// RestoreLogsOnly restores session logs from a logs-only rewind point.
   559→// This fetches the transcript from entire/checkpoints/v1 and writes it to the agent's session directory.
   560→// Does not modify the working directory.
   561→// When multiple sessions were condensed to the same checkpoint, ALL sessions are restored.
   562→// If force is false, prompts for confirmation when local logs have newer timestamps.
   563→// Returns info about each restored session so callers can print correct per-session resume commands.
   564→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) RestoreLogsOnly(point RewindPoint, force bool) ([]RestoredSession, error) {
   565→	if !point.IsLogsOnly {
   566→		return nil, errors.New("not a logs-only rewind point")
   567→	}
   568→
   569→	if point.CheckpointID.IsEmpty() {
   570→		return nil, errors.New("missing checkpoint ID")
   571→	}
   572→
   573→	// Get checkpoint store
   574→	store, err := s.getCheckpointStore()
   575→	if err != nil {
   576→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get checkpoint store: %w", err)
   577→	}
   578→
   579→	// Read checkpoint summary to get session count
   580→	summary, err := store.ReadCommitted(context.Background(), point.CheckpointID)
   581→	if err != nil {
   582→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read checkpoint: %w", err)
   583→	}
   584→	if summary == nil {
   585→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("checkpoint not found: %s", point.CheckpointID)
   586→	}
   587→
   588→	// Get repo root for agent session directory lookup
   589→	repoRoot, err := paths.RepoRoot()
   590→	if err != nil {
   591→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get repository root: %w", err)
   592→	}
   593→
   594→	// Check for newer local logs if not forcing
   595→	if !force {
   596→		sessions := s.classifySessionsForRestore(context.Background(), repoRoot, store, point.CheckpointID, summary)
   597→		hasConflicts := false
   598→		for _, sess := range sessions {
   599→			if sess.Status == StatusLocalNewer {
   600→				hasConflicts = true
   601→				break
   602→			}
   603→		}
   604→		if hasConflicts {
   605→			shouldOverwrite, promptErr := PromptOverwriteNewerLogs(sessions)
   606→			if promptErr != nil {
   607→				return nil, promptErr
   608→			}
   609→			if !shouldOverwrite {
   610→				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Resume cancelled. Local session logs preserved.\n")
   611→				return nil, nil
   612→			}
   613→		}
   614→	}
   615→
   616→	// Count sessions to restore
   617→	totalSessions := len(summary.Sessions)
   618→	if totalSessions > 1 {
   619→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Restoring %d sessions from checkpoint:\n", totalSessions)
   620→	}
   621→
   622→	// Restore all sessions (oldest to newest, using 0-based indexing)
   623→	var restored []RestoredSession
   624→	for i := range totalSessions {
   625→		content, readErr := store.ReadSessionContent(context.Background(), point.CheckpointID, i)
   626→		if readErr != nil {
   627→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  Warning: failed to read session %d: %v\n", i, readErr)
   628→			continue
   629→		}
   630→		if content == nil || len(content.Transcript) == 0 {
   631→			continue
   632→		}
   633→
   634→		sessionID := content.Metadata.SessionID
   635→		if sessionID == "" {
   636→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  Warning: session %d has no session ID, skipping\n", i)
   637→			continue
   638→		}
   639→
   640→		// Resolve per-session agent from metadata — skip if agent is unknown
   641→		if content.Metadata.Agent == "" {
   642→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  Warning: session %d (%s) has no agent metadata, skipping (cannot determine target directory)\n", i, sessionID)
   643→			continue
   644→		}
   645→		sessionAgent, agErr := ResolveAgentForRewind(content.Metadata.Agent)
   646→		if agErr != nil {
   647→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  Warning: session %d (%s) has unknown agent %q, skipping\n", i, sessionID, content.Metadata.Agent)
   648→			continue
   649→		}
   650→
   651→		// Compute transcript path from current repo location for cross-machine portability.
   652→		sessionAgentDir, dirErr := sessionAgent.GetSessionDir(repoRoot)
   653→		if dirErr != nil {
   654→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  Warning: failed to get session dir for session %d: %v\n", i, dirErr)
   655→			continue
   656→		}
   657→		sessionFile := sessionAgent.ResolveSessionFile(sessionAgentDir, sessionID)
   658→
   659→		// Get first prompt for display
   660→		promptPreview := ExtractFirstPrompt(content.Prompts)
   661→
   662→		if totalSessions > 1 {
   663→			isLatest := i == totalSessions-1
   664→			if promptPreview != "" {
   665→				if isLatest {
   666→					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  Session %d (latest): %s\n", i+1, promptPreview)
   667→				} else {
   668→					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  Session %d: %s\n", i+1, promptPreview)
   669→				}
   670→			}
   671→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "    Writing to: %s\n", sessionFile)
   672→		} else {
   673→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Writing transcript to: %s\n", sessionFile)
   674→		}
   675→
   676→		// Ensure parent directory exists (session file may be in a different dir than sessionAgentDir)
   677→		if mkdirErr := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(sessionFile), 0o750); mkdirErr != nil {
   678→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "    Warning: failed to create directory: %v\n", mkdirErr)
   679→			continue
   680→		}
   681→
   682→		agentSession := &agent.AgentSession{
   683→			SessionID:  sessionID,
   684→			AgentName:  sessionAgent.Name(),
   685→			RepoPath:   repoRoot,
   686→			SessionRef: sessionFile,
   687→			NativeData: content.Transcript,
   688→			ExportData: content.ExportData,
   689→		}
   690→		if writeErr := sessionAgent.WriteSession(agentSession); writeErr != nil {
   691→			if totalSessions > 1 {
   692→				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "    Warning: failed to write session: %v\n", writeErr)
   693→				continue
   694→			}
   695→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to write session: %w", writeErr)
   696→		}
   697→
   698→		restored = append(restored, RestoredSession{
   699→			SessionID: sessionID,
   700→			Agent:     sessionAgent.Type(),
   701→			Prompt:    promptPreview,
   702→		})
   703→	}
   704→
   705→	return restored, nil
   706→}
   707→
   708→// ResolveAgentForRewind resolves the agent from checkpoint metadata.
   709→// Falls back to the default agent (Claude) for old checkpoints that lack agent info.
   710→func ResolveAgentForRewind(agentType agent.AgentType) (agent.Agent, error) {
   711→	if !isSpecificAgentType(agentType) {
   712→		ag := agent.Default()
   713→		if ag == nil {
   714→			return nil, errors.New("no default agent registered")
   715→		}
   716→		return ag, nil
   717→	}
   718→	ag, err := agent.GetByAgentType(agentType)
   719→	if err != nil {
   720→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("resolving agent %q: %w", agentType, err)
   721→	}
   722→	return ag, nil
   723→}
   724→
   725→// readSessionPrompt reads the first prompt from the session's prompt.txt file stored in git.
   726→// Returns an empty string if the prompt cannot be read.
   727→func readSessionPrompt(repo *git.Repository, commitHash plumbing.Hash, metadataDir string) string {
   728→	// Get the commit and its tree
   729→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(commitHash)
   730→	if err != nil {
   731→		return ""
   732→	}
   733→
   734→	tree, err := commit.Tree()
   735→	if err != nil {
   736→		return ""
   737→	}
   738→
   739→	// Look for prompt.txt in the metadata directory
   740→	promptPath := metadataDir + "/" + paths.PromptFileName
   741→	promptEntry, err := tree.File(promptPath)
   742→	if err != nil {
   743→		return ""
   744→	}
   745→
   746→	content, err := promptEntry.Contents()
   747→	if err != nil {
   748→		return ""
   749→	}
   750→
   751→	return ExtractFirstPrompt(content)
   752→}
   753→
   754→// SessionRestoreStatus represents the status of a session being restored.
   755→type SessionRestoreStatus int
   756→
   757→const (
   758→	StatusNew             SessionRestoreStatus = iota // Local file doesn't exist
   759→	StatusUnchanged                                   // Local and checkpoint are the same
   760→	StatusCheckpointNewer                             // Checkpoint has newer entries
   761→	StatusLocalNewer                                  // Local has newer entries (conflict)
   762→)
   763→
   764→// SessionRestoreInfo contains information about a session being restored.
   765→type SessionRestoreInfo struct {
   766→	SessionID      string
   767→	Prompt         string               // First prompt preview for display
   768→	Status         SessionRestoreStatus // Status of this session
   769→	LocalTime      time.Time
   770→	CheckpointTime time.Time
   771→}
   772→
   773→// classifySessionsForRestore checks all sessions in a checkpoint and returns info
   774→// about each session, including whether local logs have newer timestamps.
   775→// repoRoot is used to compute per-session agent directories.
   776→// Sessions without agent metadata are skipped (cannot determine target directory).
   777→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) classifySessionsForRestore(ctx context.Context, repoRoot string, store cpkg.Store, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, summary *cpkg.CheckpointSummary) []SessionRestoreInfo {
   778→	var sessions []SessionRestoreInfo
   779→
   780→	totalSessions := len(summary.Sessions)
   781→	// Check all sessions (0-based indexing)
   782→	for i := range totalSessions {
   783→		content, err := store.ReadSessionContent(ctx, checkpointID, i)
   784→		if err != nil || content == nil || len(content.Transcript) == 0 {
   785→			continue
   786→		}
   787→
   788→		sessionID := content.Metadata.SessionID
   789→		if sessionID == "" || content.Metadata.Agent == "" {
   790→			continue
   791→		}
   792→
   793→		sessionAgent, agErr := ResolveAgentForRewind(content.Metadata.Agent)
   794→		if agErr != nil {
   795→			continue
   796→		}
   797→
   798→		// Compute transcript path from current repo location for cross-machine portability.
   799→		sessionAgentDir, dirErr := sessionAgent.GetSessionDir(repoRoot)
   800→		if dirErr != nil {
   801→			continue
   802→		}
   803→		localPath := sessionAgent.ResolveSessionFile(sessionAgentDir, sessionID)
   804→
   805→		localTime := paths.GetLastTimestampFromFile(localPath)
   806→		checkpointTime := paths.GetLastTimestampFromBytes(content.Transcript)
   807→		status := ClassifyTimestamps(localTime, checkpointTime)
   808→
   809→		sessions = append(sessions, SessionRestoreInfo{
   810→			SessionID:      sessionID,
   811→			Prompt:         ExtractFirstPrompt(content.Prompts),
   812→			Status:         status,
   813→			LocalTime:      localTime,
   814→			CheckpointTime: checkpointTime,
   815→		})
   816→	}
   817→
   818→	return sessions
   819→}
   820→
   821→// ClassifyTimestamps determines the restore status based on local and checkpoint timestamps.
   822→func ClassifyTimestamps(localTime, checkpointTime time.Time) SessionRestoreStatus {
   823→	// Local file doesn't exist (no timestamp found)
   824→	if localTime.IsZero() {
   825→		return StatusNew
   826→	}
   827→
   828→	// Can't determine checkpoint time - treat as new/safe
   829→	if checkpointTime.IsZero() {
   830→		return StatusNew
   831→	}
   832→
   833→	// Compare timestamps
   834→	if localTime.After(checkpointTime) {
   835→		return StatusLocalNewer
   836→	}
   837→	if checkpointTime.After(localTime) {
   838→		return StatusCheckpointNewer
   839→	}
   840→	return StatusUnchanged
   841→}
   842→
   843→// StatusToText returns a human-readable status string.
   844→func StatusToText(status SessionRestoreStatus) string {
   845→	switch status {
   846→	case StatusNew:
   847→		return "(new)"
   848→	case StatusUnchanged:
   849→		return "(unchanged)"
   850→	case StatusCheckpointNewer:
   851→		return "(checkpoint is newer)"
   852→	case StatusLocalNewer:
   853→		return "(local is newer)" // shouldn't appear in non-conflict list
   854→	default:
   855→		return ""
   856→	}
   857→}
   858→
   859→// PromptOverwriteNewerLogs asks the user for confirmation to overwrite local
   860→// session logs that have newer timestamps than the checkpoint versions.
   861→func PromptOverwriteNewerLogs(sessions []SessionRestoreInfo) (bool, error) {
   862→	// Separate conflicting and non-conflicting sessions
   863→	var conflicting, nonConflicting []SessionRestoreInfo
   864→	for _, s := range sessions {
   865→		if s.Status == StatusLocalNewer {
   866→			conflicting = append(conflicting, s)
   867→		} else {
   868→			nonConflicting = append(nonConflicting, s)
   869→		}
   870→	}
   871→
   872→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "\nWarning: Local session log(s) have newer entries than the checkpoint:\n")
   873→	for _, info := range conflicting {
   874→		// Show prompt if available, otherwise fall back to session ID
   875→		if info.Prompt != "" {
   876→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  \"%s\"\n", info.Prompt)
   877→		} else {
   878→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  Session: %s\n", info.SessionID)
   879→		}
   880→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "    Local last entry:      %s\n", info.LocalTime.Local().Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05"))
   881→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "    Checkpoint last entry: %s\n", info.CheckpointTime.Local().Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05"))
   882→	}
   883→
   884→	// Show non-conflicting sessions with their status
   885→	if len(nonConflicting) > 0 {
   886→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "\nThese other session(s) will also be restored:\n")
   887→		for _, info := range nonConflicting {
   888→			statusText := StatusToText(info.Status)
   889→			if info.Prompt != "" {
   890→				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  \"%s\" %s\n", info.Prompt, statusText)
   891→			} else {
   892→				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  Session: %s %s\n", info.SessionID, statusText)
   893→			}
   894→		}
   895→	}
   896→
   897→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "\nOverwriting will lose the newer local entries.\n\n")
   898→
   899→	var confirmed bool
   900→	form := huh.NewForm(
   901→		huh.NewGroup(
   902→			huh.NewConfirm().
   903→				Title("Overwrite local session logs with checkpoint versions?").
   904→				Value(&confirmed),
   905→		),
   906→	)
   907→	if isAccessibleMode() {
   908→		form = form.WithAccessible(true)
   909→	}
   910→
   911→	if err := form.Run(); err != nil {
   912→		if errors.Is(err, huh.ErrUserAborted) {
   913→			return false, nil
   914→		}
   915→		return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to get confirmation: %w", err)
   916→	}
   917→
   918→	return confirmed, nil
   919→}
   920→

    49→// repoRootCache caches the repository root to avoid repeated git commands.
    50→// The cache is keyed by the current working directory to handle directory changes.
    51→var (
    52→	repoRootMu       sync.RWMutex
    53→	repoRootCache    string
    54→	repoRootCacheDir string
    55→)
    56→
    57→// RepoRoot returns the git repository root directory.
    58→// Uses 'git rev-parse --show-toplevel' which works from any subdirectory.
    59→// The result is cached per working directory.
    60→// Returns an error if not inside a git repository.
    61→func RepoRoot() (string, error) {
    62→	// Get current working directory to check cache validity
    63→	cwd, err := os.Getwd() //nolint:forbidigo // already present in codebase
    64→	if err != nil {
    65→		cwd = ""
    66→	}
    67→
    68→	// Check cache with read lock first
    69→	repoRootMu.RLock()
    70→	if repoRootCache != "" && repoRootCacheDir == cwd {
    71→		cached := repoRootCache
    72→		repoRootMu.RUnlock()
    73→		return cached, nil
    74→	}
    75→	repoRootMu.RUnlock()
    76→
    77→	// Cache miss - get repo root and update cache with write lock
    78→	ctx := context.Background()
    79→	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel")
    80→	output, err := cmd.Output()
    81→	if err != nil {
    82→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get git repository root: %w", err)
    83→	}
    84→
    85→	root := strings.TrimSpace(string(output))
    86→
    87→	repoRootMu.Lock()
    88→	repoRootCache = root
    89→	repoRootCacheDir = cwd
    90→	repoRootMu.Unlock()
    91→
    92→	return root, nil
    93→}
    94→
    95→// ClearRepoRootCache clears the cached repository root.
    96→// This is primarily useful for testing when changing directories.
    97→func ClearRepoRootCache() {
    98→	repoRootMu.Lock()
    99→	repoRootCache = ""
   100→	repoRootCacheDir = ""
   101→	repoRootMu.Unlock()
   102→}
   103→
   104→// AbsPath returns the absolute path for a relative path within the repository.
   105→// If the path is already absolute, it is returned as-is.
   106→// Uses RepoRoot() to resolve paths relative to the repository root.
   107→func AbsPath(relPath string) (string, error) {
   108→	if filepath.IsAbs(relPath) {
   109→		return relPath, nil
   110→	}
   111→
   112→	root, err := RepoRoot()
   113→	if err != nil {
   114→		return "", err
   115→	}
   116→
   117→	return filepath.Join(root, relPath), nil
   118→}
   119→
   120→// IsInfrastructurePath returns true if the path is part of CLI infrastructure
   121→// (i.e., inside the .entire directory)
   122→func IsInfrastructurePath(path string) bool {
   123→	return strings.HasPrefix(path, EntireDir+"/") || path == EntireDir
   124→}
   125→
   126→// ToRelativePath converts an absolute path to relative.
   127→// Returns empty string if the path is outside the working directory.
   128→func ToRelativePath(absPath, cwd string) string {
   129→	if !filepath.IsAbs(absPath) {
   130→		return absPath
   131→	}
   132→	relPath, err := filepath.Rel(cwd, absPath)
   133→	if err != nil || strings.HasPrefix(relPath, "..") {
   134→		return ""
   135→	}
   136→	return relPath
   137→}
   138→
   139→// nonAlphanumericRegex matches any non-alphanumeric character
   140→var nonAlphanumericRegex = regexp.MustCompile(`[^a-zA-Z0-9]`)
   141→
   142→// SanitizePathForClaude converts a path to Claude's project directory format.
   143→// Claude replaces any non-alphanumeric character with a dash.
   144→func SanitizePathForClaude(path string) string {
   145→	return nonAlphanumericRegex.ReplaceAllString(path, "-")
   146→}
   147→
   148→// GetClaudeProjectDir returns the directory where Claude stores session transcripts
   149→// for the given repository path.
   150→//
   151→// In test environments, set ENTIRE_TEST_CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR to override the default location.
   152→func GetClaudeProjectDir(repoPath string) (string, error) {
   153→	override := os.Getenv("ENTIRE_TEST_CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR")
   154→	if override != "" {
   155→		return override, nil
   156→	}
   157→
   158→	homeDir, err := os.UserHomeDir()
   159→	if err != nil {
   160→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get home directory: %w", err)
   161→	}
   162→
   163→	projectDir := SanitizePathForClaude(repoPath)
   164→	return filepath.Join(homeDir, ".claude", "projects", projectDir), nil
   165→}
   166→
   167→// SessionMetadataDirFromSessionID returns the path to a session's metadata directory
   168→// for the given Entire session ID. The sessionID must be the full, already date-prefixed
   169→// Entire session identifier as stored on disk, not an agent-specific or raw Claude ID.
   170→func SessionMetadataDirFromSessionID(sessionID string) string {
   171→	return EntireMetadataDir + "/" + sessionID
   172→}
   173→
   174→// ExtractSessionIDFromTranscriptPath attempts to extract a session ID from a transcript path.
   175→// Claude transcripts are stored at ~/.claude/projects/<project>/sessions/<id>.jsonl
   176→// If the path doesn't match expected format, returns empty string.
   177→func ExtractSessionIDFromTranscriptPath(transcriptPath string) string {
   178→	// Try to extract from typical path: ~/.claude/projects/<project>/sessions/<id>.jsonl
   179→	parts := strings.Split(filepath.ToSlash(transcriptPath), "/")
   180→	for i, part := range parts {
   181→		if part == "sessions" && i+1 < len(parts) {
   182→			// Return filename without extension
   183→			filename := parts[i+1]
   184→			if strings.HasSuffix(filename, ".jsonl") {
   185→				return strings.TrimSuffix(filename, ".jsonl")
   186→			}
   187→			return filename
   188→		}
   189→	}
   190→	return ""
   191→}

    36→	// ShadowBranchHashLength is the number of hex characters used in shadow branch names.

    43→
    44→// HashWorktreeID returns a short hash of the worktree identifier.
    45→// Used to create unique shadow branch names per worktree.
    46→func HashWorktreeID(worktreeID string) string {
    47→	h := sha256.Sum256([]byte(worktreeID))
    48→	return hex.EncodeToString(h[:])[:WorktreeIDHashLength]
    49→}
    50→
    51→// WriteTemporary writes a temporary checkpoint to a shadow branch.
    52→// Shadow branches are named entire/<base-commit-short-hash>.
    53→// Returns the result containing commit hash and whether it was skipped.
    54→// If the new tree hash matches the last checkpoint's tree hash, the checkpoint
    55→// is skipped to avoid duplicate commits (deduplication).
    56→func (s *GitStore) WriteTemporary(ctx context.Context, opts WriteTemporaryOptions) (WriteTemporaryResult, error) {
    57→	// Validate base commit - required for shadow branch naming
    58→	if opts.BaseCommit == "" {
    59→		return WriteTemporaryResult{}, errors.New("BaseCommit is required for temporary checkpoint")
    60→	}
    61→
    62→	// Validate session ID to prevent path traversal
    63→	if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(opts.SessionID); err != nil {
    64→		return WriteTemporaryResult{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid temporary checkpoint options: %w", err)
    65→	}
    66→
    67→	// Get shadow branch name
    68→	shadowBranchName := ShadowBranchNameForCommit(opts.BaseCommit, opts.WorktreeID)
    69→
    70→	// Get or create shadow branch
    71→	parentHash, baseTreeHash, err := s.getOrCreateShadowBranch(shadowBranchName)
    72→	if err != nil {
    73→		return WriteTemporaryResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to get shadow branch: %w", err)
    74→	}
    75→
    76→	// Get the last checkpoint's tree hash for deduplication
    77→	var lastTreeHash plumbing.Hash
    78→	if parentHash != plumbing.ZeroHash {
    79→		if lastCommit, err := s.repo.CommitObject(parentHash); err == nil {
    80→			lastTreeHash = lastCommit.TreeHash
    81→		}
    82→	}
    83→
    84→	// Collect all files to include
    85→	var allFiles []string
    86→	var allDeletedFiles []string
    87→	if opts.IsFirstCheckpoint {
    88→		// For the first checkpoint, capture all changed files (modified tracked + untracked)
    89→		// using `git status --porcelain -z` which respects both repo and global .gitignore.
    90→		// This is much faster than filesystem walk. The base tree from HEAD already contains
    91→		// all unchanged tracked files. We also capture user's pre-existing deletions.
    92→		result, err := collectChangedFiles(ctx, s.repo)
    93→		if err != nil {
    94→			return WriteTemporaryResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to collect changed files: %w", err)
    95→		}
    96→		allFiles = result.Changed
    97→		// Merge user's pre-existing deletions with agent's deletions
    98→		allDeletedFiles = result.Deleted
    99→		allDeletedFiles = append(allDeletedFiles, opts.DeletedFiles...)
   100→	} else {
   101→		// For subsequent checkpoints, only include modified/new files
   102→		allFiles = make([]string, 0, len(opts.ModifiedFiles)+len(opts.NewFiles))
   103→		allFiles = append(allFiles, opts.ModifiedFiles...)
   104→		allFiles = append(allFiles, opts.NewFiles...)
   105→		allDeletedFiles = opts.DeletedFiles
   106→	}
   107→
   108→	// Build tree with changes
   109→	treeHash, err := s.buildTreeWithChanges(baseTreeHash, allFiles, allDeletedFiles, opts.MetadataDir, opts.MetadataDirAbs)
   110→	if err != nil {
   111→		return WriteTemporaryResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to build tree: %w", err)
   112→	}
   113→
   114→	// Deduplication: skip if tree hash matches the last checkpoint
   115→	if lastTreeHash != plumbing.ZeroHash && treeHash == lastTreeHash {
   116→		return WriteTemporaryResult{
   117→			CommitHash: parentHash,
   118→			Skipped:    true,
   119→		}, nil
   120→	}
   121→
   122→	// Create checkpoint commit with trailers
   123→	commitMsg := trailers.FormatShadowCommit(opts.CommitMessage, opts.MetadataDir, opts.SessionID)
   124→
   125→	commitHash, err := s.createCommit(treeHash, parentHash, commitMsg, opts.AuthorName, opts.AuthorEmail)
   126→	if err != nil {
   127→		return WriteTemporaryResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to create commit: %w", err)
   128→	}
   129→
   130→	// Update branch reference
   131→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   132→	newRef := plumbing.NewHashReference(refName, commitHash)
   133→	if err := s.repo.Storer.SetReference(newRef); err != nil {
   134→		return WriteTemporaryResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to update branch reference: %w", err)
   135→	}
   136→
   137→	return WriteTemporaryResult{
   138→		CommitHash: commitHash,
   139→		Skipped:    false,
   140→	}, nil
   141→}
   142→
   143→// ReadTemporary reads the latest checkpoint from a shadow branch.
   144→// Returns nil if the shadow branch doesn't exist.
   145→// worktreeID should be empty for main worktree or the internal git worktree name for linked worktrees.
   146→func (s *GitStore) ReadTemporary(ctx context.Context, baseCommit, worktreeID string) (*ReadTemporaryResult, error) {
   147→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   148→
   149→	shadowBranchName := ShadowBranchNameForCommit(baseCommit, worktreeID)
   150→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   151→
   152→	ref, err := s.repo.Reference(refName, true)
   153→	if err != nil {
   154→		return nil, nil //nolint:nilnil,nilerr // Branch not found is an expected case
   155→	}
   156→
   157→	commit, err := s.repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
   158→	if err != nil {
   159→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit object: %w", err)
   160→	}
   161→
   162→	// Extract session ID and metadata dir from commit trailers
   163→	sessionID, _ := trailers.ParseSession(commit.Message)
   164→	metadataDir, _ := trailers.ParseMetadata(commit.Message)
   165→
   166→	return &ReadTemporaryResult{
   167→		CommitHash:  ref.Hash(),
   168→		TreeHash:    commit.TreeHash,
   169→		SessionID:   sessionID,
   170→		MetadataDir: metadataDir,
   171→		Timestamp:   commit.Author.When,
   172→	}, nil
   173→}

   175→// ListTemporary lists all shadow branches with their checkpoint info.
   176→func (s *GitStore) ListTemporary(ctx context.Context) ([]TemporaryInfo, error) {
   177→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   178→
   179→	iter, err := s.repo.Branches()
   180→	if err != nil {
   181→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to list branches: %w", err)
   182→	}
   183→
   184→	var results []TemporaryInfo
   185→	err = iter.ForEach(func(ref *plumbing.Reference) error {
   186→		branchName := ref.Name().Short()
   187→		if !strings.HasPrefix(branchName, ShadowBranchPrefix) {
   188→			return nil
   189→		}
   190→
   191→		// Skip the sessions branch
   192→		if branchName == paths.MetadataBranchName {
   193→			return nil
   194→		}
   195→
   196→		commit, commitErr := s.repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
   197→		if commitErr != nil {
   198→			//nolint:nilerr // Skip branches we can't read (non-fatal)
   199→			return nil
   200→		}
   201→
   202→		sessionID, _ := trailers.ParseSession(commit.Message)
   203→
   204→		// Extract base commit from branch name (handles new "entire/<commit>-<worktreeHash>" format)
   205→		baseCommit, _, _ := ParseShadowBranchName(branchName)
   206→
   207→		results = append(results, TemporaryInfo{
   208→			BranchName:   branchName,
   209→			BaseCommit:   baseCommit,
   210→			LatestCommit: ref.Hash(),
   211→			SessionID:    sessionID,
   212→			Timestamp:    commit.Author.When,
   213→		})
   214→
   215→		return nil
   216→	})
   217→
   218→	if err != nil {
   219→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to iterate branches: %w", err)
   220→	}
   221→
   222→	return results, nil
   223→}
   224→
   225→// WriteTemporaryTask writes a task checkpoint to a shadow branch.
   226→// Task checkpoints include both code changes and task-specific metadata.
   227→// Returns the commit hash of the created checkpoint.
   228→func (s *GitStore) WriteTemporaryTask(ctx context.Context, opts WriteTemporaryTaskOptions) (plumbing.Hash, error) {
   229→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   230→
   231→	// Validate base commit - required for shadow branch naming
   232→	if opts.BaseCommit == "" {
   233→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, errors.New("BaseCommit is required for task checkpoint")
   234→	}
   235→
   236→	// Validate identifiers to prevent path traversal and malformed data
   237→	if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(opts.SessionID); err != nil {
   238→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("invalid task checkpoint options: %w", err)
   239→	}
   240→	if err := validation.ValidateToolUseID(opts.ToolUseID); err != nil {
   241→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("invalid task checkpoint options: %w", err)
   242→	}
   243→	if err := validation.ValidateAgentID(opts.AgentID); err != nil {
   244→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("invalid task checkpoint options: %w", err)
   245→	}
   246→
   247→	// Get shadow branch name
   248→	shadowBranchName := ShadowBranchNameForCommit(opts.BaseCommit, opts.WorktreeID)
   249→
   250→	// Get or create shadow branch
   251→	parentHash, baseTreeHash, err := s.getOrCreateShadowBranch(shadowBranchName)
   252→	if err != nil {
   253→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to get shadow branch: %w", err)
   254→	}
   255→
   256→	// Collect all files to include in the commit
   257→	allFiles := make([]string, 0, len(opts.ModifiedFiles)+len(opts.NewFiles))
   258→	allFiles = append(allFiles, opts.ModifiedFiles...)
   259→	allFiles = append(allFiles, opts.NewFiles...)
   260→
   261→	// Build new tree with code changes (no metadata dir yet)
   262→	newTreeHash, err := s.buildTreeWithChanges(baseTreeHash, allFiles, opts.DeletedFiles, "", "")
   263→	if err != nil {
   264→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to build tree: %w", err)
   265→	}
   266→
   267→	// Add task metadata to tree
   268→	newTreeHash, err = s.addTaskMetadataToTree(newTreeHash, opts)
   269→	if err != nil {
   270→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to add task metadata: %w", err)
   271→	}
   272→
   273→	// Create the commit
   274→	commitHash, err := s.createCommit(newTreeHash, parentHash, opts.CommitMessage, opts.AuthorName, opts.AuthorEmail)
   275→	if err != nil {
   276→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to create commit: %w", err)
   277→	}
   278→
   279→	// Update shadow branch reference
   280→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   281→	ref := plumbing.NewHashReference(refName, commitHash)
   282→	if err := s.repo.Storer.SetReference(ref); err != nil {
   283→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to update shadow branch reference: %w", err)
   284→	}
   285→
   286→	return commitHash, nil
   287→}
   288→
   289→// addTaskMetadataToTree adds task checkpoint metadata to a git tree.
   290→// When IsIncremental is true, only adds the incremental checkpoint file.
   291→func (s *GitStore) addTaskMetadataToTree(baseTreeHash plumbing.Hash, opts WriteTemporaryTaskOptions) (plumbing.Hash, error) {
   292→	// Get base tree and flatten it
   293→	baseTree, err := s.repo.TreeObject(baseTreeHash)
   294→	if err != nil {
   295→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to get base tree: %w", err)
   296→	}
   297→
   298→	entries := make(map[string]object.TreeEntry)
   299→	if err := FlattenTree(s.repo, baseTree, "", entries); err != nil {
   300→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to flatten tree: %w", err)
   301→	}
   302→
   303→	// Compute metadata paths
   304→	sessionMetadataDir := paths.EntireMetadataDir + "/" + opts.SessionID
   305→	taskMetadataDir := sessionMetadataDir + "/tasks/" + opts.ToolUseID
   306→
   307→	if opts.IsIncremental {
   308→		// Incremental checkpoint: only add the checkpoint file
   309→		// Use proper JSON marshaling to handle nil/empty IncrementalData correctly
   310→		var incData []byte
   311→		if opts.IncrementalData != nil {
   312→			incData, err = redact.JSONLBytes(opts.IncrementalData)
   313→			if err != nil {
   314→				return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to redact incremental checkpoint: %w", err)
   315→			}
   316→		}
   317→		incrementalCheckpoint := struct {
   318→			Type      string          `json:"type"`
   319→			ToolUseID string          `json:"tool_use_id"`
   320→			Timestamp time.Time       `json:"timestamp"`
   321→			Data      json.RawMessage `json:"data"`
   322→		}{
   323→			Type:      opts.IncrementalType,
   324→			ToolUseID: opts.ToolUseID,
   325→			Timestamp: time.Now().UTC(),
   326→			Data:      incData,
   327→		}
   328→		cpData, err := jsonutil.MarshalIndentWithNewline(incrementalCheckpoint, "", "  ")
   329→		if err != nil {
   330→			return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal incremental checkpoint: %w", err)
   331→		}
   332→
   333→		cpBlobHash, err := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, cpData)
   334→		if err != nil {
   335→			return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to create incremental checkpoint blob: %w", err)
   336→		}
   337→		cpFilename := fmt.Sprintf("%03d-%s.json", opts.IncrementalSequence, opts.ToolUseID)
   338→		cpPath := taskMetadataDir + "/checkpoints/" + cpFilename
   339→		entries[cpPath] = object.TreeEntry{
   340→			Name: cpPath,
   341→			Mode: filemode.Regular,
   342→			Hash: cpBlobHash,
   343→		}
   344→	} else {
   345→		// Final checkpoint: add transcripts and checkpoint.json
   346→
   347→		// Add session transcript (with chunking support for large transcripts)
   348→		if opts.TranscriptPath != "" {
   349→			if transcriptContent, readErr := os.ReadFile(opts.TranscriptPath); readErr == nil {
   350→				// Detect agent type from content for proper chunking
   351→				agentType := agent.DetectAgentTypeFromContent(transcriptContent)
   352→
   353→				// Chunk if necessary
   354→				chunks, chunkErr := agent.ChunkTranscript(transcriptContent, agentType)
   355→				if chunkErr != nil {
   356→					logging.Warn(context.Background(), "failed to chunk transcript, checkpoint will be saved without transcript",
   357→						slog.String("error", chunkErr.Error()),
   358→						slog.String("session_id", opts.SessionID),
   359→					)
   360→				} else {
   361→					for i, chunk := range chunks {
   362→						chunkPath := sessionMetadataDir + "/" + agent.ChunkFileName(paths.TranscriptFileName, i)
   363→						blobHash, blobErr := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, chunk)
   364→						if blobErr != nil {
   365→							logging.Warn(context.Background(), "failed to create blob for transcript chunk",
   366→								slog.String("error", blobErr.Error()),
   367→								slog.String("session_id", opts.SessionID),
   368→								slog.Int("chunk_index", i),
   369→							)
   370→							continue
   371→						}
   372→						entries[chunkPath] = object.TreeEntry{
   373→							Name: chunkPath,
   374→							Mode: filemode.Regular,
   375→							Hash: blobHash,
   376→						}
   377→					}
   378→				}
   379→			}
   380→		}
   381→
   382→		// Add subagent transcript if available
   383→		if opts.SubagentTranscriptPath != "" && opts.AgentID != "" {
   384→			if agentContent, readErr := os.ReadFile(opts.SubagentTranscriptPath); readErr == nil {
   385→				redacted, jsonlErr := redact.JSONLBytes(agentContent)
   386→				if jsonlErr != nil {
   387→					logging.Warn(context.Background(), "subagent transcript is not valid JSONL, falling back to plain redaction",
   388→						slog.String("path", opts.SubagentTranscriptPath),
   389→						slog.String("error", jsonlErr.Error()),
   390→					)
   391→					redacted = redact.Bytes(agentContent)
   392→				}
   393→				agentContent = redacted
   394→				if blobHash, blobErr := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, agentContent); blobErr == nil {
   395→					agentPath := taskMetadataDir + "/agent-" + opts.AgentID + ".jsonl"
   396→					entries[agentPath] = object.TreeEntry{
   397→						Name: agentPath,
   398→						Mode: filemode.Regular,
   399→						Hash: blobHash,
   400→					}
   401→				}
   402→			}
   403→		}
   404→
   405→		// Add checkpoint.json
   406→		checkpointJSON := fmt.Sprintf(`{
   407→  "session_id": %q,
   408→  "tool_use_id": %q,
   409→  "checkpoint_uuid": %q,
   410→  "agent_id": %q
   411→}`, opts.SessionID, opts.ToolUseID, opts.CheckpointUUID, opts.AgentID)
   412→
   413→		blobHash, err := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, []byte(checkpointJSON))
   414→		if err != nil {
   415→			return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to create checkpoint blob: %w", err)
   416→		}
   417→		checkpointPath := taskMetadataDir + "/checkpoint.json"
   418→		entries[checkpointPath] = object.TreeEntry{
   419→			Name: checkpointPath,
   420→			Mode: filemode.Regular,
   421→			Hash: blobHash,
   422→		}
   423→	}
   424→
   425→	// Build new tree from entries
   426→	return BuildTreeFromEntries(s.repo, entries)
   427→}
   428→
   429→// ListTemporaryCheckpoints lists all checkpoint commits on a shadow branch.
   430→// This returns individual commits (rewind points), not just branch info.
   431→// The sessionID filter, if provided, limits results to commits from that session.
   432→// worktreeID should be empty for main worktree or the internal git worktree name for linked worktrees.
   433→func (s *GitStore) ListTemporaryCheckpoints(ctx context.Context, baseCommit, worktreeID, sessionID string, limit int) ([]TemporaryCheckpointInfo, error) {
   434→	shadowBranchName := ShadowBranchNameForCommit(baseCommit, worktreeID)
   435→	return s.listCheckpointsForBranch(ctx, shadowBranchName, sessionID, limit)
   436→}
   437→
   438→// ListCheckpointsForBranch lists checkpoint commits for a shadow branch by name.
   439→// Use this when you already have the full branch name (e.g., from ListTemporary).
   440→// The sessionID filter, if provided, limits results to commits from that session.
   441→func (s *GitStore) ListCheckpointsForBranch(ctx context.Context, branchName, sessionID string, limit int) ([]TemporaryCheckpointInfo, error) {
   442→	return s.listCheckpointsForBranch(ctx, branchName, sessionID, limit)
   443→}
   444→
   445→// listCheckpointsForBranch lists checkpoint commits for a specific shadow branch name.
   446→// This is an internal helper used by ListTemporaryCheckpoints, ListCheckpointsForBranch, and ListAllTemporaryCheckpoints.
   447→func (s *GitStore) listCheckpointsForBranch(ctx context.Context, shadowBranchName, sessionID string, limit int) ([]TemporaryCheckpointInfo, error) {
   448→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   449→
   450→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   451→
   452→	ref, err := s.repo.Reference(refName, true)
   453→	if err != nil {
   454→		return nil, nil //nolint:nilerr // No shadow branch is expected case
   455→	}
   456→
   457→	iter, err := s.repo.Log(&git.LogOptions{From: ref.Hash()})
   458→	if err != nil {
   459→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit log: %w", err)
   460→	}
   461→
   462→	var results []TemporaryCheckpointInfo
   463→	count := 0
   464→
   465→	err = iter.ForEach(func(c *object.Commit) error {
   466→		if count >= limit*5 { // Scan more to allow for session filtering
   467→			return errStop
   468→		}
   469→		count++
   470→
   471→		// Verify commit belongs to target session via Entire-Session trailer
   472→		commitSessionID, hasTrailer := trailers.ParseSession(c.Message)
   473→		if !hasTrailer {
   474→			return nil // Skip commits without session trailer
   475→		}
   476→		if sessionID != "" && commitSessionID != sessionID {
   477→			return nil // Skip commits from other sessions
   478→		}
   479→
   480→		// Get first line of message
   481→		message := c.Message
   482→		if idx := strings.Index(message, "\n"); idx > 0 {
   483→			message = message[:idx]
   484→		}
   485→
   486→		info := TemporaryCheckpointInfo{
   487→			CommitHash: c.Hash,
   488→			Message:    message,
   489→			SessionID:  commitSessionID,
   490→			Timestamp:  c.Author.When,
   491→		}
   492→
   493→		// Check for task checkpoint first
   494→		taskMetadataDir, foundTask := trailers.ParseTaskMetadata(c.Message)
   495→		if foundTask {
   496→			info.IsTaskCheckpoint = true
   497→			info.MetadataDir = taskMetadataDir
   498→			info.ToolUseID = extractToolUseIDFromPath(taskMetadataDir)
   499→		} else {
   500→			metadataDir, found := trailers.ParseMetadata(c.Message)
   501→			if found {
   502→				info.MetadataDir = metadataDir
   503→			}
   504→		}
   505→
   506→		results = append(results, info)
   507→
   508→		if len(results) >= limit {
   509→			return errStop
   510→		}
   511→		return nil
   512→	})
   513→
   514→	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, errStop) {
   515→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("error iterating commits: %w", err)
   516→	}
   517→
   518→	return results, nil
   519→}
   520→
   521→// ListAllTemporaryCheckpoints lists checkpoint commits from ALL shadow branches.
   522→// This is used for checkpoint lookup when the base commit is unknown (e.g., HEAD advanced since session start).
   523→// The sessionID filter, if provided, limits results to commits from that session.
   524→func (s *GitStore) ListAllTemporaryCheckpoints(ctx context.Context, sessionID string, limit int) ([]TemporaryCheckpointInfo, error) {
   525→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   526→
   527→	// List all shadow branches
   528→	branches, err := s.ListTemporary(ctx)
   529→	if err != nil {
   530→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to list shadow branches: %w", err)
   531→	}
   532→
   533→	var results []TemporaryCheckpointInfo
   534→
   535→	// Iterate through each shadow branch and collect checkpoints
   536→	for _, branch := range branches {
   537→		// Use the branch name directly to get checkpoints
   538→		branchCheckpoints, branchErr := s.listCheckpointsForBranch(ctx, branch.BranchName, sessionID, limit)
   539→		if branchErr != nil {
   540→			continue // Skip branches we can't read
   541→		}
   542→		results = append(results, branchCheckpoints...)
   543→		if len(results) >= limit {
   544→			results = results[:limit]
   545→			break
   546→		}
   547→	}
   548→
   549→	return results, nil
   550→}
   551→
   552→// extractToolUseIDFromPath extracts the ToolUseID from a task metadata directory path.
   553→// Task metadata dirs have format: .entire/metadata/<session>/tasks/<toolUseID>
   554→func extractToolUseIDFromPath(metadataDir string) string {
   555→	parts := strings.Split(metadataDir, "/")
   556→	if len(parts) >= 2 && parts[len(parts)-2] == "tasks" {
   557→		return parts[len(parts)-1]
   558→	}
   559→	return ""
   560→}
   561→
   562→// errStop is a sentinel error used to break out of git log iteration.
   563→var errStop = errors.New("stop iteration")
   564→
   565→// GetTranscriptFromCommit retrieves the transcript from a specific commit's tree.
   566→// This is used for shadow branch checkpoints where the transcript is stored in the commit tree
   567→// rather than on the entire/checkpoints/v1 branch.
   568→// commitHash is the commit to read from, metadataDir is the path within the tree.
   569→// agentType is used for reassembling chunked transcripts in the correct format.
   570→// Handles both chunked and non-chunked transcripts.
   571→func (s *GitStore) GetTranscriptFromCommit(commitHash plumbing.Hash, metadataDir string, agentType agent.AgentType) ([]byte, error) {
   572→	commit, err := s.repo.CommitObject(commitHash)
   573→	if err != nil {
   574→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit: %w", err)
   575→	}
   576→
   577→	tree, err := commit.Tree()
   578→	if err != nil {
   579→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit tree: %w", err)
   580→	}
   581→
   582→	// Try to get the metadata subtree for chunk detection
   583→	subTree, subTreeErr := tree.Tree(metadataDir)
   584→	if subTreeErr == nil {
   585→		// Use the helper function that handles chunking
   586→		transcript, err := readTranscriptFromTree(subTree, agentType)
   587→		if err == nil && transcript != nil {
   588→			return transcript, nil
   589→		}
   590→	}
   591→
   592→	// Fall back to direct file access (for backwards compatibility)
   593→	transcriptPath := metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileName
   594→	if file, fileErr := tree.File(transcriptPath); fileErr == nil {
   595→		content, contentErr := file.Contents()
   596→		if contentErr == nil {
   597→			return []byte(content), nil
   598→		}
   599→	}
   600→
   601→	transcriptPath = metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy
   602→	if file, fileErr := tree.File(transcriptPath); fileErr == nil {
   603→		content, contentErr := file.Contents()
   604→		if contentErr == nil {
   605→			return []byte(content), nil
   606→		}
   607→	}
   608→
   609→	return nil, ErrNoTranscript
   610→}
   611→
   612→// GetExportDataFromCommit reads the export data file from a commit tree's metadata directory.
   613→// Returns nil if not found (most agents don't produce export data).
   614→func (s *GitStore) GetExportDataFromCommit(commitHash plumbing.Hash, metadataDir string) []byte {
   615→	commit, err := s.repo.CommitObject(commitHash)
   616→	if err != nil {
   617→		return nil
   618→	}
   619→	tree, err := commit.Tree()
   620→	if err != nil {
   621→		return nil
   622→	}
   623→	exportPath := metadataDir + "/" + paths.ExportDataFileName
   624→	file, err := tree.File(exportPath)
   625→	if err != nil {
   626→		return nil
   627→	}
   628→	content, err := file.Contents()
   629→	if err != nil {
   630→		return nil
   631→	}
   632→	return []byte(content)
   633→}
   634→
   635→// ShadowBranchExists checks if a shadow branch exists for the given base commit and worktree.
   636→// worktreeID should be empty for main worktree or the internal git worktree name for linked worktrees.
   637→func (s *GitStore) ShadowBranchExists(baseCommit, worktreeID string) bool {
   638→	shadowBranchName := ShadowBranchNameForCommit(baseCommit, worktreeID)
   639→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   640→	_, err := s.repo.Reference(refName, true)
   641→	return err == nil
   642→}
   643→
   644→// DeleteShadowBranch deletes the shadow branch for the given base commit and worktree.
   645→// worktreeID should be empty for main worktree or the internal git worktree name for linked worktrees.
   646→// Uses git CLI instead of go-git's RemoveReference because go-git v5 doesn't properly
   647→// persist deletions with packed refs or worktrees.
   648→func (s *GitStore) DeleteShadowBranch(baseCommit, worktreeID string) error {
   649→	shadowBranchName := ShadowBranchNameForCommit(baseCommit, worktreeID)
   650→	cmd := exec.CommandContext(context.Background(), "git", "branch", "-D", "--", shadowBranchName) //nolint:gosec // shadowBranchName is constructed from commit hash, not user input
   651→	if output, err := cmd.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
   652→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to delete shadow branch %s: %s: %w", shadowBranchName, strings.TrimSpace(string(output)), err)
   653→	}
   654→	return nil
   655→}
   656→
   657→// ShadowBranchNameForCommit returns the shadow branch name for a base commit hash
   658→// and worktree identifier. The worktree ID should be empty for the main worktree
   659→// or the internal git worktree name for linked worktrees.
   660→// Format: entire/<commit[:7]>-<hash(worktreeID)[:6]>
   661→func ShadowBranchNameForCommit(baseCommit, worktreeID string) string {
   662→	commitPart := baseCommit
   663→	if len(baseCommit) >= ShadowBranchHashLength {
   664→		commitPart = baseCommit[:ShadowBranchHashLength]
   665→	}
   666→	worktreeHash := HashWorktreeID(worktreeID)
   667→	return ShadowBranchPrefix + commitPart + "-" + worktreeHash
   668→}
   669→
   670→// ParseShadowBranchName extracts the commit prefix and worktree hash from a shadow branch name.
   671→// Input format: "entire/<commit[:7]>-<worktreeHash[:6]>"
   672→// Returns (commitPrefix, worktreeHash, ok). Returns ("", "", false) if not a valid shadow branch.
   673→func ParseShadowBranchName(branchName string) (commitPrefix, worktreeHash string, ok bool) {
   674→	if !strings.HasPrefix(branchName, ShadowBranchPrefix) {
   675→		return "", "", false
   676→	}
   677→	suffix := strings.TrimPrefix(branchName, ShadowBranchPrefix)
   678→
   679→	// Find the last dash - everything before is commit prefix, after is worktree hash
   680→	lastDash := strings.LastIndex(suffix, "-")
   681→	if lastDash == -1 || lastDash == 0 || lastDash == len(suffix)-1 {
   682→		// No dash, or dash at start/end - invalid format
   683→		// Could be old format "entire/<commit[:7]>" without worktree hash
   684→		return suffix, "", true // Return as commit prefix with empty worktree hash
   685→	}
   686→
   687→	return suffix[:lastDash], suffix[lastDash+1:], true
   688→}
   689→
   690→// getOrCreateShadowBranch gets or creates the shadow branch for checkpoints.
   691→// Returns (parentHash, baseTreeHash, error).
   692→func (s *GitStore) getOrCreateShadowBranch(branchName string) (plumbing.Hash, plumbing.Hash, error) {
   693→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(branchName)
   694→	ref, err := s.repo.Reference(refName, true)
   695→
   696→	if err == nil {
   697→		// Branch exists
   698→		commit, err := s.repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
   699→		if err != nil {
   700→			return plumbing.ZeroHash, plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit object: %w", err)
   701→		}
   702→		return ref.Hash(), commit.TreeHash, nil
   703→	}
   704→
   705→	// Branch doesn't exist, use current HEAD's tree as base
   706→	head, err := s.repo.Head()
   707→	if err != nil {
   708→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD: %w", err)
   709→	}
   710→
   711→	headCommit, err := s.repo.CommitObject(head.Hash())
   712→	if err != nil {
   713→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD commit: %w", err)
   714→	}
   715→
   716→	return plumbing.ZeroHash, headCommit.TreeHash, nil
   717→}
   718→
   719→// buildTreeWithChanges builds a git tree with the given changes.
   720→// metadataDir is the relative path for git tree entries, metadataDirAbs is the absolute path
   721→// for filesystem operations (needed when CLI is run from a subdirectory).
   722→func (s *GitStore) buildTreeWithChanges(
   723→	baseTreeHash plumbing.Hash,
   724→	modifiedFiles, deletedFiles []string,
   725→	metadataDir, metadataDirAbs string,
   726→) (plumbing.Hash, error) {
   727→	// Get repo root for resolving file paths
   728→	// This is critical because fileExists() and createBlobFromFile() use os.Stat()
   729→	// which resolves relative to CWD. The modifiedFiles are repo-relative paths,
   730→	// so we must resolve them against repo root, not CWD.
   731→	repoRoot, err := paths.RepoRoot()
   732→	if err != nil {
   733→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to get repo root: %w", err)
   734→	}
   735→
   736→	// Get the base tree
   737→	baseTree, err := s.repo.TreeObject(baseTreeHash)
   738→	if err != nil {
   739→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to get base tree: %w", err)
   740→	}
   741→
   742→	// Flatten existing tree
   743→	entries := make(map[string]object.TreeEntry)
   744→	if err := FlattenTree(s.repo, baseTree, "", entries); err != nil {
   745→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to flatten base tree: %w", err)
   746→	}
   747→
   748→	// Remove deleted files
   749→	for _, file := range deletedFiles {
   750→		delete(entries, file)
   751→	}
   752→
   753→	// Add/update modified files
   754→	for _, file := range modifiedFiles {
   755→		// Resolve path relative to repo root for filesystem operations
   756→		absPath := filepath.Join(repoRoot, file)
   757→		if !fileExists(absPath) {
   758→			delete(entries, file)
   759→			continue
   760→		}
   761→
   762→		blobHash, mode, err := createBlobFromFile(s.repo, absPath)
   763→		if err != nil {
   764→			// Skip files that can't be staged (may have been deleted since detection)
   765→			continue
   766→		}
   767→
   768→		entries[file] = object.TreeEntry{
   769→			Name: file,
   770→			Mode: mode,
   771→			Hash: blobHash,
   772→		}
   773→	}
   774→
   775→	// Add metadata directory files
   776→	if metadataDir != "" && metadataDirAbs != "" {
   777→		if err := addDirectoryToEntriesWithAbsPath(s.repo, metadataDirAbs, metadataDir, entries); err != nil {
   778→			return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to add metadata directory: %w", err)
   779→		}
   780→	}
   781→
   782→	// Build tree
   783→	return BuildTreeFromEntries(s.repo, entries)
   784→}

   786→// createCommit creates a commit object.
   787→func (s *GitStore) createCommit(treeHash, parentHash plumbing.Hash, message, authorName, authorEmail string) (plumbing.Hash, error) {
   788→	now := time.Now()
   789→	sig := object.Signature{
   790→		Name:  authorName,
   791→		Email: authorEmail,
   792→		When:  now,
   793→	}
   794→
   795→	commit := &object.Commit{
   796→		TreeHash:  treeHash,
   797→		Author:    sig,
   798→		Committer: sig,
   799→		Message:   message,
   800→	}
   801→
   802→	// Add parent if not a new branch
   803→	if parentHash != plumbing.ZeroHash {
   804→		commit.ParentHashes = []plumbing.Hash{parentHash}
   805→	}
   806→
   807→	obj := s.repo.Storer.NewEncodedObject()
   808→	if err := commit.Encode(obj); err != nil {
   809→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to encode commit: %w", err)
   810→	}
   811→
   812→	hash, err := s.repo.Storer.SetEncodedObject(obj)
   813→	if err != nil {
   814→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to store commit: %w", err)
   815→	}
   816→
   817→	return hash, nil
   818→}

   820→// Helper functions extracted from strategy/common.go

   822→
   823→// FlattenTree recursively flattens a tree into a map of full paths to entries.
   824→func FlattenTree(repo *git.Repository, tree *object.Tree, prefix string, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry) error {
   825→	for _, entry := range tree.Entries {
   826→		fullPath := entry.Name
   827→		if prefix != "" {
   828→			fullPath = prefix + "/" + entry.Name
   829→		}
   830→
   831→		if entry.Mode == filemode.Dir {
   832→			// Recurse into subtree
   833→			subtree, err := repo.TreeObject(entry.Hash)
   834→			if err != nil {
   835→				return fmt.Errorf("failed to get subtree %s: %w", fullPath, err)
   836→			}
   837→			if err := FlattenTree(repo, subtree, fullPath, entries); err != nil {
   838→				return err
   839→			}
   840→		} else {
   841→			entries[fullPath] = object.TreeEntry{
   842→				Name: fullPath,
   843→				Mode: entry.Mode,
   844→				Hash: entry.Hash,
   845→			}
   846→		}
   847→	}
   848→	return nil
   849→}

   851→// fileExists checks if a file exists at the given path.
   852→func fileExists(path string) bool {
   853→	_, err := os.Stat(path)
   854→	return err == nil
   855→}
   856→
   857→// createBlobFromFile creates a blob object from a file in the working directory.
   858→func createBlobFromFile(repo *git.Repository, filePath string) (plumbing.Hash, filemode.FileMode, error) {
   859→	info, err := os.Stat(filePath)
   860→	if err != nil {
   861→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to stat file: %w", err)
   862→	}
   863→
   864→	// Determine file mode
   865→	mode := filemode.Regular
   866→	if info.Mode()&0o111 != 0 {
   867→		mode = filemode.Executable
   868→	}
   869→	if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
   870→		mode = filemode.Symlink
   871→	}
   872→
   873→	// Read file contents
   874→	content, err := os.ReadFile(filePath) //nolint:gosec // filePath comes from walking the repository
   875→	if err != nil {
   876→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to read file: %w", err)
   877→	}
   878→
   879→	// Create blob object
   880→	obj := repo.Storer.NewEncodedObject()
   881→	obj.SetType(plumbing.BlobObject)
   882→	obj.SetSize(int64(len(content)))
   883→
   884→	writer, err := obj.Writer()
   885→	if err != nil {
   886→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to get object writer: %w", err)
   887→	}
   888→
   889→	_, err = writer.Write(content)
   890→	if err != nil {
   891→		_ = writer.Close()
   892→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to write blob content: %w", err)
   893→	}
   894→	if err := writer.Close(); err != nil {
   895→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to close blob writer: %w", err)
   896→	}
   897→
   898→	hash, err := repo.Storer.SetEncodedObject(obj)
   899→	if err != nil {
   900→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to store blob object: %w", err)
   901→	}
   902→
   903→	return hash, mode, nil
   904→}
   905→
   906→// addDirectoryToEntriesWithAbsPath recursively adds all files in a directory to the entries map.
   907→func addDirectoryToEntriesWithAbsPath(repo *git.Repository, dirPathAbs, dirPathRel string, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry) error {
   908→	err := filepath.Walk(dirPathAbs, func(path string, info os.FileInfo, err error) error {
   909→		if err != nil {
   910→			return err
   911→		}
   912→
   913→		// Skip symlinks to prevent reading files outside the metadata directory.
   914→		// A symlink could point to sensitive files (e.g., /etc/passwd) which would
   915→		// then be captured in the checkpoint and stored in git history.
   916→		// NOTE: filepath.Walk uses os.Stat (follows symlinks), so info.Mode() never
   917→		// reports ModeSymlink. We use os.Lstat to check the entry itself.
   918→		// This check MUST come before IsDir() because Walk follows symlinked
   919→		// directories and would recurse into them otherwise.
   920→		linfo, lstatErr := os.Lstat(path)
   921→		if lstatErr != nil {
   922→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to lstat %s: %w", path, lstatErr)
   923→		}
   924→		if linfo.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
   925→			if info.IsDir() {
   926→				return filepath.SkipDir
   927→			}
   928→			return nil
   929→		}
   930→
   931→		if info.IsDir() {
   932→			return nil
   933→		}
   934→
   935→		// Calculate relative path within the directory, then join with dirPathRel for tree entry
   936→		relWithinDir, err := filepath.Rel(dirPathAbs, path)
   937→		if err != nil {
   938→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to get relative path for %s: %w", path, err)
   939→		}
   940→
   941→		// Prevent path traversal via symlinks pointing outside the metadata dir
   942→		if strings.HasPrefix(relWithinDir, "..") {
   943→			return fmt.Errorf("path traversal detected: %s", relWithinDir)
   944→		}
   945→
   946→		treePath := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(dirPathRel, relWithinDir))
   947→
   948→		blobHash, mode, err := createRedactedBlobFromFile(repo, path, treePath)
   949→		if err != nil {
   950→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to create blob for %s: %w", path, err)
   951→		}
   952→		entries[treePath] = object.TreeEntry{
   953→			Name: treePath,
   954→			Mode: mode,
   955→			Hash: blobHash,
   956→		}
   957→		return nil
   958→	})
   959→	if err != nil {
   960→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to walk directory %s: %w", dirPathAbs, err)
   961→	}
   962→	return nil
   963→}

   965→// treeNode represents a node in our tree structure.
   966→type treeNode struct {
   967→	entries map[string]*treeNode // subdirectories
   968→	files   []object.TreeEntry   // files in this directory
   969→}
   970→
   971→// BuildTreeFromEntries builds a proper git tree structure from flattened file entries.
   972→// Exported for use by strategy package (push_common.go, session_test.go)
   973→func BuildTreeFromEntries(repo *git.Repository, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry) (plumbing.Hash, error) {
   974→	// Build a tree structure
   975→	root := &treeNode{
   976→		entries: make(map[string]*treeNode),
   977→		files:   []object.TreeEntry{},
   978→	}
   979→
   980→	// Insert all entries into the tree structure
   981→	for fullPath, entry := range entries {
   982→		parts := strings.Split(fullPath, "/")
   983→		insertIntoTree(root, parts, entry)
   984→	}
   985→
   986→	// Recursively build tree objects from bottom up
   987→	return buildTreeObject(repo, root)
   988→}
   989→
   990→// insertIntoTree inserts a file entry into the tree structure.
   991→func insertIntoTree(node *treeNode, pathParts []string, entry object.TreeEntry) {
   992→	if len(pathParts) == 1 {
   993→		// This is a file in the current directory
   994→		node.files = append(node.files, object.TreeEntry{
   995→			Name: pathParts[0],
   996→			Mode: entry.Mode,
   997→			Hash: entry.Hash,
   998→		})
   999→		return
  1000→	}
  1001→
  1002→	// This is in a subdirectory
  1003→	dirName := pathParts[0]
  1004→	if node.entries[dirName] == nil {
  1005→		node.entries[dirName] = &treeNode{
  1006→			entries: make(map[string]*treeNode),
  1007→			files:   []object.TreeEntry{},
  1008→		}
  1009→	}
  1010→	insertIntoTree(node.entries[dirName], pathParts[1:], entry)
  1011→}
  1012→
  1013→// buildTreeObject recursively builds tree objects from a treeNode.
  1014→func buildTreeObject(repo *git.Repository, node *treeNode) (plumbing.Hash, error) {
  1015→	var treeEntries []object.TreeEntry
  1016→
  1017→	// Add files
  1018→	treeEntries = append(treeEntries, node.files...)
  1019→
  1020→	// Recursively build subtrees
  1021→	for name, subnode := range node.entries {
  1022→		subHash, err := buildTreeObject(repo, subnode)
  1023→		if err != nil {
  1024→			return plumbing.ZeroHash, err
  1025→		}
  1026→		treeEntries = append(treeEntries, object.TreeEntry{
  1027→			Name: name,
  1028→			Mode: filemode.Dir,
  1029→			Hash: subHash,
  1030→		})
  1031→	}
  1032→
  1033→	// Sort entries (git requires sorted entries)
  1034→	sortTreeEntries(treeEntries)
  1035→
  1036→	// Create tree object
  1037→	tree := &object.Tree{Entries: treeEntries}
  1038→
  1039→	obj := repo.Storer.NewEncodedObject()
  1040→	if err := tree.Encode(obj); err != nil {
  1041→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to encode tree: %w", err)
  1042→	}
  1043→
  1044→	hash, err := repo.Storer.SetEncodedObject(obj)
  1045→	if err != nil {
  1046→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to store tree: %w", err)
  1047→	}
  1048→
  1049→	return hash, nil
  1050→}
  1051→
  1052→// sortTreeEntries sorts tree entries in git's required order.
  1053→// Git sorts tree entries by name, with directories having a trailing /
  1054→func sortTreeEntries(entries []object.TreeEntry) {
  1055→	sort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool {
  1056→		nameI := entries[i].Name
  1057→		nameJ := entries[j].Name
  1058→		if entries[i].Mode == filemode.Dir {
  1059→			nameI += "/"
  1060→		}
  1061→		if entries[j].Mode == filemode.Dir {
  1062→			nameJ += "/"
  1063→		}
  1064→		return nameI < nameJ
  1065→	})
  1066→}
