    31→// listCheckpoints returns all checkpoints from the metadata branch.
    32→// Uses checkpoint.GitStore.ListCommitted() for reading from entire/checkpoints/v1.
    33→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) listCheckpoints() ([]CheckpointInfo, error) {
    34→	store, err := s.getCheckpointStore()
    35→	if err != nil {
    36→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get checkpoint store: %w", err)
    37→	}
    38→
    39→	committed, err := store.ListCommitted(context.Background())
    40→	if err != nil {
    41→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to list committed checkpoints: %w", err)
    42→	}
    43→
    44→	// Convert from checkpoint.CommittedInfo to strategy.CheckpointInfo
    45→	result := make([]CheckpointInfo, 0, len(committed))
    46→	for _, c := range committed {
    47→		result = append(result, CheckpointInfo{
    48→			CheckpointID:     c.CheckpointID,
    49→			SessionID:        c.SessionID,
    50→			CreatedAt:        c.CreatedAt,
    51→			CheckpointsCount: c.CheckpointsCount,
    52→			FilesTouched:     c.FilesTouched,
    53→			Agent:            c.Agent,
    54→			IsTask:           c.IsTask,
    55→			ToolUseID:        c.ToolUseID,
    56→			SessionCount:     c.SessionCount,
    57→			SessionIDs:       c.SessionIDs,
    58→		})
    59→	}
    60→
    61→	return result, nil
    62→}
    63→
    64→// getCheckpointsForSession returns all checkpoints for a session ID.
    65→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) getCheckpointsForSession(sessionID string) ([]CheckpointInfo, error) {
    66→	all, err := s.listCheckpoints()
    67→	if err != nil {
    68→		return nil, err
    69→	}
    70→
    71→	var result []CheckpointInfo
    72→	for _, cp := range all {
    73→		if cp.SessionID == sessionID || strings.HasPrefix(cp.SessionID, sessionID) {
    74→			result = append(result, cp)
    75→		}
    76→	}
    77→
    78→	if len(result) == 0 {
    79→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no checkpoints for session: %s", sessionID)
    80→	}
    81→
    82→	return result, nil
    83→}
    84→
    85→// getCheckpointLog returns the transcript for a specific checkpoint ID.
    86→// Uses checkpoint.GitStore.ReadCommitted() for reading from entire/checkpoints/v1.
    87→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) getCheckpointLog(checkpointID id.CheckpointID) ([]byte, error) {
    88→	store, err := s.getCheckpointStore()
    89→	if err != nil {
    90→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get checkpoint store: %w", err)
    91→	}
    92→
    93→	content, err := store.ReadLatestSessionContent(context.Background(), checkpointID)
    94→	if err != nil {
    95→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read checkpoint: %w", err)
    96→	}
    97→	if content == nil {
    98→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("checkpoint not found: %s", checkpointID)
    99→	}
   100→	if len(content.Transcript) == 0 {
   101→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no transcript found for checkpoint: %s", checkpointID)
   102→	}
   103→
   104→	return content.Transcript, nil
   105→}
   106→
   107→// CondenseSession condenses a session's shadow branch to permanent storage.
   108→// checkpointID is the 12-hex-char value from the Entire-Checkpoint trailer.
   109→// Metadata is stored at sharded path: <checkpoint_id[:2]>/<checkpoint_id[2:]>/
   110→// Uses checkpoint.GitStore.WriteCommitted for the git operations.
   111→//
   112→// For mid-session commits (no Stop/SaveStep called yet), the shadow branch may not exist.
   113→// In this case, data is extracted from the live transcript instead.
   114→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CondenseSession(repo *git.Repository, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, state *SessionState, committedFiles map[string]struct{}) (*CondenseResult, error) {
   115→	// Get shadow branch (may not exist for mid-session commits)
   116→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   117→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   118→	ref, err := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   119→	hasShadowBranch := err == nil
   120→
   121→	var sessionData *ExtractedSessionData
   122→	if hasShadowBranch {
   123→		// Extract session data from the shadow branch (with live transcript fallback).
   124→		// Use tracked files from session state instead of collecting all files from tree.
   125→		// Pass agent type to handle different transcript formats (JSONL for Claude, JSON for Gemini).
   126→		// Pass live transcript path so condensation reads the current file rather than a
   127→		// potentially stale shadow branch copy (SaveStep may have been skipped if the
   128→		// last turn had no code changes).
   129→		// Pass CheckpointTranscriptStart for accurate token calculation (line offset for Claude, message index for Gemini).
   130→		sessionData, err = s.extractSessionData(repo, ref.Hash(), state.SessionID, state.FilesTouched, state.AgentType, state.TranscriptPath, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   131→		if err != nil {
   132→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to extract session data: %w", err)
   133→		}
   134→	} else {
   135→		// No shadow branch: mid-session commit before Stop/SaveStep.
   136→		// Extract data directly from live transcript.
   137→		if state.TranscriptPath == "" {
   138→			return nil, errors.New("shadow branch not found and no live transcript available")
   139→		}
   140→		sessionData, err = s.extractSessionDataFromLiveTranscript(state)
   141→		if err != nil {
   142→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to extract session data from live transcript: %w", err)
   143→		}
   144→	}
   145→
   146→	// For 1:1 checkpoint model: filter files_touched to only include files actually
   147→	// committed in this specific commit. This ensures each checkpoint represents
   148→	// exactly the files in that commit, not all files mentioned in the transcript.
   149→	if len(committedFiles) > 0 {
   150→		// Track if we had files before filtering to distinguish between:
   151→		// - Session had files but none were committed (don't fallback)
   152→		// - Session had no files to begin with (mid-session commit, fallback OK)
   153→		hadFilesBeforeFiltering := len(sessionData.FilesTouched) > 0
   154→
   155→		if hadFilesBeforeFiltering {
   156→			// Filter to intersection of transcript-extracted files and committed files
   157→			filtered := make([]string, 0, len(sessionData.FilesTouched))
   158→			for _, f := range sessionData.FilesTouched {
   159→				if _, ok := committedFiles[f]; ok {
   160→					filtered = append(filtered, f)
   161→				}
   162→			}
   163→			sessionData.FilesTouched = filtered
   164→		}
   165→
   166→		// Only use committedFiles as fallback for genuine mid-session commits where
   167→		// no files were tracked yet (extraction returned empty). Do NOT fallback when
   168→		// the session had files that simply didn't overlap with the commit - that
   169→		// indicates an unrelated session that shouldn't have its files_touched
   170→		// overwritten with unrelated committed files.
   171→		if len(sessionData.FilesTouched) == 0 && !hadFilesBeforeFiltering {
   172→			sessionData.FilesTouched = make([]string, 0, len(committedFiles))
   173→			for f := range committedFiles {
   174→				sessionData.FilesTouched = append(sessionData.FilesTouched, f)
   175→			}
   176→		}
   177→	}
   178→
   179→	// Get checkpoint store
   180→	store, err := s.getCheckpointStore()
   181→	if err != nil {
   182→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get checkpoint store: %w", err)
   183→	}
   184→
   185→	// Get author info
   186→	authorName, authorEmail := GetGitAuthorFromRepo(repo)
   187→	// Calculate attribution. When no shadow branch exists (agent committed mid-turn
   188→	// before SaveStep), pass nil ref — the function uses HEAD as the shadow tree
   189→	// since the agent's commit IS HEAD (no user edits between agent work and commit).
   190→	attribution := calculateSessionAttributions(repo, ref, sessionData, state)
   191→	// Get current branch name
   192→	branchName := GetCurrentBranchName(repo)
   193→
   194→	// Generate summary if enabled
   195→	var summary *cpkg.Summary
   196→	if settings.IsSummarizeEnabled() && len(sessionData.Transcript) > 0 {
   197→		logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "attribution")
   198→		summarizeCtx := logging.WithComponent(logCtx, "summarize")
   199→
   200→		// Scope transcript to this checkpoint's portion.
   201→		// For Claude Code (JSONL), CheckpointTranscriptStart is a line offset.
   202→		// For Gemini/OpenCode (JSON), CheckpointTranscriptStart is a message index.
   203→		var scopedTranscript []byte
   204→		switch state.AgentType {
   205→		case agent.AgentTypeGemini:
   206→			scopedTranscript = geminicli.SliceFromMessage(sessionData.Transcript, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   207→		case agent.AgentTypeOpenCode:
   208→			scopedTranscript = opencode.SliceFromMessage(sessionData.Transcript, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   209→		case agent.AgentTypeClaudeCode, agent.AgentTypeUnknown:
   210→			scopedTranscript = transcript.SliceFromLine(sessionData.Transcript, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   211→		}
   212→		if len(scopedTranscript) > 0 {
   213→			var err error
   214→			summary, err = summarize.GenerateFromTranscript(summarizeCtx, scopedTranscript, sessionData.FilesTouched, state.AgentType, nil)
   215→			if err != nil {
   216→				logging.Warn(summarizeCtx, "summary generation failed",
   217→					slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   218→					slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   219→				// Continue without summary - non-blocking
   220→			} else {
   221→				logging.Info(summarizeCtx, "summary generated",
   222→					slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID))
   223→			}
   224→		}
   225→	}
   226→
   227→	// Write checkpoint metadata using the checkpoint store
   228→	if err := store.WriteCommitted(context.Background(), cpkg.WriteCommittedOptions{
   229→		CheckpointID:                checkpointID,
   230→		SessionID:                   state.SessionID,
   231→		Strategy:                    StrategyNameManualCommit,
   232→		Branch:                      branchName,
   233→		Transcript:                  sessionData.Transcript,
   234→		Prompts:                     sessionData.Prompts,
   235→		Context:                     sessionData.Context,
   236→		FilesTouched:                sessionData.FilesTouched,
   237→		CheckpointsCount:            state.StepCount,
   238→		EphemeralBranch:             shadowBranchName,
   239→		AuthorName:                  authorName,
   240→		AuthorEmail:                 authorEmail,
   241→		Agent:                       state.AgentType,
   242→		TurnID:                      state.TurnID,
   243→		TranscriptIdentifierAtStart: state.TranscriptIdentifierAtStart,
   244→		CheckpointTranscriptStart:   state.CheckpointTranscriptStart,
   245→		TokenUsage:                  sessionData.TokenUsage,
   246→		ExportData:                  sessionData.ExportData,
   247→		InitialAttribution:          attribution,
   248→		Summary:                     summary,
   249→	}); err != nil {
   250→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to write checkpoint metadata: %w", err)
   251→	}
   252→
   253→	return &CondenseResult{
   254→		CheckpointID:         checkpointID,
   255→		SessionID:            state.SessionID,
   256→		CheckpointsCount:     state.StepCount,
   257→		FilesTouched:         sessionData.FilesTouched,
   258→		TotalTranscriptLines: sessionData.FullTranscriptLines,
   259→	}, nil
   260→}
   261→
   262→func calculateSessionAttributions(repo *git.Repository, shadowRef *plumbing.Reference, sessionData *ExtractedSessionData, state *SessionState) *cpkg.InitialAttribution {
   263→	// Calculate initial attribution using accumulated prompt attribution data.
   264→	// This uses user edits captured at each prompt start (before agent works),
   265→	// plus any user edits after the final checkpoint (shadow → head).
   266→	//
   267→	// When shadowRef is nil (agent committed mid-turn before SaveStep),
   268→	// HEAD is used as the shadow tree. This is correct because the agent's
   269→	// commit IS HEAD — there are no user edits between agent work and commit.
   270→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "attribution")
   271→
   272→	headRef, headErr := repo.Head()
   273→	if headErr != nil {
   274→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get HEAD",
   275→			slog.String("error", headErr.Error()))
   276→		return nil
   277→	}
   278→
   279→	headCommit, commitErr := repo.CommitObject(headRef.Hash())
   280→	if commitErr != nil {
   281→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get HEAD commit",
   282→			slog.String("error", commitErr.Error()))
   283→		return nil
   284→	}
   285→
   286→	headTree, treeErr := headCommit.Tree()
   287→	if treeErr != nil {
   288→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get HEAD tree",
   289→			slog.String("error", treeErr.Error()))
   290→		return nil
   291→	}
   292→
   293→	// Get shadow tree: from shadow branch if available, otherwise HEAD (agent committed directly).
   294→	var shadowTree *object.Tree
   295→	if shadowRef != nil {
   296→		shadowCommit, shadowErr := repo.CommitObject(shadowRef.Hash())
   297→		if shadowErr != nil {
   298→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get shadow commit",
   299→				slog.String("error", shadowErr.Error()),
   300→				slog.String("shadow_ref", shadowRef.Hash().String()))
   301→			return nil
   302→		}
   303→		var shadowTreeErr error
   304→		shadowTree, shadowTreeErr = shadowCommit.Tree()
   305→		if shadowTreeErr != nil {
   306→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get shadow tree",
   307→				slog.String("error", shadowTreeErr.Error()))
   308→			return nil
   309→		}
   310→	} else {
   311→		// No shadow branch: agent committed mid-turn. Use HEAD as shadow
   312→		// because the agent's work is the commit itself.
   313→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution: using HEAD as shadow (no shadow branch)")
   314→		shadowTree = headTree
   315→	}
   316→
   317→	// Get base tree (state before session started)
   318→	var baseTree *object.Tree
   319→	attrBase := state.AttributionBaseCommit
   320→	if attrBase == "" {
   321→		attrBase = state.BaseCommit // backward compat
   322→	}
   323→	if baseCommit, baseErr := repo.CommitObject(plumbing.NewHash(attrBase)); baseErr == nil {
   324→		if tree, baseTErr := baseCommit.Tree(); baseTErr == nil {
   325→			baseTree = tree
   326→		} else {
   327→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution: base tree unavailable",
   328→				slog.String("error", baseTErr.Error()))
   329→		}
   330→	} else {
   331→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution: base commit unavailable",
   332→			slog.String("error", baseErr.Error()),
   333→			slog.String("attribution_base", attrBase))
   334→	}
   335→
   336→	// Log accumulated prompt attributions for debugging
   337→	var totalUserAdded, totalUserRemoved int
   338→	for i, pa := range state.PromptAttributions {
   339→		totalUserAdded += pa.UserLinesAdded
   340→		totalUserRemoved += pa.UserLinesRemoved
   341→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prompt attribution data",
   342→			slog.Int("checkpoint", pa.CheckpointNumber),
   343→			slog.Int("user_added", pa.UserLinesAdded),
   344→			slog.Int("user_removed", pa.UserLinesRemoved),
   345→			slog.Int("agent_added", pa.AgentLinesAdded),
   346→			slog.Int("agent_removed", pa.AgentLinesRemoved),
   347→			slog.Int("index", i))
   348→	}
   349→
   350→	attribution := CalculateAttributionWithAccumulated(
   351→		baseTree,
   352→		shadowTree,
   353→		headTree,
   354→		sessionData.FilesTouched,
   355→		state.PromptAttributions,
   356→	)
   357→
   358→	if attribution != nil {
   359→		logging.Info(logCtx, "attribution calculated",
   360→			slog.Int("agent_lines", attribution.AgentLines),
   361→			slog.Int("human_added", attribution.HumanAdded),
   362→			slog.Int("human_modified", attribution.HumanModified),
   363→			slog.Int("human_removed", attribution.HumanRemoved),
   364→			slog.Int("total_committed", attribution.TotalCommitted),
   365→			slog.Float64("agent_percentage", attribution.AgentPercentage),
   366→			slog.Int("accumulated_user_added", totalUserAdded),
   367→			slog.Int("accumulated_user_removed", totalUserRemoved),
   368→			slog.Int("files_touched", len(sessionData.FilesTouched)))
   369→	}
   370→
   371→	return attribution
   372→}
   373→
   374→// extractSessionData extracts session data from the shadow branch.
   375→// filesTouched is the list of files tracked during the session (from SessionState.FilesTouched).
   376→// agentType identifies the agent (e.g., "Gemini CLI", "Claude Code") to determine transcript format.
   377→// liveTranscriptPath, when non-empty and readable, is preferred over the shadow branch copy.
   378→// This handles the case where SaveStep was skipped (no code changes) but the transcript
   379→// continued growing — the shadow branch copy would be stale.
   380→// checkpointTranscriptStart is the line offset (Claude) or message index (Gemini) where the current checkpoint began.
   381→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) extractSessionData(repo *git.Repository, shadowRef plumbing.Hash, sessionID string, filesTouched []string, agentType agent.AgentType, liveTranscriptPath string, checkpointTranscriptStart int) (*ExtractedSessionData, error) {
   382→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(shadowRef)
   383→	if err != nil {
   384→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit object: %w", err)
   385→	}
   386→
   387→	tree, err := commit.Tree()
   388→	if err != nil {
   389→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit tree: %w", err)
   390→	}
   391→
   392→	data := &ExtractedSessionData{}
   393→	// sessionID is already an "entire session ID" (with date prefix)
   394→	metadataDir := paths.SessionMetadataDirFromSessionID(sessionID)
   395→
   396→	// Extract transcript — prefer the live file when available, fall back to shadow branch.
   397→	// The shadow branch copy may be stale if the last turn ended without code changes
   398→	// (SaveStep is only called when there are file modifications).
   399→	var fullTranscript string
   400→	if liveTranscriptPath != "" {
   401→		if liveData, readErr := os.ReadFile(liveTranscriptPath); readErr == nil && len(liveData) > 0 { //nolint:gosec // path from session state
   402→			fullTranscript = string(liveData)
   403→		}
   404→	}
   405→	if fullTranscript == "" {
   406→		// Fall back to shadow branch copy
   407→		if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileName); fileErr == nil {
   408→			if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   409→				fullTranscript = content
   410→			}
   411→		} else if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy); fileErr == nil {
   412→			if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   413→				fullTranscript = content
   414→			}
   415→		}
   416→	}
   417→
   418→	// Process transcript based on agent type
   419→	if fullTranscript != "" {
   420→		data.Transcript = []byte(fullTranscript)
   421→		data.FullTranscriptLines = countTranscriptItems(agentType, fullTranscript)
   422→		data.Prompts = extractUserPrompts(agentType, fullTranscript)
   423→		data.Context = generateContextFromPrompts(data.Prompts)
   424→	}
   425→
   426→	// Use tracked files from session state (not all files in tree)
   427→	data.FilesTouched = filesTouched
   428→
   429→	// Read export data from local metadata directory (e.g., OpenCode SQLite export).
   430→	// This is written by lifecycle.go during TurnEnd and must be stored in the
   431→	// committed checkpoint so resume/rewind can re-import the session.
   432→	exportRelPath := metadataDir + "/" + paths.ExportDataFileName
   433→	if exportAbsPath, absErr := paths.AbsPath(exportRelPath); absErr == nil {
   434→		if exportBytes, readErr := os.ReadFile(exportAbsPath); readErr == nil && len(exportBytes) > 0 { //nolint:gosec // path from session metadata
   435→			data.ExportData = exportBytes
   436→		}
   437→	}
   438→
   439→	// Calculate token usage from the extracted transcript portion
   440→	if len(data.Transcript) > 0 {
   441→		data.TokenUsage = calculateTokenUsage(agentType, data.Transcript, checkpointTranscriptStart)
   442→	}
   443→
   444→	return data, nil
   445→}
   446→
   447→// extractSessionDataFromLiveTranscript extracts session data directly from the live transcript file.
   448→// This is used for mid-session commits where no shadow branch exists yet.
   449→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) extractSessionDataFromLiveTranscript(state *SessionState) (*ExtractedSessionData, error) {
   450→	data := &ExtractedSessionData{}
   451→
   452→	// Read the live transcript
   453→	if state.TranscriptPath == "" {
   454→		return nil, errors.New("no transcript path in session state")
   455→	}
   456→
   457→	liveData, err := os.ReadFile(state.TranscriptPath)
   458→	if err != nil {
   459→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read live transcript: %w", err)
   460→	}
   461→
   462→	if len(liveData) == 0 {
   463→		return nil, errors.New("live transcript is empty")
   464→	}
   465→
   466→	fullTranscript := string(liveData)
   467→	data.Transcript = liveData
   468→	data.FullTranscriptLines = countTranscriptItems(state.AgentType, fullTranscript)
   469→	data.Prompts = extractUserPrompts(state.AgentType, fullTranscript)
   470→	data.Context = generateContextFromPrompts(data.Prompts)
   471→
   472→	// Extract files from transcript since state.FilesTouched may be empty for mid-session commits
   473→	// (no SaveStep/Stop has been called yet to populate it)
   474→	if len(state.FilesTouched) > 0 {
   475→		data.FilesTouched = state.FilesTouched
   476→	} else {
   477→		// Use the shared helper which includes subagent transcripts
   478→		data.FilesTouched = s.extractModifiedFilesFromLiveTranscript(state, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   479→	}
   480→
   481→	// Read export data from local metadata directory
   482→	metadataDir := paths.SessionMetadataDirFromSessionID(state.SessionID)
   483→	exportRelPath := metadataDir + "/" + paths.ExportDataFileName
   484→	if exportAbsPath, absErr := paths.AbsPath(exportRelPath); absErr == nil {
   485→		if exportBytes, readErr := os.ReadFile(exportAbsPath); readErr == nil && len(exportBytes) > 0 { //nolint:gosec // path from session metadata
   486→			data.ExportData = exportBytes
   487→		}
   488→	}
   489→
   490→	// Calculate token usage from the extracted transcript portion
   491→	if len(data.Transcript) > 0 {
   492→		data.TokenUsage = calculateTokenUsage(state.AgentType, data.Transcript, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   493→	}
   494→
   495→	return data, nil
   496→}
   497→
   498→// countTranscriptItems counts lines (JSONL) or messages (JSON) in a transcript.
   499→// For Claude Code and JSONL-based agents, this counts lines.
   500→// For Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and JSON-based agents, this counts messages.
   501→// Returns 0 if the content is empty or malformed.
   502→func countTranscriptItems(agentType agent.AgentType, content string) int {
   503→	if content == "" {
   504→		return 0
   505→	}
   506→
   507→	// OpenCode uses export JSON format with {"info": {...}, "messages": [...]}
   508→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeOpenCode {
   509→		session, err := opencode.ParseExportSession([]byte(content))
   510→		if err == nil && session != nil {
   511→			return len(session.Messages)
   512→		}
   513→		return 0
   514→	}
   515→
   516→	// Try Gemini format first if agentType is Gemini, or as fallback if Unknown
   517→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini || agentType == agent.AgentTypeUnknown {
   518→		transcript, err := geminicli.ParseTranscript([]byte(content))
   519→		if err == nil && transcript != nil && len(transcript.Messages) > 0 {
   520→			return len(transcript.Messages)
   521→		}
   522→		// If agentType is explicitly Gemini but parsing failed, return 0
   523→		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini {
   524→			return 0
   525→		}
   526→		// Otherwise fall through to JSONL parsing for Unknown type
   527→	}
   528→
   529→	// Claude Code and other JSONL-based agents
   530→	allLines := strings.Split(content, "\n")
   531→	// Trim trailing empty lines (from final \n in JSONL)
   532→	for len(allLines) > 0 && strings.TrimSpace(allLines[len(allLines)-1]) == "" {
   533→		allLines = allLines[:len(allLines)-1]
   534→	}
   535→	return len(allLines)
   536→}
   537→
   538→// extractUserPrompts extracts all user prompts from transcript content.
   539→// Returns prompts with IDE context tags stripped (e.g., <ide_opened_file>).
   540→func extractUserPrompts(agentType agent.AgentType, content string) []string {
   541→	if content == "" {
   542→		return nil
   543→	}
   544→
   545→	// OpenCode uses JSONL with a different per-line schema than Claude Code
   546→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeOpenCode {
   547→		prompts, err := opencode.ExtractAllUserPrompts([]byte(content))
   548→		if err == nil && len(prompts) > 0 {
   549→			cleaned := make([]string, 0, len(prompts))
   550→			for _, prompt := range prompts {
   551→				if stripped := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(prompt); stripped != "" {
   552→					cleaned = append(cleaned, stripped)
   553→				}
   554→			}
   555→			return cleaned
   556→		}
   557→		return nil
   558→	}
   559→
   560→	// Try Gemini format first if agentType is Gemini, or as fallback if Unknown
   561→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini || agentType == agent.AgentTypeUnknown {
   562→		prompts, err := geminicli.ExtractAllUserPrompts([]byte(content))
   563→		if err == nil && len(prompts) > 0 {
   564→			// Strip IDE context tags for consistency with Claude Code handling
   565→			cleaned := make([]string, 0, len(prompts))
   566→			for _, prompt := range prompts {
   567→				if stripped := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(prompt); stripped != "" {
   568→					cleaned = append(cleaned, stripped)
   569→				}
   570→			}
   571→			return cleaned
   572→		}
   573→		// If agentType is explicitly Gemini but parsing failed, return nil
   574→		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini {
   575→			return nil
   576→		}
   577→		// Otherwise fall through to JSONL parsing for Unknown type
   578→	}
   579→
   580→	// Claude Code and other JSONL-based agents
   581→	return extractUserPromptsFromLines(strings.Split(content, "\n"))
   582→}
   583→
   584→// calculateTokenUsage calculates token usage from raw transcript data.
   585→// startOffset is the line number (Claude Code) or message index (Gemini CLI)
   586→// where the current checkpoint began, allowing calculation for only the portion
   587→// of the transcript since the last checkpoint.
   588→func calculateTokenUsage(agentType agent.AgentType, data []byte, startOffset int) *agent.TokenUsage {
   589→	if len(data) == 0 {
   590→		return &agent.TokenUsage{}
   591→	}
   592→
   593→	// OpenCode uses JSONL with token info on assistant messages (different schema from Claude Code)
   594→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeOpenCode {
   595→		return opencode.CalculateTokenUsageFromBytes(data, startOffset)
   596→	}
   597→
   598→	// Try Gemini format first if agentType is Gemini, or as fallback if Unknown
   599→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini || agentType == agent.AgentTypeUnknown {
   600→		// Attempt to parse as Gemini JSON
   601→		transcript, err := geminicli.ParseTranscript(data)
   602→		if err == nil && transcript != nil && len(transcript.Messages) > 0 {
   603→			return geminicli.CalculateTokenUsage(data, startOffset)
   604→		}
   605→		// If agentType is explicitly Gemini but parsing failed, return empty usage
   606→		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini {
   607→			return &agent.TokenUsage{}
   608→		}
   609→		// Otherwise fall through to JSONL parsing for Unknown type
   610→	}
   611→
   612→	// Claude Code and other JSONL-based agents
   613→	lines, err := transcript.ParseFromBytes(data)
   614→	if err != nil || len(lines) == 0 {
   615→		return &agent.TokenUsage{}
   616→	}
   617→	// Slice transcript lines to only include checkpoint portion
   618→	if startOffset > 0 && startOffset < len(lines) {
   619→		lines = lines[startOffset:]
   620→	}
   621→	return claudecode.CalculateTokenUsage(lines)
   622→}
   623→
   624→// extractUserPromptsFromLines extracts user prompts from JSONL transcript lines.
   625→// IDE-injected context tags (like <ide_opened_file>) are stripped from the results.
   626→func extractUserPromptsFromLines(lines []string) []string {
   627→	var prompts []string
   628→	for _, line := range lines {
   629→		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
   630→		if line == "" {
   631→			continue
   632→		}
   633→
   634→		var entry map[string]interface{}
   635→		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &entry); err != nil {
   636→			continue
   637→		}
   638→
   639→		// Check for user message (supports both "human" and "user" types)
   640→		msgType, ok := entry["type"].(string)
   641→		if !ok || (msgType != "human" && msgType != "user") {
   642→			continue
   643→		}
   644→
   645→		// Extract message content
   646→		message, ok := entry["message"].(map[string]interface{})
   647→		if !ok {
   648→			continue
   649→		}
   650→
   651→		// Handle string content
   652→		if content, ok := message["content"].(string); ok && content != "" {
   653→			cleaned := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(content)
   654→			if cleaned != "" {
   655→				prompts = append(prompts, cleaned)
   656→			}
   657→			continue
   658→		}
   659→
   660→		// Handle array content (e.g., multiple text blocks from VSCode)
   661→		if arr, ok := message["content"].([]interface{}); ok {
   662→			var texts []string
   663→			for _, item := range arr {
   664→				if m, ok := item.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
   665→					if m["type"] == "text" {
   666→						if text, ok := m["text"].(string); ok {
   667→							texts = append(texts, text)
   668→						}
   669→					}
   670→				}
   671→			}
   672→			if len(texts) > 0 {
   673→				cleaned := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(strings.Join(texts, "\n\n"))
   674→				if cleaned != "" {
   675→					prompts = append(prompts, cleaned)
   676→				}
   677→			}
   678→		}
   679→	}
   680→	return prompts
   681→}
   682→
   683→// generateContextFromPrompts generates context.md content from a list of prompts.
   684→func generateContextFromPrompts(prompts []string) []byte {
   685→	if len(prompts) == 0 {
   686→		return nil
   687→	}
   688→
   689→	var buf strings.Builder
   690→	buf.WriteString("# Session Context\n\n")
   691→	buf.WriteString("## User Prompts\n\n")
   692→
   693→	for i, prompt := range prompts {
   694→		// Truncate very long prompts for readability
   695→		displayPrompt := prompt
   696→		if len(displayPrompt) > 500 {
   697→			displayPrompt = displayPrompt[:500] + "..."
   698→		}
   699→		buf.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("### Prompt %d\n\n", i+1))
   700→		buf.WriteString(displayPrompt)
   701→		buf.WriteString("\n\n")
   702→	}
   703→
   704→	return []byte(buf.String())
   705→}
   706→
   707→// CondenseSessionByID force-condenses a session by its ID and cleans up.
   708→// This is used by "entire doctor" to salvage stuck sessions.
   709→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CondenseSessionByID(sessionID string) error {
   710→	ctx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "condense-by-id")
   711→
   712→	// Load session state
   713→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   714→	if err != nil {
   715→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load session state: %w", err)
   716→	}
   717→	if state == nil {
   718→		return fmt.Errorf("session not found: %s", sessionID)
   719→	}
   720→
   721→	// Open repository
   722→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
   723→	if err != nil {
   724→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to open repository: %w", err)
   725→	}
   726→
   727→	// Generate a checkpoint ID
   728→	checkpointID, err := id.Generate()
   729→	if err != nil {
   730→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to generate checkpoint ID: %w", err)
   731→	}
   732→
   733→	// Check if shadow branch exists (required for condensation)
   734→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   735→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   736→	_, refErr := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   737→	hasShadowBranch := refErr == nil
   738→
   739→	if !hasShadowBranch {
   740→		// No shadow branch means no checkpoint data to condense.
   741→		// Just clean up the state file.
   742→		logging.Info(ctx, "no shadow branch for session, clearing state only",
   743→			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   744→			slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   745→		)
   746→		if err := s.clearSessionState(sessionID); err != nil {
   747→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to clear session state: %w", err)
   748→		}
   749→		return nil
   750→	}
   751→
   752→	// Condense the session
   753→	result, err := s.CondenseSession(repo, checkpointID, state, nil)
   754→	if err != nil {
   755→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to condense session: %w", err)
   756→	}
   757→
   758→	logging.Info(ctx, "session condensed by ID",
   759→		slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   760→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", result.CheckpointID.String()),
   761→		slog.Int("checkpoints_condensed", result.CheckpointsCount),
   762→	)
   763→
   764→	// Update session state: reset step count and transition to idle
   765→	state.StepCount = 0
   766→	state.CheckpointTranscriptStart = result.TotalTranscriptLines
   767→	state.Phase = session.PhaseIdle
   768→	state.LastCheckpointID = checkpointID
   769→	state.AttributionBaseCommit = state.BaseCommit
   770→	state.PromptAttributions = nil
   771→	state.PendingPromptAttribution = nil
   772→
   773→	if err := s.saveSessionState(state); err != nil {
   774→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save session state: %w", err)
   775→	}
   776→
   777→	// Clean up shadow branch if no other sessions need it
   778→	if err := s.cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused(repo, shadowBranchName, sessionID); err != nil {
   779→		logging.Warn(ctx, "failed to clean up shadow branch",
   780→			slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   781→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   782→		)
   783→		// Non-fatal: condensation succeeded, shadow branch cleanup is best-effort
   784→	}
   785→
   786→	return nil
   787→}
   788→
   789→// cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused deletes a shadow branch if no other active sessions reference it.
   790→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused(_ *git.Repository, shadowBranchName, excludeSessionID string) error {
   791→	// List all session states to check if any other session uses this shadow branch
   792→	allStates, err := s.listAllSessionStates()
   793→	if err != nil {
   794→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to list session states: %w", err)
   795→	}
   796→
   797→	for _, state := range allStates {
   798→		if state.SessionID == excludeSessionID {
   799→			continue
   800→		}
   801→		otherShadow := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   802→		if otherShadow == shadowBranchName && state.StepCount > 0 {
   803→			// Another session still needs this shadow branch
   804→			return nil
   805→		}
   806→	}
   807→
   808→	// No other sessions need it, delete the shadow branch via CLI
   809→	// (go-git v5's RemoveReference doesn't persist with packed refs/worktrees)
   810→	if err := DeleteBranchCLI(shadowBranchName); err != nil {
   811→		// Branch already gone is not an error
   812→		if errors.Is(err, ErrBranchNotFound) {
   813→			return nil
   814→		}
   815→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to remove shadow branch: %w", err)
   816→	}
   817→	return nil
   818→}

  "new_string": "// restoreSessionTranscriptFromStrategy restores a session transcript from checkpoint storage.\n// This is used for strategies that store transcripts in git branches rather than local files.\n// Returns the session ID that was actually used (may differ from input if checkpoint provides one).\nfunc restoreSessionTranscriptFromStrategy(cpID id.CheckpointID, sessionID string, agent agentpkg.Agent) (string, error) {\n\t// Get transcript content from checkpoint storage\n\tcontent, returnedSessionID, err := checkpoint.LookupSessionLog(cpID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", fmt.Errorf(\"failed to get session log: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\t// Use session ID returned from checkpoint if available\n\t// Otherwise fall back to the passed-in sessionID\n\tif returnedSessionID != \"\" {\n\t\tsessionID = returnedSessionID\n\t}\n\n\t// Use WriteSession which handles both file writing and native storage import\n\t// (e.g., SQLite for OpenCode). The transcript IS the export data — for agents\n\t// that need import (OpenCode), WriteSession uses ExportData; for others\n\t// (Claude, Gemini), WriteSession ignores it and just writes NativeData.\n\tsessionFile, err := resolveTranscriptPath(sessionID, agent)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", err\n\t}\n\tif err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(sessionFile), 0o750); err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", fmt.Errorf(\"failed to create agent session directory: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tagentSession := &agentpkg.AgentSession{\n\t\tSessionID:  sessionID,\n\t\tAgentName:  agent.Name(),\n\t\tSessionRef: sessionFile,\n\t\tNativeData: content,\n\t\tExportData: content,\n\t}\n\tif err := agent.WriteSession(agentSession); err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", fmt.Errorf(\"failed to write session: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\treturn sessionID, nil\n}"

- `manual_commit_condensation.go` — Removed export.json reading blocks and `ExportData` from `WriteCommitted` call

**Tests updated**:
- `agent_test.go` — Removed `ExportData` assertion (OpenCode's `ReadSession` still sets it, but the test was for behavior we didn't change)

   135→File: cmd/entire/cli/agent/opencode/lifecycle.go:135
   136→Author: cursor[bot]
   137→Body: ### Stale cached transcript returned on subsequent turns
   138→
   139→**High Severity**
   140→
   141→<!-- DESCRIPTION START -->
   142→`fetchAndCacheExport` checks if `.entire/tmp/<sessionID>.json` already exists and returns it immediately without calling `opencode export`. In a multi-turn session, the first TurnEnd writes the transcript, and every subsequent TurnEnd reuses that stale file because nothing deletes it between turns. The second turn's checkpoint would contain only the first turn's messages, silently losing transcript data. The "file already exists" shortcut was intended for integration tests but fires in production too.

Body: ## Pull request overview

This PR refactors OpenCode transcript handling to use OpenCode's native export JSON format instead of plugin-generated JSONL. The TypeScript plugin now only sends the session ID to hooks, and the Go handler calls `opencode export` directly to obtain the full transcript. This architectural change eliminates race conditions between plugin shutdown and hook execution, ensures full data fidelity, and captures complete context on each checkpoint (not just from the last prompt).

**Changes:**
- TypeScript plugin simplified to remove transcript generation logic and only send session_id
- Go lifecycle handler now calls `opencode export` and caches results in `.entire/tmp/`
- All OpenCode transcript parsing changed from JSONL line-by-line format to export JSON structure
- Added temp file cleanup to `entire clean` command
- Updated all tests to use export JSON format instead of JSONL

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 17 out of 17 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| cmd/entire/cli/agent/opencode/entire_plugin.ts | Removed transcript generation logic; plugin now only sends session_id |
| cmd/entire/cli/agent/opencode/lifecycle.go | Added fetchAndCacheExport to call `opencode export` and cache results |
| cmd/entire/cli/agent/opencode/types.go | Changed from JSONL Message type to export JSON ExportSession/ExportMessage types |
| cmd/entire/cli/agent/opencode/transcript.go | Replaced ParseMessages with ParseExportSession; added SliceFromMessage helper |
| cmd/entire/cli/agent/opencode/opencode.go | Implemented JSON-based ChunkTranscript/ReassembleTranscript |
| cmd/entire/cli/agent/opencode/cli_commands.go | Added runOpenCodeExport function |
| cmd/entire/cli/agent/opencode/*_test.go | Updated all tests to use export JSON format |
| cmd/entire/cli/lifecycle.go | Removed export JSON copy logic (no longer needed) |
| cmd/entire/cli/clean.go | Added temp file listing and deletion for .entire/tmp/ |
| cmd/entire/cli/clean_test.go | Updated test expectations and signatures |
| cmd/entire/cli/summarize/summarize.go | Updated buildCondensedTranscriptFromOpenCode for export JSON |
| cmd/entire/cli/strategy/manual_commit_condensation.go | Added OpenCode case for transcript scoping |
| cmd/entire/cli/integration_test/*.go | Updated all integration tests for export JSON format |
</details>

Here's a summary of the PR comments. They're all from automated bots (Copilot + Cursor Bugbot) — no human reviewer comments yet.

## High Severity (real bugs worth fixing)

1. **Stale cached transcript on subsequent turns** (`lifecycle.go:135`) — `fetchAndCacheExport` checks if `.entire/tmp/<sessionID>.json` exists and returns it immediately. In multi-turn sessions, the first TurnEnd writes the file and every subsequent TurnEnd reuses the stale data. This is a real bug.

2. **OpenCode message count uses wrong JSONL line counting** (`condensation.go:209`) — `countTranscriptItems` has no case for `AgentTypeOpenCode`, so it falls through to JSONL line counting. Since OpenCode transcripts are now a single JSON document, this returns line count instead of message count, breaking `CheckpointTranscriptStart`. Real bug.

3. **Silent data loss when messages fail to marshal** (`opencode.go:86`) — `ChunkTranscript` silently skips messages that fail `json.Marshal`. Should return an error instead of `continue`.

4. **Export data not validated before caching** (`lifecycle.go:142`) — `opencode export` output is written to disk without JSON validation. Corrupted data causes confusing errors later.

5. **Missing export.json write breaks resume/rewind** (`lifecycle.go:209`) — **Already fixed** by our current work (we removed the export.json indirection entirely). This comment is stale.

## Medium Severity

6. **SliceFromMessage silently fails on marshal error** (`transcript.go:70`) — Returns `nil` without error on marshal failure, causing silent no-summary.

7. **ReassembleTranscript returns (nil, nil)** (`opencode.go:125`) — Returns `(nil, nil)` for empty chunks, violating nilnil linter rule.

## Low Severity (style/quality, not bugs)

9. **Duplicated text extraction logic** (`summarize.go:225` / `transcript.go:230`)
10. **Unused partStore in TypeScript plugin** (`entire_plugin.ts:14`) — Dead code.
11. **Clean command deletes temp files without checking active sessions** (`clean.go:131`)
12. **Inconsistent RepoRoot error handling** (`lifecycle.go:59`)
13. **Test mock setup ignores errors** (`hooks.go:853`)

    55→		// Fallback to "." is acceptable - the file will still be written, just
    56→		// to current directory instead of .entire/tmp/.
    57→		repoRoot, _ := paths.RepoRoot() //nolint:errcheck // see comment above
    58→		tmpDir := filepath.Join(repoRoot, paths.EntireTmpDir)
    59→		transcriptPath := filepath.Join(tmpDir, raw.SessionID+".json")
    60→		return &agent.Event{
    61→			Type:       agent.TurnStart,
    62→			SessionID:  raw.SessionID,
    63→			SessionRef: transcriptPath,
    64→			Prompt:     raw.Prompt,
    65→			Timestamp:  time.Now(),
    66→		}, nil
    67→
    68→	case HookNameTurnEnd:
    69→		raw, err := agent.ReadAndParseHookInput[sessionInfoRaw](stdin)
    70→		if err != nil {
    71→			return nil, err
    72→		}
    73→		// Call `opencode export` to get the transcript and write to temp file
    74→		transcriptPath, exportErr := a.fetchAndCacheExport(raw.SessionID)
    75→		if exportErr != nil {
    76→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to export session: %w", exportErr)
    77→		}
    78→		return &agent.Event{
    79→			Type:       agent.TurnEnd,
    80→			SessionID:  raw.SessionID,
    81→			SessionRef: transcriptPath,
    82→			Timestamp:  time.Now(),
    83→		}, nil
    84→
    85→	case HookNameCompaction:
    86→		raw, err := agent.ReadAndParseHookInput[sessionInfoRaw](stdin)
    87→		if err != nil {
    88→			return nil, err
    89→		}
    90→		return &agent.Event{
    91→			Type:      agent.Compaction,
    92→			SessionID: raw.SessionID,
    93→			Timestamp: time.Now(),
    94→		}, nil
    95→
    96→	case HookNameSessionEnd:
    97→		raw, err := agent.ReadAndParseHookInput[sessionInfoRaw](stdin)
    98→		if err != nil {
    99→			return nil, err
   100→		}
   101→		return &agent.Event{
   102→			Type:      agent.SessionEnd,
   103→			SessionID: raw.SessionID,
   104→			Timestamp: time.Now(),
   105→		}, nil
   106→
   107→	default:
   108→		return nil, nil //nolint:nilnil // nil event = no lifecycle action for unknown hooks
   109→	}
   110→}
   111→
   112→// fetchAndCacheExport calls `opencode export <sessionID>` and writes the result
   113→// to a temporary file. Returns the path to the temp file.
   114→//
   115→// Integration testing: Set ENTIRE_TEST_OPENCODE_MOCK_EXPORT=1 to skip the
   116→// `opencode export` call and use pre-written mock data instead. Tests must
   117→// pre-write the transcript file to .entire/tmp/<sessionID>.json before
   118→// triggering the hook. See integration_test/hooks.go:SimulateOpenCodeTurnEnd.
   119→func (a *OpenCodeAgent) fetchAndCacheExport(sessionID string) (string, error) {
   120→	// Get repo root for the temp directory
   121→	repoRoot, err := paths.RepoRoot()
   122→	if err != nil {
   123→		repoRoot = "."
   124→	}
   125→
   126→	tmpDir := filepath.Join(repoRoot, paths.EntireTmpDir)
   127→	tmpFile := filepath.Join(tmpDir, sessionID+".json")
   128→
   129→	// Integration test mode: use pre-written mock file without calling opencode export
   130→	if os.Getenv("ENTIRE_TEST_OPENCODE_MOCK_EXPORT") != "" {
   131→		if _, err := os.Stat(tmpFile); err == nil {
   132→			return tmpFile, nil
   133→		}
   134→		return "", fmt.Errorf("mock export file not found: %s (ENTIRE_TEST_OPENCODE_MOCK_EXPORT is set)", tmpFile)
   135→	}
   136→
   137→	// Call opencode export to get the transcript (always refresh on each turn)
   138→	data, err := runOpenCodeExport(sessionID)
   139→	if err != nil {
   140→		return "", fmt.Errorf("opencode export failed: %w", err)
   141→	}
   142→
   143→	// Write to temp directory under .entire
   144→	if err := os.MkdirAll(tmpDir, 0o750); err != nil {
   145→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to create temp dir: %w", err)
   146→	}
   147→
   148→	if err := os.WriteFile(tmpFile, data, 0o600); err != nil {
   149→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to write export file: %w", err)
   150→	}
   151→
   152→	return tmpFile, nil
   153→}

    65→// ChunkTranscript splits an OpenCode export JSON transcript by distributing messages across chunks.
    66→// OpenCode uses JSON format with {"info": {...}, "messages": [...]} structure.
    67→func (a *OpenCodeAgent) ChunkTranscript(content []byte, maxSize int) ([][]byte, error) {
    68→	var session ExportSession
    69→	if err := json.Unmarshal(content, &session); err != nil {
    70→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse export session for chunking: %w", err)
    71→	}
    72→
    73→	if len(session.Messages) == 0 {
    74→		return [][]byte{content}, nil
    75→	}
    76→
    77→	var chunks [][]byte
    78→	var currentMessages []ExportMessage
    79→	currentSize := len(`{"info":{},"messages":[]}`) // Base JSON structure size
    80→
    81→	for _, msg := range session.Messages {
    82→		// Marshal message to get its size
    83→		msgBytes, err := json.Marshal(msg)
    84→		if err != nil {
    85→			continue
    86→		}
    87→		msgSize := len(msgBytes) + 1 // +1 for comma separator
    88→
    89→		if currentSize+msgSize > maxSize && len(currentMessages) > 0 {
    90→			// Save current chunk
    91→			chunkData, err := json.Marshal(ExportSession{Info: session.Info, Messages: currentMessages})
    92→			if err != nil {
    93→				return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal chunk: %w", err)
    94→			}
    95→			chunks = append(chunks, chunkData)
    96→
    97→			// Start new chunk
    98→			currentMessages = nil
    99→			currentSize = len(`{"info":{},"messages":[]}`)
   100→		}
   101→
   102→		currentMessages = append(currentMessages, msg)
   103→		currentSize += msgSize
   104→	}
   105→
   106→	// Add the last chunk
   107→	if len(currentMessages) > 0 {
   108→		chunkData, err := json.Marshal(ExportSession{Info: session.Info, Messages: currentMessages})
   109→		if err != nil {
   110→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal final chunk: %w", err)
   111→		}
   112→		chunks = append(chunks, chunkData)
   113→	}
   114→
   115→	if len(chunks) == 0 {
   116→		return nil, errors.New("failed to create any chunks")
   117→	}
   118→
   119→	return chunks, nil
   120→}
   121→
   122→// ReassembleTranscript merges OpenCode export JSON chunks by combining their message arrays.
   123→func (a *OpenCodeAgent) ReassembleTranscript(chunks [][]byte) ([]byte, error) {
   124→	if len(chunks) == 0 {
   125→		return nil, nil
   126→	}
   127→
   128→	var allMessages []ExportMessage
   129→	var sessionInfo SessionInfo
   130→
   131→	for i, chunk := range chunks {
   132→		var session ExportSession
   133→		if err := json.Unmarshal(chunk, &session); err != nil {
   134→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal chunk %d: %w", i, err)
   135→		}
   136→		if i == 0 {
   137→			sessionInfo = session.Info // Preserve session info from first chunk
   138→		}
   139→		allMessages = append(allMessages, session.Messages...)
   140→	}
   141→
   142→	result, err := json.Marshal(ExportSession{Info: sessionInfo, Messages: allMessages})
   143→	if err != nil {
   144→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal reassembled transcript: %w", err)
   145→	}
   146→	return result, nil
   147→}

   174→func (a *OpenCodeAgent) ReadSession(input *agent.HookInput) (*agent.AgentSession, error) {
   175→	if input.SessionRef == "" {
   176→		return nil, errors.New("no session ref provided")
   177→	}

   179→	if err != nil {

   184→	modifiedFiles, err := ExtractModifiedFiles(data)
   185→	if err != nil {
   186→		// Non-fatal: we can still return the session without modified files
   187→		modifiedFiles = nil
   188→	}
   189→
   190→	return &agent.AgentSession{
   191→		AgentName:     a.Name(),
   192→		SessionID:     input.SessionID,
   193→		SessionRef:    input.SessionRef,
   194→		NativeData:    data,
   195→		ExportData:    data, // Export JSON is both native and export format
   196→		ModifiedFiles: modifiedFiles,
   197→	}, nil
   198→}
   199→
   200→func (a *OpenCodeAgent) WriteSession(session *agent.AgentSession) error {
   201→	if session == nil {
   202→		return errors.New("nil session")
   203→	}
   204→	if session.SessionRef == "" {
   205→		return errors.New("no session ref to write to")
   206→	}
   207→	if len(session.NativeData) == 0 {
   208→		return errors.New("no session data to write")
   209→	}
   210→
   211→	// 1. Write export JSON file (for Entire's internal checkpoint use)
   212→	dir := filepath.Dir(session.SessionRef)
   213→	//nolint:gosec // G301: Session directory needs standard permissions
   214→	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
   215→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create session directory: %w", err)
   216→	}
   217→	if err := os.WriteFile(session.SessionRef, session.NativeData, 0o600); err != nil {
   218→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write session data: %w", err)
   219→	}
   220→
   221→	// 2. If we have export data, import the session into OpenCode.
   222→	//    This enables `opencode -s <id>` for both resume and rewind.
   223→	if len(session.ExportData) == 0 {
   224→		return nil // No export data — skip import (graceful degradation)
   225→	}
   226→
   227→	if err := a.importSessionIntoOpenCode(session.SessionID, session.ExportData); err != nil {
   228→		// Non-fatal: import is best-effort. The JSONL file is written,
   229→		// and the user can always run `opencode import <file>` manually.
   230→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "warning: could not import session into OpenCode: %v\n", err)
   231→	}
   232→
   233→	return nil
   234→}
   235→
   236→// importSessionIntoOpenCode writes the export JSON to a temp file and runs
   237→// `opencode import` to restore the session into OpenCode's database.
   238→// For rewind (session already exists), the session is deleted first so the
   239→// reimport replaces it with the checkpoint-state messages.
   240→func (a *OpenCodeAgent) importSessionIntoOpenCode(sessionID string, exportData []byte) error {
   241→	// Delete the session first so reimport replaces it cleanly.
   242→	// opencode import uses ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, so existing messages
   243→	// would be skipped without this step (breaking rewind).
   244→	// runOpenCodeSessionDelete treats "not found" as success.
   245→	if err := runOpenCodeSessionDelete(sessionID); err != nil {
   246→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to delete existing session: %w", err)
   247→	}
   248→
   249→	// Write export JSON to a temp file for opencode import
   250→	tmpFile, err := os.CreateTemp("", "entire-opencode-export-*.json")
   251→	if err != nil {
   252→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create temp file: %w", err)
   253→	}
   254→	defer os.Remove(tmpFile.Name())
   255→
   256→	if _, err := tmpFile.Write(exportData); err != nil {
   257→		_ = tmpFile.Close()
   258→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write export data: %w", err)
   259→	}
   260→	if err := tmpFile.Close(); err != nil {
   261→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to close temp file: %w", err)
   262→	}
   263→
   264→	return runOpenCodeImport(tmpFile.Name())
   265→}
   266→
   267→func (a *OpenCodeAgent) FormatResumeCommand(sessionID string) string {
   268→	if strings.TrimSpace(sessionID) == "" {
   269→		return "opencode"
   270→	}
   271→	return "opencode -s " + sessionID
   272→}
   273→
   274→// nonAlphanumericRegex matches any non-alphanumeric character.
   275→var nonAlphanumericRegex = regexp.MustCompile(`[^a-zA-Z0-9]`)
   276→
   277→// SanitizePathForOpenCode converts a path to a safe directory name.
   278→// Replaces any non-alphanumeric character with a dash (same approach as Claude/Gemini).
   279→func SanitizePathForOpenCode(path string) string {
   280→	return nonAlphanumericRegex.ReplaceAllString(path, "-")
   281→}

    19→// ParseExportSession parses export JSON content into an ExportSession structure.
    20→func ParseExportSession(data []byte) (*ExportSession, error) {
    21→	if len(data) == 0 {
    22→		return nil, nil //nolint:nilnil // nil for empty data is expected
    23→	}
    24→
    25→	var session ExportSession
    26→	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &session); err != nil {
    27→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse export session: %w", err)
    28→	}
    29→
    30→	return &session, nil
    31→}
    32→
    33→// parseExportSessionFromFile reads and parses an export JSON transcript file.
    34→func parseExportSessionFromFile(path string) (*ExportSession, error) {
    35→	data, err := os.ReadFile(path) //nolint:gosec // Path from agent hook
    36→	if err != nil {
    37→		return nil, err //nolint:wrapcheck // Callers check os.IsNotExist on this error
    38→	}
    39→	return ParseExportSession(data)
    40→}
    41→
    42→// SliceFromMessage returns an OpenCode export transcript scoped to messages starting from
    43→// startMessageIndex. This is the OpenCode equivalent of transcript.SliceFromLine —
    44→// for OpenCode's JSON format, scoping is done by message index rather than line offset.
    45→// Returns the original data if startMessageIndex <= 0.
    46→// Returns nil if startMessageIndex exceeds the number of messages.
    47→func SliceFromMessage(data []byte, startMessageIndex int) []byte {
    48→	if len(data) == 0 || startMessageIndex <= 0 {
    49→		return data
    50→	}
    51→
    52→	session, err := ParseExportSession(data)
    53→	if err != nil || session == nil {
    54→		return nil
    55→	}
    56→
    57→	if startMessageIndex >= len(session.Messages) {
    58→		return nil
    59→	}
    60→
    61→	scoped := &ExportSession{
    62→		Info:     session.Info,
    63→		Messages: session.Messages[startMessageIndex:],
    64→	}
    65→
    66→	out, err := json.Marshal(scoped)
    67→	if err != nil {
    68→		return nil
    69→	}
    70→	return out
    71→}
    72→
    73→// GetTranscriptPosition returns the number of messages in the transcript.
    74→func (a *OpenCodeAgent) GetTranscriptPosition(path string) (int, error) {
    75→	session, err := parseExportSessionFromFile(path)
    76→	if err != nil {
    77→		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
    78→			return 0, nil
    79→		}
    80→		return 0, err
    81→	}
    82→	if session == nil {
    83→		return 0, nil
    84→	}
    85→	return len(session.Messages), nil
    86→}

    88→// ExtractModifiedFilesFromOffset extracts files modified by tool calls from the given message offset.
    89→func (a *OpenCodeAgent) ExtractModifiedFilesFromOffset(path string, startOffset int) ([]string, int, error) {
    90→	session, err := parseExportSessionFromFile(path)
    91→	if err != nil {
    92→		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
    93→			return nil, 0, nil
    94→		}
    95→		return nil, 0, err
    96→	}
    97→	if session == nil {
    98→		return nil, 0, nil
    99→	}
   100→
   101→	seen := make(map[string]bool)
   102→	var files []string
   103→
   104→	for i := startOffset; i < len(session.Messages); i++ {
   105→		msg := session.Messages[i]
   106→		if msg.Info.Role != roleAssistant {
   107→			continue
   108→		}
   109→		for _, part := range msg.Parts {
   110→			if part.Type != "tool" || part.State == nil {
   111→				continue
   112→			}
   113→			if !slices.Contains(FileModificationTools, part.Tool) {
   114→				continue
   115→			}
   116→			filePath := extractFilePathFromInput(part.State.Input)
   117→			if filePath != "" && !seen[filePath] {
   118→				seen[filePath] = true
   119→				files = append(files, filePath)
   120→			}
   121→		}
   122→	}
   123→
   124→	return files, len(session.Messages), nil
   125→}

   127→// ExtractModifiedFiles extracts modified file paths from raw export JSON transcript bytes.
   128→// This is the bytes-based equivalent of ExtractModifiedFilesFromOffset, used by ReadSession.
   129→func ExtractModifiedFiles(data []byte) ([]string, error) {
   130→	session, err := ParseExportSession(data)
   131→	if err != nil {
   132→		return nil, err
   133→	}
   134→	if session == nil {
   135→		return nil, nil
   136→	}
   137→
   138→	seen := make(map[string]bool)
   139→	var files []string
   140→
   141→	for _, msg := range session.Messages {
   142→		if msg.Info.Role != roleAssistant {
   143→			continue
   144→		}
   145→		for _, part := range msg.Parts {
   146→			if part.Type != "tool" || part.State == nil {
   147→				continue
   148→			}
   149→			if !slices.Contains(FileModificationTools, part.Tool) {
   150→				continue
   151→			}
   152→			filePath := extractFilePathFromInput(part.State.Input)
   153→			if filePath != "" && !seen[filePath] {
   154→				seen[filePath] = true
   155→				files = append(files, filePath)
   156→			}
   157→		}
   158→	}
   159→
   160→	return files, nil
   161→}
   162→
   163→// extractFilePathFromInput extracts the file path from an OpenCode tool's input map.
   164→// OpenCode uses camelCase keys (e.g., "filePath"), with "path" as a fallback.
   165→func extractFilePathFromInput(input map[string]any) string {
   166→	for _, key := range []string{"filePath", "path"} {
   167→		if v, ok := input[key]; ok {
   168→			if s, ok := v.(string); ok && s != "" {
   169→				return s
   170→			}
   171→		}
   172→	}
   173→	return ""
   174→}

   176→// ExtractPrompts extracts user prompt strings from the transcript starting at the given offset.
   177→func (a *OpenCodeAgent) ExtractPrompts(sessionRef string, fromOffset int) ([]string, error) {
   178→	session, err := parseExportSessionFromFile(sessionRef)
   179→	if err != nil {
   180→		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   181→			return nil, nil
   182→		}
   183→		return nil, err
   184→	}
   185→	if session == nil {
   186→		return nil, nil
   187→	}
   188→
   189→	var prompts []string
   190→	for i := fromOffset; i < len(session.Messages); i++ {
   191→		msg := session.Messages[i]
   192→		if msg.Info.Role != roleUser {
   193→			continue
   194→		}
   195→		// Extract text from parts
   196→		content := extractTextFromParts(msg.Parts)
   197→		if content != "" {
   198→			prompts = append(prompts, content)
   199→		}
   200→	}
   201→
   202→	return prompts, nil
   203→}
   204→
   205→// ExtractSummary extracts the last assistant message content as a summary.
   206→func (a *OpenCodeAgent) ExtractSummary(sessionRef string) (string, error) {
   207→	session, err := parseExportSessionFromFile(sessionRef)
   208→	if err != nil {
   209→		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   210→			return "", nil
   211→		}
   212→		return "", err
   213→	}
   214→	if session == nil {
   215→		return "", nil
   216→	}
   217→
   218→	for i := len(session.Messages) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
   219→		msg := session.Messages[i]
   220→		if msg.Info.Role == roleAssistant {
   221→			content := extractTextFromParts(msg.Parts)
   222→			if content != "" {
   223→				return content, nil
   224→			}
   225→		}
   226→	}
   227→
   228→	return "", nil
   229→}
   230→
   231→// extractTextFromParts extracts text content from message parts.
   232→func extractTextFromParts(parts []Part) string {
   233→	var texts []string
   234→	for _, part := range parts {
   235→		if part.Type == "text" && part.Text != "" {
   236→			texts = append(texts, part.Text)
   237→		}
   238→	}
   239→	return strings.Join(texts, "\n")
   240→}
   241→
   242→// ExtractAllUserPrompts extracts all user prompts from raw export JSON transcript bytes.
   243→// This is a package-level function used by the condensation path.
   244→func ExtractAllUserPrompts(data []byte) ([]string, error) {
   245→	session, err := ParseExportSession(data)
   246→	if err != nil {
   247→		return nil, err
   248→	}
   249→	if session == nil {
   250→		return nil, nil
   251→	}
   252→
   253→	var prompts []string
   254→	for _, msg := range session.Messages {
   255→		if msg.Info.Role != roleUser {
   256→			continue
   257→		}
   258→		content := extractTextFromParts(msg.Parts)
   259→		if content != "" {
   260→			prompts = append(prompts, content)
   261→		}
   262→	}
   263→	return prompts, nil
   264→}
   265→
   266→// CalculateTokenUsageFromBytes computes token usage from raw export JSON transcript bytes
   267→// starting at the given message offset.
   268→// This is a package-level function used by the condensation path (which has bytes, not a file path).
   269→func CalculateTokenUsageFromBytes(data []byte, startMessageIndex int) *agent.TokenUsage {
   270→	session, err := ParseExportSession(data)
   271→	if err != nil || session == nil {
   272→		return &agent.TokenUsage{}
   273→	}
   274→
   275→	usage := &agent.TokenUsage{}
   276→	for i := startMessageIndex; i < len(session.Messages); i++ {
   277→		msg := session.Messages[i]
   278→		if msg.Info.Role != roleAssistant || msg.Info.Tokens == nil {
   279→			continue
   280→		}
   281→		usage.InputTokens += msg.Info.Tokens.Input
   282→		usage.OutputTokens += msg.Info.Tokens.Output
   283→		usage.CacheReadTokens += msg.Info.Tokens.Cache.Read
   284→		usage.CacheCreationTokens += msg.Info.Tokens.Cache.Write
   285→		usage.APICallCount++
   286→	}
   287→
   288→	return usage
   289→}
   290→
   291→// CalculateTokenUsage computes token usage from assistant messages starting at the given offset.
   292→func (a *OpenCodeAgent) CalculateTokenUsage(sessionRef string, fromOffset int) (*agent.TokenUsage, error) {
   293→	session, err := parseExportSessionFromFile(sessionRef)
   294→	if err != nil {
   295→		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   296→			return nil, nil //nolint:nilnil // nil usage for nonexistent file is expected
   297→		}
   298→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse transcript for token usage: %w", err)
   299→	}
   300→	if session == nil {
   301→		return nil, nil //nolint:nilnil // nil usage for empty file is expected
   302→	}
   303→
   304→	usage := &agent.TokenUsage{}
   305→	for i := fromOffset; i < len(session.Messages); i++ {
   306→		msg := session.Messages[i]
   307→		if msg.Info.Role != roleAssistant || msg.Info.Tokens == nil {
   308→			continue
   309→		}
   310→		usage.InputTokens += msg.Info.Tokens.Input
   311→		usage.OutputTokens += msg.Info.Tokens.Output
   312→		usage.CacheReadTokens += msg.Info.Tokens.Cache.Read
   313→		usage.CacheCreationTokens += msg.Info.Tokens.Cache.Write
   314→		usage.APICallCount++
   315→	}
   316→
   317→	return usage, nil
   318→}

     1→// Entire CLI plugin for OpenCode
     2→// Auto-generated by `entire enable --agent opencode`
     3→// Do not edit manually — changes will be overwritten on next install.
     4→// Requires Bun runtime (used by OpenCode's plugin system for loading ESM plugins).
     5→import type { Plugin } from "@opencode-ai/plugin"
     6→
     7→export const EntirePlugin: Plugin = async ({ $, directory }) => {
     8→  const ENTIRE_CMD = "__ENTIRE_CMD__"
     9→  // Track seen user messages to fire turn-start only once per message
    10→  const seenUserMessages = new Set<string>()
    11→  // Track current session ID for message events (which don't include sessionID)
    12→  let currentSessionID: string | null = null
    13→  // In-memory stores for message metadata
    14→  const messageStore = new Map<string, any>()
    15→  const partStore = new Map<string, any[]>()
    16→
    17→  /**
    18→   * Pipe JSON payload to an entire hooks command.
    19→   * Errors are logged but never thrown — plugin failures must not crash OpenCode.
    20→   */
    21→  async function callHook(hookName: string, payload: Record<string, unknown>) {
    22→    try {
    23→      const json = JSON.stringify(payload)
    24→      await $`echo ${json} | ${ENTIRE_CMD} hooks opencode ${hookName}`.quiet().nothrow()
    25→    } catch {
    26→      // Silently ignore — plugin failures must not crash OpenCode
    27→    }
    28→  }
    29→
    30→  return {
    31→    event: async ({ event }) => {
    32→      switch (event.type) {
    33→        case "session.created": {
    34→          const session = (event as any).properties?.info
    35→          if (!session?.id) break
    36→          currentSessionID = session.id
    37→          await callHook("session-start", {
    38→            session_id: session.id,
    39→          })
    40→          break
    41→        }
    42→
    43→        case "message.updated": {
    44→          const msg = (event as any).properties?.info
    45→          if (!msg) break
    46→          // Store message metadata (role, time, tokens, etc.)
    47→          messageStore.set(msg.id, msg)
    48→          break
    49→        }
    50→
    51→        case "message.part.updated": {
    52→          const part = (event as any).properties?.part
    53→          if (!part?.messageID) break
    54→
    55→          // Accumulate parts per message
    56→          const existing = partStore.get(part.messageID) ?? []
    57→          const idx = existing.findIndex((p: any) => p.id === part.id)
    58→          if (idx >= 0) {
    59→            existing[idx] = part
    60→          } else {
    61→            existing.push(part)
    62→          }
    63→          partStore.set(part.messageID, existing)
    64→
    65→          // Fire turn-start on the first text part of a new user message
    66→          const msg = messageStore.get(part.messageID)
    67→          if (msg?.role === "user" && part.type === "text" && !seenUserMessages.has(msg.id)) {
    68→            seenUserMessages.add(msg.id)
    69→            const sessionID = msg.sessionID ?? currentSessionID
    70→            if (sessionID) {
    71→              await callHook("turn-start", {
    72→                session_id: sessionID,
    73→                prompt: part.text ?? "",
    74→              })
    75→            }
    76→          }
    77→          break
    78→        }
    79→
    80→        case "session.idle": {
    81→          const sessionID = (event as any).properties?.sessionID
    82→          if (!sessionID) break
    83→          // Go hook handler will call `opencode export` to get the transcript
    84→          await callHook("turn-end", {
    85→            session_id: sessionID,
    86→          })
    87→          break
    88→        }
    89→
    90→        case "session.compacted": {
    91→          const sessionID = (event as any).properties?.sessionID
    92→          if (!sessionID) break
    93→          await callHook("compaction", {
    94→            session_id: sessionID,
    95→          })
    96→          break
    97→        }
    98→
    99→        case "session.deleted": {
   100→          const session = (event as any).properties?.info
   101→          if (!session?.id) break
   102→          seenUserMessages.clear()
   103→          messageStore.clear()
   104→          partStore.clear()
   105→          currentSessionID = null
   106→          await callHook("session-end", {
   107→            session_id: session.id,
   108→          })
   109→          break
   110→        }
   111→      }
   112→    },
   113→  }
   114→}

2. **ReassembleTranscript nil,nil** (`opencode.go:125`) — Returns error for empty chunks instead of `(nil, nil)` + updated test
3. **Chunk size calculation** (`opencode.go:79`) — Now marshals `session.Info` to calculate accurate base size
4. **Export JSON validation** (`lifecycle.go:142`) — Added `json.Valid()` check before writing to disk
5. **Unused partStore** (`entire_plugin.ts`) — Removed dead accumulation code
6. **Duplicated extractTextFromParts** — Exported `ExtractTextFromParts` from opencode package, removed duplicate from summarize package
7. **Inconsistent RepoRoot** (`lifecycle.go:57`) — Now uses `repoRoot = "."` fallback consistent with `fetchAndCacheExport`
8. **Test helper errors** (`hooks.go:853`) — Changed from silently ignoring errors to `t.Fatalf`

> AGENT

No model information is tracked anywhere. The answer is:

**No, we don't store the model used in session logs for any agent.**

Here's what each agent's transcript contains:

- **Claude Code** (JSONL): Each line has `type`, `uuid`, and `message` (which has `content` blocks and `usage` with token counts). No `model` field.
- **Gemini CLI** (JSON): Messages have `id`, `type`, `content`, and `tokens`. No `model` field.
- **OpenCode** (export JSON): Messages have `info` (role, tokens, cost) and `parts`. No `model` field.

The checkpoint metadata (`CheckpointInfo`, `SessionState`, etc.) tracks agent name (e.g. "Claude Code"), session IDs, timestamps, files touched, and token usage — but not which model was used (e.g. `claude-sonnet-4-5-20250514` vs `claude-opus-4-5-20250514`).

The model info *is* present in the raw transcripts though — Claude Code's JSONL includes `message.model` in assistant responses, and OpenCode's export JSON likely includes it per-message too. We just don't extract or store it.

Would you like me to look into what model data is available in the raw transcripts and whether we should extract/store it?

os.IsNotExist(err) {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"OpenCode database not found: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), timeout)\n\tdefer cancel()\n\n\t//nolint:gosec // G204: query is constructed from sanitized inputs (escapeSQLiteString)\n\tcmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, \"sqlite3\", dbPath, query)\n\toutput, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn output, fmt.Errorf(\"sqlite3 query failed: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\treturn output, nil\n}\n\n// deleteMessagesFromSQLite removes all messages (and cascading parts) for a session.\n// This is used before reimporting a session during rewind so that `opencode import`\n// can insert the checkpoint-state messages (import uses ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING).\nfunc deleteMessagesFromSQLite(sessionID string) error {\n\t// Enable foreign keys so CASCADE deletes work (parts are deleted with messages).\n\tquery := fmt.Sprintf(\n\t\t\"PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON; DELETE FROM message WHERE session_id = '%s';\",\n\t\tescapeSQLiteString(sessionID),\n\t)\n\tif output, err := runSQLiteQuery(query, 5*time.Second); err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"failed to delete messages from OpenCode DB: %w (output: %s)\", err, string(output))\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// escapeSQLiteString escapes single quotes in a string for safe use in SQLite queries.\nfunc escapeSQLiteString(s string) string {\n\tresult := make([]byte, 0, len(s))\n\tfor i := range len(s) {\n\t\tif s[i] == '\\'' {\n\t\t\tresult = append(result, '\\'', '\\'')\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tresult = append(result, s[i])\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn string(result)\n}\n"

   122→func resumeFromCurrentBranch(branchName string, force bool) error {
   123→	repo, err := openRepository()
   124→	if err != nil {
   125→		return fmt.Errorf("not a git repository: %w", err)
   126→	}
   127→
   128→	// Find a commit with an Entire-Checkpoint trailer, looking at branch-only commits
   129→	result, err := findBranchCheckpoint(repo, branchName)
   130→	if err != nil {
   131→		return err
   132→	}
   133→	if result.checkpointID.IsEmpty() {
   134→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "No Entire checkpoint found on branch '%s'\n", branchName)
   135→		return nil
   136→	}
   137→
   138→	// If there are newer commits without checkpoints, ask for confirmation.
   139→	// Merge commits (e.g., from merging main) don't count as "work" and are skipped silently.
   140→	if result.newerCommitsExist && !force {
   141→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Found checkpoint in an older commit.\n")
   142→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "There are %d newer commit(s) on this branch without checkpoints.\n", result.newerCommitCount)
   143→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Checkpoint from: %s %s\n\n", result.commitHash[:7], firstLine(result.commitMessage))
   144→
   145→		shouldResume, err := promptResumeFromOlderCheckpoint()
   146→		if err != nil {
   147→			return err
   148→		}
   149→		if !shouldResume {
   150→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Resume cancelled.\n")
   151→			return nil
   152→		}
   153→	}
   154→
   155→	checkpointID := result.checkpointID
   156→
   157→	// Get metadata branch tree for lookups
   158→	metadataTree, err := strategy.GetMetadataBranchTree(repo)
   159→	if err != nil {
   160→		// No local metadata branch, check if remote has it
   161→		return checkRemoteMetadata(repo, checkpointID)
   162→	}
   163→
   164→	// Look up metadata from sharded path
   165→	metadata, err := strategy.ReadCheckpointMetadata(metadataTree, checkpointID.Path())
   166→	if err != nil {
   167→		// Checkpoint exists in commit but no local metadata - check remote
   168→		return checkRemoteMetadata(repo, checkpointID)
   169→	}
   170→
   171→	return resumeSession(metadata.SessionID, checkpointID, force)
   172→}
