   174→// branchCheckpointResult contains the result of searching for a checkpoint on a branch.
   175→type branchCheckpointResult struct {
   176→	checkpointID      id.CheckpointID
   177→	commitHash        string
   178→	commitMessage     string
   179→	newerCommitsExist bool // true if there are branch-only commits (not merge commits) without checkpoints
   180→	newerCommitCount  int  // count of branch-only commits without checkpoints
   181→}
   182→
   183→// findBranchCheckpoint finds the most recent commit with an Entire-Checkpoint trailer
   184→// among commits that are unique to this branch (not reachable from the default branch).
   185→// This handles the case where main has been merged into the feature branch.
   186→func findBranchCheckpoint(repo *git.Repository, branchName string) (*branchCheckpointResult, error) {
   187→	result := &branchCheckpointResult{}
   188→
   189→	// Get HEAD commit
   190→	head, err := repo.Head()
   191→	if err != nil {
   192→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD: %w", err)
   193→	}
   194→
   195→	headCommit, err := repo.CommitObject(head.Hash())
   196→	if err != nil {
   197→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD commit: %w", err)
   198→	}
   199→
   200→	// First, check if HEAD itself has a checkpoint (most common case)
   201→	if cpID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(headCommit.Message); found {
   202→		result.checkpointID = cpID
   203→		result.commitHash = head.Hash().String()
   204→		result.commitMessage = headCommit.Message
   205→		result.newerCommitsExist = false
   206→		return result, nil
   207→	}
   208→
   209→	// HEAD doesn't have a checkpoint - find branch-only commits
   210→	// Get the default branch name
   211→	defaultBranch := getDefaultBranchFromRemote(repo)
   212→	if defaultBranch == "" {
   213→		// Fallback: try common names
   214→		for _, name := range []string{"main", "master"} {
   215→			if _, err := repo.Reference(plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(name), true); err == nil {
   216→				defaultBranch = name
   217→				break
   218→			}
   219→		}
   220→	}
   221→
   222→	// If we can't find a default branch, or we're on it, just walk all commits
   223→	if defaultBranch == "" || defaultBranch == branchName {
   224→		return findCheckpointInHistory(headCommit, nil), nil
   225→	}
   226→
   227→	// Get the default branch reference
   228→	defaultRef, err := repo.Reference(plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(defaultBranch), true)
   229→	if err != nil {
   230→		// Default branch doesn't exist locally, fall back to walking all commits
   231→		return findCheckpointInHistory(headCommit, nil), nil //nolint:nilerr // Intentional fallback
   232→	}
   233→
   234→	defaultCommit, err := repo.CommitObject(defaultRef.Hash())
   235→	if err != nil {
   236→		// Can't get default commit, fall back to walking all commits
   237→		return findCheckpointInHistory(headCommit, nil), nil //nolint:nilerr // Intentional fallback
   238→	}
   239→
   240→	// Find merge base
   241→	mergeBase, err := headCommit.MergeBase(defaultCommit)
   242→	if err != nil || len(mergeBase) == 0 {
   243→		// No common ancestor, fall back to walking all commits
   244→		return findCheckpointInHistory(headCommit, nil), nil //nolint:nilerr // Intentional fallback
   245→	}
   246→
   247→	// Walk from HEAD to merge base, looking for checkpoint
   248→	return findCheckpointInHistory(headCommit, &mergeBase[0].Hash), nil
   249→}
   250→
   251→// findCheckpointInHistory walks commit history from start looking for a checkpoint trailer.
   252→// If stopAt is provided, stops when reaching that commit (exclusive).
   253→// Returns the first checkpoint found and info about commits between HEAD and the checkpoint.
   254→// It distinguishes between merge commits (bringing in other branches) and regular commits
   255→// (actual branch work) to avoid false warnings after merging main.
   256→func findCheckpointInHistory(start *object.Commit, stopAt *plumbing.Hash) *branchCheckpointResult {
   257→	result := &branchCheckpointResult{}
   258→	branchWorkCommits := 0 // Regular commits without checkpoints (actual work)
   259→	const maxCommits = 100 // Limit search depth
   260→	totalChecked := 0
   261→
   262→	current := start
   263→	for current != nil && totalChecked < maxCommits {
   264→		// Stop if we've reached the boundary
   265→		if stopAt != nil && current.Hash == *stopAt {
   266→			break
   267→		}
   268→
   269→		// Check for checkpoint trailer
   270→		if cpID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(current.Message); found {
   271→			result.checkpointID = cpID
   272→			result.commitHash = current.Hash.String()
   273→			result.commitMessage = current.Message
   274→			// Only warn about branch work commits, not merge commits
   275→			result.newerCommitsExist = branchWorkCommits > 0
   276→			result.newerCommitCount = branchWorkCommits
   277→			return result
   278→		}
   279→
   280→		// Only count regular commits (not merge commits) as "branch work"
   281→		if current.NumParents() <= 1 {
   282→			branchWorkCommits++
   283→		}
   284→
   285→		totalChecked++
   286→
   287→		// Move to parent (first parent for merge commits - follows the main line)
   288→		if current.NumParents() == 0 {
   289→			break
   290→		}
   291→		parent, err := current.Parent(0)
   292→		if err != nil {
   293→			// Can't get parent, treat as end of history
   294→			break
   295→		}
   296→		current = parent
   297→	}
   298→
   299→	// No checkpoint found
   300→	return result
   301→}
   302→
   303→// promptResumeFromOlderCheckpoint asks the user if they want to resume from an older checkpoint.
   304→func promptResumeFromOlderCheckpoint() (bool, error) {
   305→	var confirmed bool
   306→
   307→	form := NewAccessibleForm(
   308→		huh.NewGroup(
   309→			huh.NewConfirm().
   310→				Title("Resume from this older checkpoint?").
   311→				Value(&confirmed),
   312→		),
   313→	)
   314→
   315→	if err := form.Run(); err != nil {
   316→		if errors.Is(err, huh.ErrUserAborted) {
   317→			return false, nil
   318→		}
   319→		return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to get confirmation: %w", err)
   320→	}
   321→
   322→	return confirmed, nil
   323→}

   325→// checkRemoteMetadata checks if checkpoint metadata exists on origin/entire/checkpoints/v1
   326→// and automatically fetches it if available.
   327→func checkRemoteMetadata(repo *git.Repository, checkpointID id.CheckpointID) error {
   328→	// Try to get remote metadata branch tree
   329→	remoteTree, err := strategy.GetRemoteMetadataBranchTree(repo)
   330→	if err != nil {
   331→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Checkpoint '%s' found in commit but session metadata not available\n", checkpointID)
   332→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "The entire/checkpoints/v1 branch may not exist locally or on the remote.\n")
   333→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Informational message, not a fatal error
   334→	}
   335→
   336→	// Check if the checkpoint exists on the remote
   337→	metadata, err := strategy.ReadCheckpointMetadata(remoteTree, checkpointID.Path())
   338→	if err != nil {
   339→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Checkpoint '%s' found in commit but session metadata not available\n", checkpointID)
   340→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Informational message, not a fatal error
   341→	}
   342→
   343→	// Metadata exists on remote but not locally - fetch it automatically
   344→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Fetching session metadata from origin...\n")
   345→	if err := FetchMetadataBranch(); err != nil {
   346→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Failed to fetch metadata: %v\n", err)
   347→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "You can try manually: git fetch origin entire/checkpoints/v1:entire/checkpoints/v1\n")
   348→		return NewSilentError(errors.New("failed to fetch metadata"))
   349→	}
   350→
   351→	// Now resume the session with the fetched metadata
   352→	return resumeSession(metadata.SessionID, checkpointID, false)
   353→}
   354→
   355→// resumeSession restores and displays the resume command for a specific session.
   356→// For multi-session checkpoints, restores ALL sessions and shows commands for each.
   357→// If force is false, prompts for confirmation when local logs have newer timestamps.
   358→func resumeSession(sessionID string, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, force bool) error {
   359→	// Read checkpoint metadata first to get agent type (matching rewind pattern)
   360→	repo, err := openRepository()
   361→	if err != nil {
   362→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to open repository: %w", err)
   363→	}
   364→
   365→	metadataTree, err := strategy.GetMetadataBranchTree(repo)
   366→	if err != nil {
   367→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get metadata branch: %w", err)
   368→	}
   369→
   370→	metadata, err := strategy.ReadCheckpointMetadata(metadataTree, checkpointID.Path())
   371→	if err != nil {
   372→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to read checkpoint metadata: %w", err)
   373→	}
   374→
   375→	// Resolve agent from checkpoint metadata (same as rewind)
   376→	ag, err := strategy.ResolveAgentForRewind(metadata.Agent)
   377→	if err != nil {
   378→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to resolve agent: %w", err)
   379→	}
   380→
   381→	// Initialize logging context with agent
   382→	ctx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "resume"), ag.Name())
   383→
   384→	logging.Debug(ctx, "resume session started",
   385→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   386→		slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   387→	)
   388→
   389→	// Get repo root for session directory lookup
   390→	repoRoot, err := paths.RepoRoot()
   391→	if err != nil {
   392→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get repository root: %w", err)
   393→	}
   394→
   395→	sessionDir, err := ag.GetSessionDir(repoRoot)
   396→	if err != nil {
   397→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to determine session directory: %w", err)
   398→	}
   399→
   400→	// Create directory if it doesn't exist
   401→	if err := os.MkdirAll(sessionDir, 0o700); err != nil {
   402→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create session directory: %w", err)
   403→	}
   404→
   405→	// Get strategy and restore sessions using full checkpoint data
   406→	strat := GetStrategy()
   407→
   408→	// Use RestoreLogsOnly via LogsOnlyRestorer interface for multi-session support
   409→	if restorer, ok := strat.(strategy.LogsOnlyRestorer); ok {
   410→		// Create a logs-only rewind point with Agent populated (same as rewind)
   411→		point := strategy.RewindPoint{
   412→			IsLogsOnly:   true,
   413→			CheckpointID: checkpointID,
   414→			Agent:        metadata.Agent,
   415→		}
   416→
   417→		sessions, restoreErr := restorer.RestoreLogsOnly(point, force)
   418→		if restoreErr != nil || len(sessions) == 0 {
   419→			// Fall back to single-session restore (e.g., old checkpoints without agent metadata)
   420→			return resumeSingleSession(ctx, ag, sessionID, checkpointID, repoRoot, force)
   421→		}
   422→
   423→		logging.Debug(ctx, "resume session completed",
   424→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   425→			slog.Int("session_count", len(sessions)),
   426→		)
   427→
   428→		// Print per-session resume commands using returned sessions
   429→		if len(sessions) > 1 {
   430→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "\nRestored %d sessions. To continue, run:\n", len(sessions))
   431→		} else if len(sessions) == 1 {
   432→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Session: %s\n", sessions[0].SessionID)
   433→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "\nTo continue this session, run:\n")
   434→		}
   435→		for i, sess := range sessions {
   436→			sessionAgent, err := strategy.ResolveAgentForRewind(sess.Agent)
   437→			if err != nil {
   438→				return fmt.Errorf("failed to resolve agent for session %s: %w", sess.SessionID, err)
   439→			}
   440→			cmd := sessionAgent.FormatResumeCommand(sess.SessionID)
   441→
   442→			if len(sessions) > 1 {
   443→				if i == len(sessions)-1 {
   444→					if sess.Prompt != "" {
   445→						fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  %s  # %s (most recent)\n", cmd, sess.Prompt)
   446→					} else {
   447→						fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  %s  # (most recent)\n", cmd)
   448→					}
   449→				} else {
   450→					if sess.Prompt != "" {
   451→						fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  %s  # %s\n", cmd, sess.Prompt)
   452→					} else {
   453→						fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  %s\n", cmd)
   454→					}
   455→				}
   456→			} else {
   457→				if sess.Prompt != "" {
   458→					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  %s  # %s\n", cmd, sess.Prompt)
   459→				} else {
   460→					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  %s\n", cmd)
   461→				}
   462→			}
   463→		}
   464→
   465→		return nil
   466→	}
   467→
   468→	// Strategy doesn't support LogsOnlyRestorer, fall back to single session
   469→	return resumeSingleSession(ctx, ag, sessionID, checkpointID, repoRoot, force)
   470→}
   471→
   472→// resumeSingleSession restores a single session (fallback when multi-session restore fails).
   473→// Always overwrites existing session logs to ensure consistency with checkpoint state.
   474→// If force is false, prompts for confirmation when local log has newer timestamps.
   475→func resumeSingleSession(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, sessionID string, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, repoRoot string, force bool) error {
   476→	sessionLogPath, err := resolveTranscriptPath(sessionID, ag)
   477→	if err != nil {
   478→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to resolve transcript path: %w", err)
   479→	}
   480→
   481→	if checkpointID.IsEmpty() {
   482→		logging.Debug(ctx, "resume session: empty checkpoint ID",
   483→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   484→		)
   485→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Session '%s' found in commit trailer but session log not available\n", sessionID)
   486→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "\nTo continue this session, run:\n")
   487→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  %s\n", ag.FormatResumeCommand(sessionID))
   488→		return nil
   489→	}
   490→
   491→	logContent, _, err := checkpoint.LookupSessionLog(checkpointID)
   492→	if err != nil {
   493→		if errors.Is(err, checkpoint.ErrCheckpointNotFound) || errors.Is(err, checkpoint.ErrNoTranscript) {
   494→			logging.Debug(ctx, "resume session completed (no metadata)",
   495→				slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   496→				slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   497→			)
   498→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Session '%s' found in commit trailer but session log not available\n", sessionID)
   499→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "\nTo continue this session, run:\n")
   500→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  %s\n", ag.FormatResumeCommand(sessionID))
   501→			return nil
   502→		}
   503→		logging.Error(ctx, "resume session failed",
   504→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   505→			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   506→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   507→		)
   508→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get session log: %w", err)
   509→	}
   510→
   511→	// Check if local file has newer timestamps than checkpoint
   512→	if !force {
   513→		localTime := paths.GetLastTimestampFromFile(sessionLogPath)
   514→		checkpointTime := paths.GetLastTimestampFromBytes(logContent)
   515→		status := strategy.ClassifyTimestamps(localTime, checkpointTime)
   516→
   517→		if status == strategy.StatusLocalNewer {
   518→			sessions := []strategy.SessionRestoreInfo{{
   519→				SessionID:      sessionID,
   520→				Status:         status,
   521→				LocalTime:      localTime,
   522→				CheckpointTime: checkpointTime,
   523→			}}
   524→			shouldOverwrite, promptErr := strategy.PromptOverwriteNewerLogs(sessions)
   525→			if promptErr != nil {
   526→				return fmt.Errorf("failed to get confirmation: %w", promptErr)
   527→			}
   528→			if !shouldOverwrite {
   529→				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Resume cancelled. Local session log preserved.\n")
   530→				return nil
   531→			}
   532→		}
   533→	}
   534→
   535→	// Ensure parent directory exists
   536→	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(sessionLogPath), 0o750); err != nil {
   537→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create session directory: %w", err)
   538→	}
   539→
   540→	// Create an AgentSession with the native data.
   541→	// The transcript IS the export data — for agents that need import (OpenCode),
   542→	// WriteSession uses ExportData; for others (Claude, Gemini), it's ignored.
   543→	agentSession := &agent.AgentSession{
   544→		SessionID:  sessionID,
   545→		AgentName:  ag.Name(),
   546→		RepoPath:   repoRoot,
   547→		SessionRef: sessionLogPath,
   548→		NativeData: logContent,
   549→		ExportData: logContent,
   550→	}
   551→
   552→	// Write the session using the agent's WriteSession method
   553→	if err := ag.WriteSession(agentSession); err != nil {
   554→		logging.Error(ctx, "resume session failed during write",
   555→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   556→			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   557→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   558→		)
   559→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write session: %w", err)
   560→	}
   561→
   562→	logging.Debug(ctx, "resume session completed",
   563→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   564→		slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   565→	)
   566→
   567→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Session restored to: %s\n", sessionLogPath)
   568→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Session: %s\n", sessionID)
   569→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "\nTo continue this session, run:\n")
   570→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  %s\n", ag.FormatResumeCommand(sessionID))
   571→
   572→	return nil
   573→}

   575→func promptFetchFromRemote(branchName string) (bool, error) {
   576→	var confirmed bool
   577→
   578→	form := NewAccessibleForm(
   579→		huh.NewGroup(
   580→			huh.NewConfirm().
   581→				Title(fmt.Sprintf("Branch '%s' not found locally. Fetch from origin?", branchName)).
   582→				Value(&confirmed),
   583→		),
   584→	)
   585→
   586→	if err := form.Run(); err != nil {
   587→		if errors.Is(err, huh.ErrUserAborted) {
   588→			return false, nil
   589→		}
   590→		return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to get confirmation: %w", err)
   591→	}
   592→
   593→	return confirmed, nil
   594→}

   596→// firstLine returns the first line of a string
   597→func firstLine(s string) string {
   598→	for i, c := range s {
   599→		if c == '\n' {
   600→			return s[:i]
   601→		}
   602→	}
   603→	return s
   604→}

   564→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) RestoreLogsOnly(point RewindPoint, force bool) ([]RestoredSession, error) {
   565→	if !point.IsLogsOnly {
   566→		return nil, errors.New("not a logs-only rewind point")
   567→	}
   568→
   569→	if point.CheckpointID.IsEmpty() {
   570→		return nil, errors.New("missing checkpoint ID")
   571→	}
   572→
   573→	// Get checkpoint store
   574→	store, err := s.getCheckpointStore()
   575→	if err != nil {
   576→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get checkpoint store: %w", err)
   577→	}
   578→
   579→	// Read checkpoint summary to get session count
   580→	summary, err := store.ReadCommitted(context.Background(), point.CheckpointID)
   581→	if err != nil {
   582→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read checkpoint: %w", err)
   583→	}
   584→	if summary == nil {
   585→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("checkpoint not found: %s", point.CheckpointID)
   586→	}
   587→
   588→	// Get repo root for agent session directory lookup
   589→	repoRoot, err := paths.RepoRoot()
   590→	if err != nil {
   591→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get repository root: %w", err)
   592→	}
   593→
   594→	// Check for newer local logs if not forcing
   595→	if !force {
   596→		sessions := s.classifySessionsForRestore(context.Background(), repoRoot, store, point.CheckpointID, summary)
   597→		hasConflicts := false
   598→		for _, sess := range sessions {
   599→			if sess.Status == StatusLocalNewer {
   600→				hasConflicts = true
   601→				break
   602→			}
   603→		}
   604→		if hasConflicts {
   605→			shouldOverwrite, promptErr := PromptOverwriteNewerLogs(sessions)
   606→			if promptErr != nil {
   607→				return nil, promptErr
   608→			}
   609→			if !shouldOverwrite {
   610→				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Resume cancelled. Local session logs preserved.\n")
   611→				return nil, nil
   612→			}
   613→		}
   614→	}
   615→
   616→	// Count sessions to restore
   617→	totalSessions := len(summary.Sessions)
   618→	if totalSessions > 1 {
   619→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Restoring %d sessions from checkpoint:\n", totalSessions)
   620→	}
   621→
   622→	// Restore all sessions (oldest to newest, using 0-based indexing)
   623→	var restored []RestoredSession
   624→	for i := range totalSessions {
   625→		content, readErr := store.ReadSessionContent(context.Background(), point.CheckpointID, i)
   626→		if readErr != nil {
   627→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  Warning: failed to read session %d: %v\n", i, readErr)
   628→			continue
   629→		}
   630→		if content == nil || len(content.Transcript) == 0 {
   631→			continue
   632→		}
   633→
   634→		sessionID := content.Metadata.SessionID
   635→		if sessionID == "" {
   636→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  Warning: session %d has no session ID, skipping\n", i)
   637→			continue
   638→		}
   639→
   640→		// Resolve per-session agent from metadata — skip if agent is unknown
   641→		if content.Metadata.Agent == "" {
   642→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  Warning: session %d (%s) has no agent metadata, skipping (cannot determine target directory)\n", i, sessionID)
   643→			continue
   644→		}
   645→		sessionAgent, agErr := ResolveAgentForRewind(content.Metadata.Agent)
   646→		if agErr != nil {
   647→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  Warning: session %d (%s) has unknown agent %q, skipping\n", i, sessionID, content.Metadata.Agent)
   648→			continue
   649→		}
   650→
   651→		// Compute transcript path from current repo location for cross-machine portability.
   652→		sessionAgentDir, dirErr := sessionAgent.GetSessionDir(repoRoot)
   653→		if dirErr != nil {
   654→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  Warning: failed to get session dir for session %d: %v\n", i, dirErr)
   655→			continue
   656→		}
   657→		sessionFile := sessionAgent.ResolveSessionFile(sessionAgentDir, sessionID)
   658→
   659→		// Get first prompt for display
   660→		promptPreview := ExtractFirstPrompt(content.Prompts)
   661→
   662→		if totalSessions > 1 {
   663→			isLatest := i == totalSessions-1
   664→			if promptPreview != "" {
   665→				if isLatest {
   666→					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  Session %d (latest): %s\n", i+1, promptPreview)
   667→				} else {
   668→					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  Session %d: %s\n", i+1, promptPreview)
   669→				}
   670→			}
   671→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "    Writing to: %s\n", sessionFile)
   672→		} else {
   673→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Writing transcript to: %s\n", sessionFile)
   674→		}
   675→
   676→		// Ensure parent directory exists (session file may be in a different dir than sessionAgentDir)
   677→		if mkdirErr := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(sessionFile), 0o750); mkdirErr != nil {
   678→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "    Warning: failed to create directory: %v\n", mkdirErr)
   679→			continue
   680→		}
   681→
   682→		agentSession := &agent.AgentSession{
   683→			SessionID:  sessionID,
   684→			AgentName:  sessionAgent.Name(),
   685→			RepoPath:   repoRoot,
   686→			SessionRef: sessionFile,
   687→			NativeData: content.Transcript,
   688→			ExportData: content.Transcript,
   689→		}
   690→		if writeErr := sessionAgent.WriteSession(agentSession); writeErr != nil {
   691→			if totalSessions > 1 {
   692→				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "    Warning: failed to write session: %v\n", writeErr)
   693→				continue
   694→			}
   695→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to write session: %w", writeErr)
   696→		}
   697→
   698→		restored = append(restored, RestoredSession{
   699→			SessionID: sessionID,
   700→			Agent:     sessionAgent.Type(),
   701→			Prompt:    promptPreview,
   702→		})
   703→	}
   704→
   705→	return restored, nil
   706→}
   707→
   708→// ResolveAgentForRewind resolves the agent from checkpoint metadata.
   709→// Falls back to the default agent (Claude) for old checkpoints that lack agent info.
   710→func ResolveAgentForRewind(agentType agent.AgentType) (agent.Agent, error) {
   711→	if !isSpecificAgentType(agentType) {
   712→		ag := agent.Default()
   713→		if ag == nil {
   714→			return nil, errors.New("no default agent registered")
   715→		}
   716→		return ag, nil
   717→	}
   718→	ag, err := agent.GetByAgentType(agentType)
   719→	if err != nil {
   720→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("resolving agent %q: %w", agentType, err)
   721→	}
   722→	return ag, nil
   723→}

   726→// Returns an empty string if the prompt cannot be read.
   727→func readSessionPrompt(repo *git.Repository, commitHash plumbing.Hash, metadataDir string) string {
   728→	// Get the commit and its tree
   729→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(commitHash)
   730→	if err != nil {
   731→		return ""
   732→	}

    26→func newResumeCmd() *cobra.Command {
    27→	var force bool
    28→
    29→	cmd := &cobra.Command{
    30→		Use:   "resume <branch>",
    31→		Short: "Switch to a branch and resume its session",
    32→		Long: `Switch to a local branch and resume the agent session from its last commit.
    33→
    34→This command:
    35→1. Checks out the specified branch
    36→2. Finds the session ID from commits unique to this branch (not on main)
    37→3. Restores the session log if it doesn't exist locally
    38→4. Shows the command to resume the session
    39→
    40→If the branch doesn't exist locally but exists on origin, you'll be prompted
    41→to fetch it.
    42→
    43→If newer commits without checkpoints exist on the branch (e.g., after merging main
    44→or cherry-picking from elsewhere), this operation will reset your Git status to the
    45→most recent commit with a checkpoint.  You'll be prompted to confirm resuming in this case.`,
    46→		Args: cobra.ExactArgs(1),
    47→		RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
    48→			if checkDisabledGuard(cmd.OutOrStdout()) {
    49→				return nil
    50→			}
    51→			return runResume(args[0], force)
    52→		},
    53→	}
    54→
    55→	cmd.Flags().BoolVarP(&force, "force", "f", false, "Resume from older checkpoint without confirmation")
    56→
    57→	return cmd
    58→}
    59→
    60→func runResume(branchName string, force bool) error {
    61→	// Check if we're already on this branch
    62→	currentBranch, err := GetCurrentBranch()
    63→	if err == nil && currentBranch == branchName {
    64→		// Already on the branch, skip checkout
    65→		return resumeFromCurrentBranch(branchName, force)
    66→	}
    67→
    68→	// Check if branch exists locally
    69→	exists, err := BranchExistsLocally(branchName)
    70→	if err != nil {
    71→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to check branch: %w", err)
    72→	}
    73→
    74→	if !exists {
    75→		// Branch doesn't exist locally, check if it exists on remote
    76→		remoteExists, err := BranchExistsOnRemote(branchName)
    77→		if err != nil {
    78→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to check remote branch: %w", err)
    79→		}
    80→
    81→		if !remoteExists {
    82→			return fmt.Errorf("branch '%s' not found locally or on origin", branchName)
    83→		}
    84→
    85→		// Ask user if they want to fetch from remote
    86→		shouldFetch, err := promptFetchFromRemote(branchName)
    87→		if err != nil {
    88→			return err
    89→		}
    90→		if !shouldFetch {
    91→			return nil
    92→		}
    93→
    94→		// Fetch and checkout the remote branch
    95→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Fetching branch '%s' from origin...\n", branchName)
    96→		if err := FetchAndCheckoutRemoteBranch(branchName); err != nil {
    97→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Failed to checkout branch: %v\n", err)
    98→			return NewSilentError(errors.New("failed to checkout branch"))
    99→		}
   100→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Switched to branch '%s'\n", branchName)
   101→	} else {
   102→		// Branch exists locally, check for uncommitted changes before checkout
   103→		hasChanges, err := HasUncommittedChanges()
   104→		if err != nil {
   105→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to check for uncommitted changes: %w", err)
   106→		}
   107→		if hasChanges {
   108→			return errors.New("you have uncommitted changes. Please commit or stash them first")
   109→		}
   110→
   111→		// Checkout the branch
   112→		if err := CheckoutBranch(branchName); err != nil {
   113→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Failed to checkout branch: %v\n", err)
   114→			return NewSilentError(errors.New("failed to checkout branch"))
   115→		}
   116→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Switched to branch '%s'\n", branchName)
   117→	}
   118→
   119→	return resumeFromCurrentBranch(branchName, force)
   120→}
   121→
   122→func resumeFromCurrentBranch(branchName string, force bool) error {
   123→	repo, err := openRepository()
   124→	if err != nil {
   125→		return fmt.Errorf("not a git repository: %w", err)
   126→	}
   127→
   128→	// Find a commit with an Entire-Checkpoint trailer, looking at branch-only commits
   129→	result, err := findBranchCheckpoint(repo, branchName)
   130→	if err != nil {
   131→		return err
   132→	}
   133→	if result.checkpointID.IsEmpty() {
   134→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "No Entire checkpoint found on branch '%s'\n", branchName)
   135→		return nil
   136→	}
   137→
   138→	// If there are newer commits without checkpoints, ask for confirmation.
   139→	// Merge commits (e.g., from merging main) don't count as "work" and are skipped silently.
   140→	if result.newerCommitsExist && !force {
   141→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Found checkpoint in an older commit.\n")
   142→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "There are %d newer commit(s) on this branch without checkpoints.\n", result.newerCommitCount)
   143→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Checkpoint from: %s %s\n\n", result.commitHash[:7], firstLine(result.commitMessage))
   144→
   145→		shouldResume, err := promptResumeFromOlderCheckpoint()
   146→		if err != nil {
   147→			return err
   148→		}
   149→		if !shouldResume {
   150→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Resume cancelled.\n")
   151→			return nil
   152→		}
   153→	}
   154→
   155→	checkpointID := result.checkpointID
   156→
   157→	// Get metadata branch tree for lookups
   158→	metadataTree, err := strategy.GetMetadataBranchTree(repo)
   159→	if err != nil {
   160→		// No local metadata branch, check if remote has it
   161→		return checkRemoteMetadata(repo, checkpointID)
   162→	}
   163→
   164→	// Look up metadata from sharded path
   165→	metadata, err := strategy.ReadCheckpointMetadata(metadataTree, checkpointID.Path())
   166→	if err != nil {
   167→		// Checkpoint exists in commit but no local metadata - check remote
   168→		return checkRemoteMetadata(repo, checkpointID)
   169→	}
   170→
   171→	return resumeSession(metadata.SessionID, checkpointID, force)
   172→}
   173→
   174→// branchCheckpointResult contains the result of searching for a checkpoint on a branch.
   175→type branchCheckpointResult struct {
   176→	checkpointID      id.CheckpointID
   177→	commitHash        string
   178→	commitMessage     string
   179→	newerCommitsExist bool // true if there are branch-only commits (not merge commits) without checkpoints
   180→	newerCommitCount  int  // count of branch-only commits without checkpoints
   181→}
   182→
   183→// findBranchCheckpoint finds the most recent commit with an Entire-Checkpoint trailer
   184→// among commits that are unique to this branch (not reachable from the default branch).
   185→// This handles the case where main has been merged into the feature branch.
   186→func findBranchCheckpoint(repo *git.Repository, branchName string) (*branchCheckpointResult, error) {
   187→	result := &branchCheckpointResult{}
   188→
   189→	// Get HEAD commit
   190→	head, err := repo.Head()
   191→	if err != nil {
   192→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD: %w", err)
   193→	}
   194→
   195→	headCommit, err := repo.CommitObject(head.Hash())
   196→	if err != nil {
   197→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD commit: %w", err)
   198→	}
   199→
   200→	// First, check if HEAD itself has a checkpoint (most common case)
   201→	if cpID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(headCommit.Message); found {
   202→		result.checkpointID = cpID
   203→		result.commitHash = head.Hash().String()
   204→		result.commitMessage = headCommit.Message
   205→		result.newerCommitsExist = false
   206→		return result, nil
   207→	}
   208→
   209→	// HEAD doesn't have a checkpoint - find branch-only commits
   210→	// Get the default branch name
   211→	defaultBranch := getDefaultBranchFromRemote(repo)
   212→	if defaultBranch == "" {
   213→		// Fallback: try common names
   214→		for _, name := range []string{"main", "master"} {
   215→			if _, err := repo.Reference(plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(name), true); err == nil {
   216→				defaultBranch = name
   217→				break
   218→			}
   219→		}
   220→	}
   221→
   222→	// If we can't find a default branch, or we're on it, just walk all commits
   223→	if defaultBranch == "" || defaultBranch == branchName {
   224→		return findCheckpointInHistory(headCommit, nil), nil
   225→	}
   226→
   227→	// Get the default branch reference
   228→	defaultRef, err := repo.Reference(plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(defaultBranch), true)
   229→	if err != nil {
   230→		// Default branch doesn't exist locally, fall back to walking all commits
   231→		return findCheckpointInHistory(headCommit, nil), nil //nolint:nilerr // Intentional fallback
   232→	}
   233→
   234→	defaultCommit, err := repo.CommitObject(defaultRef.Hash())
   235→	if err != nil {
   236→		// Can't get default commit, fall back to walking all commits
   237→		return findCheckpointInHistory(headCommit, nil), nil //nolint:nilerr // Intentional fallback
   238→	}
   239→
   240→	// Find merge base
   241→	mergeBase, err := headCommit.MergeBase(defaultCommit)
   242→	if err != nil || len(mergeBase) == 0 {
   243→		// No common ancestor, fall back to walking all commits
   244→		return findCheckpointInHistory(headCommit, nil), nil //nolint:nilerr // Intentional fallback
   245→	}
   246→
   247→	// Walk from HEAD to merge base, looking for checkpoint
   248→	return findCheckpointInHistory(headCommit, &mergeBase[0].Hash), nil
   249→}
   250→
   251→// findCheckpointInHistory walks commit history from start looking for a checkpoint trailer.
   252→// If stopAt is provided, stops when reaching that commit (exclusive).
   253→// Returns the first checkpoint found and info about commits between HEAD and the checkpoint.
   254→// It distinguishes between merge commits (bringing in other branches) and regular commits
   255→// (actual branch work) to avoid false warnings after merging main.
   256→func findCheckpointInHistory(start *object.Commit, stopAt *plumbing.Hash) *branchCheckpointResult {
   257→	result := &branchCheckpointResult{}
   258→	branchWorkCommits := 0 // Regular commits without checkpoints (actual work)
   259→	const maxCommits = 100 // Limit search depth
   260→	totalChecked := 0
   261→
   262→	current := start
   263→	for current != nil && totalChecked < maxCommits {
   264→		// Stop if we've reached the boundary
   265→		if stopAt != nil && current.Hash == *stopAt {
   266→			break
   267→		}
   268→
   269→		// Check for checkpoint trailer
   270→		if cpID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(current.Message); found {
   271→			result.checkpointID = cpID
   272→			result.commitHash = current.Hash.String()
   273→			result.commitMessage = current.Message
   274→			// Only warn about branch work commits, not merge commits
   275→			result.newerCommitsExist = branchWorkCommits > 0
   276→			result.newerCommitCount = branchWorkCommits
   277→			return result
   278→		}
   279→
   280→		// Only count regular commits (not merge commits) as "branch work"
   281→		if current.NumParents() <= 1 {
   282→			branchWorkCommits++
   283→		}
   284→
   285→		totalChecked++
   286→
   287→		// Move to parent (first parent for merge commits - follows the main line)
   288→		if current.NumParents() == 0 {
   289→			break
   290→		}
   291→		parent, err := current.Parent(0)
   292→		if err != nil {
   293→			// Can't get parent, treat as end of history
   294→			break
   295→		}
   296→		current = parent
   297→	}
   298→
   299→	// No checkpoint found
   300→	return result
   301→}

   325→// checkRemoteMetadata checks if checkpoint metadata exists on origin/entire/checkpoints/v1
   326→// and automatically fetches it if available.
   327→func checkRemoteMetadata(repo *git.Repository, checkpointID id.CheckpointID) error {
   328→	// Try to get remote metadata branch tree
   329→	remoteTree, err := strategy.GetRemoteMetadataBranchTree(repo)
   330→	if err != nil {
   331→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Checkpoint '%s' found in commit but session metadata not available\n", checkpointID)
   332→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "The entire/checkpoints/v1 branch may not exist locally or on the remote.\n")
   333→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Informational message, not a fatal error
   334→	}
   335→
   336→	// Check if the checkpoint exists on the remote
   337→	metadata, err := strategy.ReadCheckpointMetadata(remoteTree, checkpointID.Path())
   338→	if err != nil {
   339→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Checkpoint '%s' found in commit but session metadata not available\n", checkpointID)
   340→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Informational message, not a fatal error
   341→	}
   342→
   343→	// Metadata exists on remote but not locally - fetch it automatically
   344→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Fetching session metadata from origin...\n")
   345→	if err := FetchMetadataBranch(); err != nil {
   346→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Failed to fetch metadata: %v\n", err)
   347→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "You can try manually: git fetch origin entire/checkpoints/v1:entire/checkpoints/v1\n")
   348→		return NewSilentError(errors.New("failed to fetch metadata"))
   349→	}
   350→
   351→	// Now resume the session with the fetched metadata
   352→	return resumeSession(metadata.SessionID, checkpointID, false)
   353→}

   355→// resumeSession restores and displays the resume command for a specific session.
   356→// For multi-session checkpoints, restores ALL sessions and shows commands for each.
   357→// If force is false, prompts for confirmation when local logs have newer timestamps.
   358→func resumeSession(sessionID string, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, force bool) error {
   359→	// Read checkpoint metadata first to get agent type (matching rewind pattern)
   360→	repo, err := openRepository()
   361→	if err != nil {
   362→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to open repository: %w", err)
   363→	}
   364→
   365→	metadataTree, err := strategy.GetMetadataBranchTree(repo)
   366→	if err != nil {
   367→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get metadata branch: %w", err)
   368→	}
   369→
   370→	metadata, err := strategy.ReadCheckpointMetadata(metadataTree, checkpointID.Path())
   371→	if err != nil {
   372→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to read checkpoint metadata: %w", err)
   373→	}
   374→
   375→	// Resolve agent from checkpoint metadata (same as rewind)
   376→	ag, err := strategy.ResolveAgentForRewind(metadata.Agent)
   377→	if err != nil {
   378→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to resolve agent: %w", err)
   379→	}
   380→
   381→	// Initialize logging context with agent
   382→	ctx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "resume"), ag.Name())
   383→
   384→	logging.Debug(ctx, "resume session started",
   385→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   386→		slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   387→	)
   388→
   389→	// Get repo root for session directory lookup
   390→	repoRoot, err := paths.RepoRoot()
   391→	if err != nil {
   392→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get repository root: %w", err)
   393→	}
   394→
   395→	sessionDir, err := ag.GetSessionDir(repoRoot)
   396→	if err != nil {
   397→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to determine session directory: %w", err)
   398→	}
   399→
   400→	// Create directory if it doesn't exist
   401→	if err := os.MkdirAll(sessionDir, 0o700); err != nil {
   402→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create session directory: %w", err)
   403→	}
   404→
   405→	// Get strategy and restore sessions using full checkpoint data
   406→	strat := GetStrategy()
   407→
   408→	// Use RestoreLogsOnly via LogsOnlyRestorer interface for multi-session support
   409→	if restorer, ok := strat.(strategy.LogsOnlyRestorer); ok {
   410→		// Create a logs-only rewind point with Agent populated (same as rewind)
   411→		point := strategy.RewindPoint{
   412→			IsLogsOnly:   true,
   413→			CheckpointID: checkpointID,
   414→			Agent:        metadata.Agent,
   415→		}
   416→
   417→		sessions, restoreErr := restorer.RestoreLogsOnly(point, force)
   418→		if restoreErr != nil || len(sessions) == 0 {
   419→			// Fall back to single-session restore (e.g., old checkpoints without agent metadata)
   420→			return resumeSingleSession(ctx, ag, sessionID, checkpointID, repoRoot, force)
   421→		}
   422→
   423→		logging.Debug(ctx, "resume session completed",
   424→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   425→			slog.Int("session_count", len(sessions)),
   426→		)
   427→
   428→		// Print per-session resume commands using returned sessions
   429→		if len(sessions) > 1 {
   430→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "\nRestored %d sessions. To continue, run:\n", len(sessions))
   431→		} else if len(sessions) == 1 {
   432→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Session: %s\n", sessions[0].SessionID)
   433→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "\nTo continue this session, run:\n")
   434→		}
   435→		for i, sess := range sessions {
   436→			sessionAgent, err := strategy.ResolveAgentForRewind(sess.Agent)
   437→			if err != nil {
   438→				return fmt.Errorf("failed to resolve agent for session %s: %w", sess.SessionID, err)
   439→			}
   440→			cmd := sessionAgent.FormatResumeCommand(sess.SessionID)
   441→
   442→			if len(sessions) > 1 {
   443→				if i == len(sessions)-1 {
   444→					if sess.Prompt != "" {
   445→						fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  %s  # %s (most recent)\n", cmd, sess.Prompt)
   446→					} else {
   447→						fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  %s  # (most recent)\n", cmd)
   448→					}
   449→				} else {
   450→					if sess.Prompt != "" {
   451→						fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  %s  # %s\n", cmd, sess.Prompt)
   452→					} else {
   453→						fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  %s\n", cmd)
   454→					}
   455→				}
   456→			} else {
   457→				if sess.Prompt != "" {
   458→					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  %s  # %s\n", cmd, sess.Prompt)
   459→				} else {
   460→					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  %s\n", cmd)
   461→				}
   462→			}
   463→		}
   464→
   465→		return nil
   466→	}
   467→
   468→	// Strategy doesn't support LogsOnlyRestorer, fall back to single session
   469→	return resumeSingleSession(ctx, ag, sessionID, checkpointID, repoRoot, force)
   470→}
   471→
   472→// resumeSingleSession restores a single session (fallback when multi-session restore fails).
   473→// Always overwrites existing session logs to ensure consistency with checkpoint state.
   474→// If force is false, prompts for confirmation when local log has newer timestamps.
   475→func resumeSingleSession(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, sessionID string, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, repoRoot string, force bool) error {
   476→	sessionLogPath, err := resolveTranscriptPath(sessionID, ag)
   477→	if err != nil {
   478→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to resolve transcript path: %w", err)
   479→	}
   480→
   481→	if checkpointID.IsEmpty() {
   482→		logging.Debug(ctx, "resume session: empty checkpoint ID",
   483→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   484→		)
   485→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Session '%s' found in commit trailer but session log not available\n", sessionID)
   486→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "\nTo continue this session, run:\n")
   487→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  %s\n", ag.FormatResumeCommand(sessionID))
   488→		return nil
   489→	}
   490→
   491→	logContent, _, err := checkpoint.LookupSessionLog(checkpointID)
   492→	if err != nil {
   493→		if errors.Is(err, checkpoint.ErrCheckpointNotFound) || errors.Is(err, checkpoint.ErrNoTranscript) {
   494→			logging.Debug(ctx, "resume session completed (no metadata)",
   495→				slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   496→				slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   497→			)
   498→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Session '%s' found in commit trailer but session log not available\n", sessionID)
   499→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "\nTo continue this session, run:\n")
   500→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  %s\n", ag.FormatResumeCommand(sessionID))
   501→			return nil
   502→		}
   503→		logging.Error(ctx, "resume session failed",
   504→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   505→			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   506→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   507→		)
   508→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get session log: %w", err)
   509→	}
   510→
   511→	// Check if local file has newer timestamps than checkpoint
   512→	if !force {
   513→		localTime := paths.GetLastTimestampFromFile(sessionLogPath)
   514→		checkpointTime := paths.GetLastTimestampFromBytes(logContent)
   515→		status := strategy.ClassifyTimestamps(localTime, checkpointTime)
   516→
   517→		if status == strategy.StatusLocalNewer {
   518→			sessions := []strategy.SessionRestoreInfo{{
   519→				SessionID:      sessionID,
   520→				Status:         status,
   521→				LocalTime:      localTime,
   522→				CheckpointTime: checkpointTime,
   523→			}}
   524→			shouldOverwrite, promptErr := strategy.PromptOverwriteNewerLogs(sessions)
   525→			if promptErr != nil {
   526→				return fmt.Errorf("failed to get confirmation: %w", promptErr)
   527→			}
   528→			if !shouldOverwrite {
   529→				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Resume cancelled. Local session log preserved.\n")
   530→				return nil
   531→			}
   532→		}
   533→	}
   534→
   535→	// Ensure parent directory exists
   536→	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(sessionLogPath), 0o750); err != nil {
   537→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create session directory: %w", err)
   538→	}
   539→
   540→	// Create an AgentSession with the native data.
   541→	// The transcript IS the export data — for agents that need import (OpenCode),
   542→	// WriteSession uses ExportData; for others (Claude, Gemini), it's ignored.
   543→	agentSession := &agent.AgentSession{
   544→		SessionID:  sessionID,
   545→		AgentName:  ag.Name(),
   546→		RepoPath:   repoRoot,
   547→		SessionRef: sessionLogPath,
   548→		NativeData: logContent,
   549→		ExportData: logContent,
   550→	}
   551→
   552→	// Write the session using the agent's WriteSession method
   553→	if err := ag.WriteSession(agentSession); err != nil {
   554→		logging.Error(ctx, "resume session failed during write",
   555→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   556→			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   557→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   558→		)
   559→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write session: %w", err)
   560→	}
   561→
   562→	logging.Debug(ctx, "resume session completed",
   563→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   564→		slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   565→	)
   566→
   567→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Session restored to: %s\n", sessionLogPath)
   568→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Session: %s\n", sessionID)
   569→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "\nTo continue this session, run:\n")
   570→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  %s\n", ag.FormatResumeCommand(sessionID))
   571→
   572→	return nil
   573→}

   596→// firstLine returns the first line of a string
   597→func firstLine(s string) string {
   598→	for i, c := range s {
   599→		if c == '\n' {
   600→			return s[:i]
   601→		}
   602→	}
   603→	return s

   382→// writeCheckpointSummary writes the root-level CheckpointSummary with aggregated statistics.
   383→// sessions is the complete sessions array (already built by the caller).
   384→func (s *GitStore) writeCheckpointSummary(opts WriteCommittedOptions, basePath string, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry, sessions []SessionFilePaths) error {
   385→	checkpointsCount, filesTouched, tokenUsage, err :=
   386→		s.reaggregateFromEntries(basePath, len(sessions), entries)
   387→	if err != nil {
   388→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to aggregate session stats: %w", err)
   389→	}
   390→
   391→	summary := CheckpointSummary{
   392→		CheckpointID:     opts.CheckpointID,
   393→		CLIVersion:       buildinfo.Version,
   394→		Strategy:         opts.Strategy,
   395→		Branch:           opts.Branch,
   396→		CheckpointsCount: checkpointsCount,
   397→		FilesTouched:     filesTouched,
   398→		Sessions:         sessions,
   399→		TokenUsage:       tokenUsage,
   400→	}
   401→
   402→	metadataJSON, err := jsonutil.MarshalIndentWithNewline(summary, "", "  ")
   403→	if err != nil {
   404→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal checkpoint summary: %w", err)
   405→	}
   406→	metadataHash, err := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, metadataJSON)
   407→	if err != nil {
   408→		return err
   409→	}
   410→	entries[basePath+paths.MetadataFileName] = object.TreeEntry{
   411→		Name: basePath + paths.MetadataFileName,
   412→		Mode: filemode.Regular,
   413→		Hash: metadataHash,
   414→	}
   415→	return nil
   416→}

   114→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CondenseSession(repo *git.Repository, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, state *SessionState, committedFiles map[string]struct{}) (*CondenseResult, error) {
   115→	// Get shadow branch (may not exist for mid-session commits)
   116→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   117→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   118→	ref, err := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   119→	hasShadowBranch := err == nil
   120→
   121→	var sessionData *ExtractedSessionData
   122→	if hasShadowBranch {
   123→		// Extract session data from the shadow branch (with live transcript fallback).
   124→		// Use tracked files from session state instead of collecting all files from tree.
   125→		// Pass agent type to handle different transcript formats (JSONL for Claude, JSON for Gemini).
   126→		// Pass live transcript path so condensation reads the current file rather than a
   127→		// potentially stale shadow branch copy (SaveStep may have been skipped if the
   128→		// last turn had no code changes).
   129→		// Pass CheckpointTranscriptStart for accurate token calculation (line offset for Claude, message index for Gemini).
   130→		sessionData, err = s.extractSessionData(repo, ref.Hash(), state.SessionID, state.FilesTouched, state.AgentType, state.TranscriptPath, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   131→		if err != nil {
   132→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to extract session data: %w", err)
   133→		}
   134→	} else {
   135→		// No shadow branch: mid-session commit before Stop/SaveStep.
   136→		// Extract data directly from live transcript.
   137→		if state.TranscriptPath == "" {
   138→			return nil, errors.New("shadow branch not found and no live transcript available")
   139→		}
   140→		sessionData, err = s.extractSessionDataFromLiveTranscript(state)
   141→		if err != nil {
   142→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to extract session data from live transcript: %w", err)
   143→		}
   144→	}
   145→
   146→	// For 1:1 checkpoint model: filter files_touched to only include files actually
   147→	// committed in this specific commit. This ensures each checkpoint represents
   148→	// exactly the files in that commit, not all files mentioned in the transcript.
   149→	if len(committedFiles) > 0 {
   150→		// Track if we had files before filtering to distinguish between:
   151→		// - Session had files but none were committed (don't fallback)
   152→		// - Session had no files to begin with (mid-session commit, fallback OK)
   153→		hadFilesBeforeFiltering := len(sessionData.FilesTouched) > 0
   154→
   155→		if hadFilesBeforeFiltering {
   156→			// Filter to intersection of transcript-extracted files and committed files
   157→			filtered := make([]string, 0, len(sessionData.FilesTouched))
   158→			for _, f := range sessionData.FilesTouched {
   159→				if _, ok := committedFiles[f]; ok {
   160→					filtered = append(filtered, f)
   161→				}
   162→			}
   163→			sessionData.FilesTouched = filtered
   164→		}
   165→
   166→		// Only use committedFiles as fallback for genuine mid-session commits where
   167→		// no files were tracked yet (extraction returned empty). Do NOT fallback when
   168→		// the session had files that simply didn't overlap with the commit - that
   169→		// indicates an unrelated session that shouldn't have its files_touched
   170→		// overwritten with unrelated committed files.
   171→		if len(sessionData.FilesTouched) == 0 && !hadFilesBeforeFiltering {
   172→			sessionData.FilesTouched = make([]string, 0, len(committedFiles))
   173→			for f := range committedFiles {
   174→				sessionData.FilesTouched = append(sessionData.FilesTouched, f)
   175→			}
   176→		}
   177→	}
   178→
   179→	// Get checkpoint store
   180→	store, err := s.getCheckpointStore()
   181→	if err != nil {
   182→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get checkpoint store: %w", err)
   183→	}
   184→
   185→	// Get author info
   186→	authorName, authorEmail := GetGitAuthorFromRepo(repo)
   187→	// Calculate attribution. When no shadow branch exists (agent committed mid-turn
   188→	// before SaveStep), pass nil ref — the function uses HEAD as the shadow tree
   189→	// since the agent's commit IS HEAD (no user edits between agent work and commit).
   190→	attribution := calculateSessionAttributions(repo, ref, sessionData, state)
   191→	// Get current branch name
   192→	branchName := GetCurrentBranchName(repo)
   193→
   194→	// Generate summary if enabled
   195→	var summary *cpkg.Summary
   196→	if settings.IsSummarizeEnabled() && len(sessionData.Transcript) > 0 {
   197→		logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "attribution")
   198→		summarizeCtx := logging.WithComponent(logCtx, "summarize")
   199→
   200→		// Scope transcript to this checkpoint's portion.
   201→		// For Claude Code (JSONL), CheckpointTranscriptStart is a line offset.
   202→		// For Gemini/OpenCode (JSON), CheckpointTranscriptStart is a message index.
   203→		var scopedTranscript []byte
   204→		switch state.AgentType {
   205→		case agent.AgentTypeGemini:
   206→			scopedTranscript = geminicli.SliceFromMessage(sessionData.Transcript, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   207→		case agent.AgentTypeOpenCode:
   208→			scopedTranscript = opencode.SliceFromMessage(sessionData.Transcript, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   209→		case agent.AgentTypeClaudeCode, agent.AgentTypeUnknown:
   210→			scopedTranscript = transcript.SliceFromLine(sessionData.Transcript, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   211→		}
   212→		if len(scopedTranscript) > 0 {
   213→			var err error
   214→			summary, err = summarize.GenerateFromTranscript(summarizeCtx, scopedTranscript, sessionData.FilesTouched, state.AgentType, nil)
   215→			if err != nil {
   216→				logging.Warn(summarizeCtx, "summary generation failed",
   217→					slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   218→					slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   219→				// Continue without summary - non-blocking
   220→			} else {
   221→				logging.Info(summarizeCtx, "summary generated",
   222→					slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID))
   223→			}
   224→		}
   225→	}
   226→
   227→	// Write checkpoint metadata using the checkpoint store
   228→	if err := store.WriteCommitted(context.Background(), cpkg.WriteCommittedOptions{
   229→		CheckpointID:                checkpointID,
   230→		SessionID:                   state.SessionID,
   231→		Strategy:                    StrategyNameManualCommit,
   232→		Branch:                      branchName,
   233→		Transcript:                  sessionData.Transcript,
   234→		Prompts:                     sessionData.Prompts,
   235→		Context:                     sessionData.Context,
   236→		FilesTouched:                sessionData.FilesTouched,
   237→		CheckpointsCount:            state.StepCount,
   238→		EphemeralBranch:             shadowBranchName,
   239→		AuthorName:                  authorName,
   240→		AuthorEmail:                 authorEmail,
   241→		Agent:                       state.AgentType,
   242→		TurnID:                      state.TurnID,
   243→		TranscriptIdentifierAtStart: state.TranscriptIdentifierAtStart,
   244→		CheckpointTranscriptStart:   state.CheckpointTranscriptStart,
   245→		TokenUsage:                  sessionData.TokenUsage,
   246→		InitialAttribution:          attribution,
   247→		Summary:                     summary,
   248→	}); err != nil {
   249→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to write checkpoint metadata: %w", err)
   250→	}
   251→
   252→	return &CondenseResult{
   253→		CheckpointID:         checkpointID,
   254→		SessionID:            state.SessionID,
   255→		CheckpointsCount:     state.StepCount,
   256→		FilesTouched:         sessionData.FilesTouched,
   257→		TotalTranscriptLines: sessionData.FullTranscriptLines,
   258→	}, nil
   259→}

   261→func calculateSessionAttributions(repo *git.Repository, shadowRef *plumbing.Reference, sessionData *ExtractedSessionData, state *SessionState) *cpkg.InitialAttribution {
   262→	// Calculate initial attribution using accumulated prompt attribution data.
   263→	// This uses user edits captured at each prompt start (before agent works),
   264→	// plus any user edits after the final checkpoint (shadow → head).
   265→	//
   266→	// When shadowRef is nil (agent committed mid-turn before SaveStep),
   267→	// HEAD is used as the shadow tree. This is correct because the agent's
   268→	// commit IS HEAD — there are no user edits between agent work and commit.
   269→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "attribution")
   270→
   271→	headRef, headErr := repo.Head()
   272→	if headErr != nil {
   273→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get HEAD",
   274→			slog.String("error", headErr.Error()))
   275→		return nil
   276→	}
   277→
   278→	headCommit, commitErr := repo.CommitObject(headRef.Hash())
   279→	if commitErr != nil {
   280→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get HEAD commit",
   281→			slog.String("error", commitErr.Error()))
   282→		return nil
   283→	}
   284→
   285→	headTree, treeErr := headCommit.Tree()
   286→	if treeErr != nil {
   287→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get HEAD tree",
   288→			slog.String("error", treeErr.Error()))
   289→		return nil
   290→	}
   291→
   292→	// Get shadow tree: from shadow branch if available, otherwise HEAD (agent committed directly).
   293→	var shadowTree *object.Tree
   294→	if shadowRef != nil {
   295→		shadowCommit, shadowErr := repo.CommitObject(shadowRef.Hash())
   296→		if shadowErr != nil {
   297→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get shadow commit",
   298→				slog.String("error", shadowErr.Error()),
   299→				slog.String("shadow_ref", shadowRef.Hash().String()))
   300→			return nil
   301→		}
   302→		var shadowTreeErr error
   303→		shadowTree, shadowTreeErr = shadowCommit.Tree()
   304→		if shadowTreeErr != nil {
   305→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get shadow tree",
   306→				slog.String("error", shadowTreeErr.Error()))
   307→			return nil
   308→		}
   309→	} else {
   310→		// No shadow branch: agent committed mid-turn. Use HEAD as shadow
   311→		// because the agent's work is the commit itself.
   312→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution: using HEAD as shadow (no shadow branch)")
   313→		shadowTree = headTree
