  1644→// HandleTurnEnd dispatches strategy-specific actions emitted when an agent turn ends.
  1645→// The primary job is to finalize all checkpoints from this turn with the full transcript.
  1646→//
  1647→// During a turn, PostCommit writes provisional transcript data (whatever was available
  1648→// at commit time). HandleTurnEnd replaces that with the complete session transcript
  1649→// (from prompt to stop event), ensuring every checkpoint has the full context.
  1650→//
  1651→//nolint:unparam // error return required by interface but hooks must return nil
  1652→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) HandleTurnEnd(state *SessionState) error {
  1653→	// Finalize all checkpoints from this turn with the full transcript.
  1654→	//
  1655→	// IMPORTANT: This is best-effort - errors are logged but don't fail the hook.
  1656→	// Failing here would prevent session cleanup and could leave state inconsistent.
  1657→	// The provisional transcript from PostCommit is already persisted, so the
  1658→	// checkpoint isn't lost - it just won't have the complete transcript.
  1659→	errCount := s.finalizeAllTurnCheckpoints(state)
  1660→	if errCount > 0 {
  1661→		logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "checkpoint")
  1662→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "HandleTurnEnd completed with errors (best-effort)",
  1663→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
  1664→			slog.Int("error_count", errCount),
  1665→		)
  1666→	}
  1667→	return nil
  1668→}
  1669→
  1670→// finalizeAllTurnCheckpoints replaces the provisional transcript in each checkpoint
  1671→// created during this turn with the full session transcript.
  1672→//
  1673→// This is called at turn end (stop hook). During the turn, PostCommit wrote whatever
  1674→// transcript was available at commit time. Now we have the complete transcript and
  1675→// replace it so every checkpoint has the full prompt-to-stop context.
  1676→//
  1677→// Returns the number of errors encountered (best-effort: continues processing on error).
  1678→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) finalizeAllTurnCheckpoints(state *SessionState) int {
  1679→	if len(state.TurnCheckpointIDs) == 0 {
  1680→		return 0 // No mid-turn commits to finalize
  1681→	}
  1682→
  1683→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "checkpoint")
  1684→
  1685→	logging.Info(logCtx, "finalizing turn checkpoints with full transcript",
  1686→		slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
  1687→		slog.Int("checkpoint_count", len(state.TurnCheckpointIDs)),
  1688→	)
  1689→
  1690→	errCount := 0
  1691→
  1692→	// Read full transcript from live transcript file
  1693→	if state.TranscriptPath == "" {
  1694→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "finalize: no transcript path, skipping",
  1695→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
  1696→		)
  1697→		state.TurnCheckpointIDs = nil
  1698→		return 1 // Count as error - all checkpoints will be skipped
  1699→	}
  1700→
  1701→	fullTranscript, err := os.ReadFile(state.TranscriptPath)
  1702→	if err != nil || len(fullTranscript) == 0 {
  1703→		msg := "finalize: empty transcript, skipping"
  1704→		if err != nil {
  1705→			msg = "finalize: failed to read transcript, skipping"
  1706→		}
  1707→		logging.Warn(logCtx, msg,
  1708→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
  1709→			slog.String("transcript_path", state.TranscriptPath),
  1710→			slog.Any("error", err),
  1711→		)
  1712→		state.TurnCheckpointIDs = nil
  1713→		return 1 // Count as error - all checkpoints will be skipped
  1714→	}
  1715→
  1716→	// Extract prompts and context from the full transcript
  1717→	prompts := extractUserPrompts(state.AgentType, string(fullTranscript))
  1718→	contextBytes := generateContextFromPrompts(prompts)
  1719→
  1720→	// Redact secrets before writing — matches WriteCommitted behavior.
  1721→	// The live transcript on disk contains raw content; redaction must happen
  1722→	// before anything is persisted to the metadata branch.
  1723→	fullTranscript, err = redact.JSONLBytes(fullTranscript)
  1724→	if err != nil {
  1725→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "finalize: transcript redaction failed, skipping",
  1726→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
  1727→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
  1728→		)
  1729→		state.TurnCheckpointIDs = nil
  1730→		return 1 // Count as error - all checkpoints will be skipped
  1731→	}
  1732→	for i, p := range prompts {
  1733→		prompts[i] = redact.String(p)
  1734→	}
  1735→	contextBytes = redact.Bytes(contextBytes)
  1736→
  1737→	// Open repository and create checkpoint store
  1738→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
  1739→	if err != nil {
  1740→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "finalize: failed to open repository",
  1741→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
  1742→		)
  1743→		state.TurnCheckpointIDs = nil
  1744→		return 1 // Count as error - all checkpoints will be skipped
  1745→	}
  1746→	store := checkpoint.NewGitStore(repo)
  1747→
  1748→	// Update each checkpoint with the full transcript
  1749→	for _, cpIDStr := range state.TurnCheckpointIDs {
  1750→		cpID, parseErr := id.NewCheckpointID(cpIDStr)
  1751→		if parseErr != nil {
  1752→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "finalize: invalid checkpoint ID, skipping",
  1753→				slog.String("checkpoint_id", cpIDStr),
  1754→				slog.String("error", parseErr.Error()),
  1755→			)
  1756→			errCount++
  1757→			continue
  1758→		}
  1759→
  1760→		updateErr := store.UpdateCommitted(context.Background(), checkpoint.UpdateCommittedOptions{
  1761→			CheckpointID: cpID,
  1762→			SessionID:    state.SessionID,
  1763→			Transcript:   fullTranscript,
  1764→			Prompts:      prompts,
  1765→			Context:      contextBytes,
  1766→			Agent:        state.AgentType,
  1767→		})
  1768→		if updateErr != nil {
  1769→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "finalize: failed to update checkpoint",
  1770→				slog.String("checkpoint_id", cpIDStr),
  1771→				slog.String("error", updateErr.Error()),
  1772→			)
  1773→			errCount++
  1774→			continue
  1775→		}
  1776→
  1777→		logging.Info(logCtx, "finalize: checkpoint updated with full transcript",
  1778→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", cpIDStr),
  1779→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
  1780→		)
  1781→	}
  1782→
  1783→	// Clear turn checkpoint IDs. Do NOT update CheckpointTranscriptStart here — it was
  1784→	// already set correctly by PostCommit: condenseAndUpdateState sets it to the total
  1785→	// transcript lines when condensing, and carryForwardToNewShadowBranch resets it to 0
  1786→	// when carry-forward is active. Overwriting here would break carry-forward by making
  1787→	// sessionHasNewContent think the transcript is fully consumed (no growth).
  1788→	state.TurnCheckpointIDs = nil
  1789→
  1790→	return errCount
  1791→}

  1793→// filesChangedInCommit returns the set of files changed in a commit by diffing against its parent.
  1794→func filesChangedInCommit(commit *object.Commit) map[string]struct{} {
  1795→	result := make(map[string]struct{})
  1796→
  1797→	commitTree, err := commit.Tree()
  1798→	if err != nil {
  1799→		return result
  1800→	}
  1801→
  1802→	var parentTree *object.Tree
  1803→	if commit.NumParents() > 0 {
  1804→		parent, err := commit.Parent(0)
  1805→		if err != nil {
  1806→			return result
  1807→		}
  1808→		parentTree, err = parent.Tree()
  1809→		if err != nil {
  1810→			return result
  1811→		}
  1812→	}
  1813→
  1814→	if parentTree == nil {
  1815→		// Initial commit — all files are new
  1816→		if iterErr := commitTree.Files().ForEach(func(f *object.File) error {
  1817→			result[f.Name] = struct{}{}
  1818→			return nil
  1819→		}); iterErr != nil {
  1820→			return result
  1821→		}
  1822→		return result
  1823→	}
  1824→
  1825→	changes, err := parentTree.Diff(commitTree)
  1826→	if err != nil {
  1827→		return result
  1828→	}
  1829→	for _, change := range changes {
  1830→		name := change.To.Name
  1831→		if name == "" {
  1832→			name = change.From.Name
  1833→		}
  1834→		result[name] = struct{}{}
  1835→	}
  1836→	return result
  1837→}
  1838→
  1839→// subtractFiles returns files that are NOT in the exclude set.
  1840→func subtractFiles(files []string, exclude map[string]struct{}) []string {
  1841→	var remaining []string
  1842→	for _, f := range files {
  1843→		if _, excluded := exclude[f]; !excluded {
  1844→			remaining = append(remaining, f)
  1845→		}
  1846→	}
  1847→	return remaining
  1848→}
  1849→
  1850→// carryForwardToNewShadowBranch creates a new shadow branch at the current HEAD
  1851→// containing the remaining uncommitted files and all session metadata.
  1852→// This enables the next commit to get its own unique checkpoint.
  1853→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) carryForwardToNewShadowBranch(
  1854→	logCtx context.Context,
  1855→	repo *git.Repository,
  1856→	state *SessionState,
  1857→	remainingFiles []string,
  1858→) {
  1859→	store := checkpoint.NewGitStore(repo)
  1860→
  1861→	// Don't include metadata directory in carry-forward. The carry-forward branch
  1862→	// only needs to preserve file content for comparison - not the transcript.
  1863→	// Including the transcript would cause sessionHasNewContent to always return true
  1864→	// because CheckpointTranscriptStart is reset to 0 for carry-forward.
  1865→	result, err := store.WriteTemporary(context.Background(), checkpoint.WriteTemporaryOptions{
  1866→		SessionID:         state.SessionID,
  1867→		BaseCommit:        state.BaseCommit,
  1868→		WorktreeID:        state.WorktreeID,
  1869→		ModifiedFiles:     remainingFiles,
  1870→		MetadataDir:       "",
  1871→		MetadataDirAbs:    "",
  1872→		CommitMessage:     "carry forward: uncommitted session files",
  1873→		IsFirstCheckpoint: false,
  1874→	})
  1875→	if err != nil {
  1876→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "post-commit: carry-forward failed",
  1877→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
  1878→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
  1879→		)
  1880→		return
  1881→	}
  1882→	if result.Skipped {
  1883→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: carry-forward skipped (no changes)",
  1884→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
  1885→		)
  1886→		return
  1887→	}
  1888→
  1889→	// Update state for the carry-forward checkpoint.
  1890→	// CheckpointTranscriptStart = 0 is intentional: each checkpoint is self-contained with
  1891→	// the full transcript. This trades storage efficiency for simplicity:
  1892→	// - Pro: Each checkpoint is independently readable without needing to stitch together
  1893→	//   multiple checkpoints to understand the session history
  1894→	// - Con: For long sessions with multiple partial commits, each checkpoint includes
  1895→	//   the full transcript, which could be large
  1896→	// An alternative would be incremental checkpoints (only new content since last condensation),
  1897→	// but this would complicate checkpoint retrieval and require careful tracking of dependencies.
  1898→	state.StepCount = 1
  1899→	state.CheckpointTranscriptStart = 0
  1900→	state.LastCheckpointID = ""
  1901→	// NOTE: TurnCheckpointIDs is intentionally NOT cleared here. Those checkpoint
  1902→	// IDs from earlier in the turn still need finalization with the full transcript
  1903→	// when HandleTurnEnd runs at stop time.
  1904→
  1905→	logging.Info(logCtx, "post-commit: carried forward remaining files",
  1906→		slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
  1907→		slog.Int("remaining_files", len(remainingFiles)),
  1908→	)
  1909→}

   122→func resumeFromCurrentBranch(branchName string, force bool) error {
   123→	repo, err := openRepository()
   124→	if err != nil {
   125→		return fmt.Errorf("not a git repository: %w", err)
   126→	}
   127→
   128→	// Find a commit with an Entire-Checkpoint trailer, looking at branch-only commits
   129→	result, err := findBranchCheckpoint(repo, branchName)
   130→	if err != nil {
   131→		return err
   132→	}
   133→	if result.checkpointID.IsEmpty() {
   134→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "No Entire checkpoint found on branch '%s'\n", branchName)
   135→		return nil
   136→	}
   137→
   138→	// If there are newer commits without checkpoints, ask for confirmation.
   139→	// Merge commits (e.g., from merging main) don't count as "work" and are skipped silently.
   140→	if result.newerCommitsExist && !force {
   141→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Found checkpoint in an older commit.\n")
   142→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "There are %d newer commit(s) on this branch without checkpoints.\n", result.newerCommitCount)
   143→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Checkpoint from: %s %s\n\n", result.commitHash[:7], firstLine(result.commitMessage))
   144→
   145→		shouldResume, err := promptResumeFromOlderCheckpoint()
   146→		if err != nil {
   147→			return err
   148→		}
   149→		if !shouldResume {
   150→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Resume cancelled.\n")
   151→			return nil
   152→		}
   153→	}
   154→
   155→	checkpointID := result.checkpointID
   156→
   157→	// Get metadata branch tree for lookups
   158→	metadataTree, err := strategy.GetMetadataBranchTree(repo)

   333→// checkRemoteMetadata checks if checkpoint metadata exists on origin/entire/checkpoints/v1
   334→// and automatically fetches it if available.
   335→func checkRemoteMetadata(repo *git.Repository, checkpointID id.CheckpointID) error {
   336→	// Try to get remote metadata branch tree
   337→	remoteTree, err := strategy.GetRemoteMetadataBranchTree(repo)
   338→	if err != nil {
   339→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Checkpoint '%s' found in commit but session metadata not available\n", checkpointID)
   340→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "The entire/checkpoints/v1 branch may not exist locally or on the remote.\n")
   341→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Informational message, not a fatal error
   342→	}
   343→
   344→	// Check if the checkpoint exists on the remote
   345→	metadata, err := strategy.ReadCheckpointMetadata(remoteTree, checkpointID.Path())
   346→	if err != nil {
   347→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Checkpoint '%s' found in commit but session metadata not available\n", checkpointID)
   348→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Informational message, not a fatal error
   349→	}
   350→
   351→	// Metadata exists on remote but not locally - fetch it automatically
   352→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Fetching session metadata from origin...\n")
   353→	if err := FetchMetadataBranch(); err != nil {
   354→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Failed to fetch metadata: %v\n", err)
   355→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "You can try manually: git fetch origin entire/checkpoints/v1:entire/checkpoints/v1\n")
   356→		return NewSilentError(errors.New("failed to fetch metadata"))
   357→	}
   358→
   359→	// Now resume the session with the fetched metadata
   360→	return resumeSession(metadata.SessionID, checkpointID, false)
   361→}

   364→// For multi-session checkpoints, restores ALL sessions and shows commands for each.

+// findMainSessionIDs finds session IDs from the checkpoint at or before the merge base.
+// These sessions exist on the default branch and should be filtered out during resume.
+// Returns nil if no merge base or no checkpoint is found (graceful degradation).
+func findMainSessionIDs(repo *git.Repository, mergeBaseHash *plumbing.Hash, metadataTree *object.Tree) map[string]bool {
+	if mergeBaseHash == nil || metadataTree == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	// Walk from merge base looking for a checkpoint on main
+	mergeBaseCommit, err := repo.CommitObject(*mergeBaseHash)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	mainResult := findCheckpointInHistory(mergeBaseCommit, nil)
+	if mainResult.checkpointID.IsEmpty() {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	// Read checkpoint metadata to get session IDs
+	mainMetadata, err := strategy.ReadCheckpointMetadata(metadataTree, mainResult.checkpointID.Path())
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	sessionIDs := make(map[string]bool, len(mainMetadata.SessionIDs))
+	for _, sid := range mainMetadata.SessionIDs {
+		sessionIDs[sid] = true
+	}
+	// Also include the primary session ID (for single-session checkpoints where SessionIDs is empty)
+	if mainMetadata.SessionID != "" {
+		sessionIDs[mainMetadata.SessionID] = true
+	}
+	return sessionIDs

> AGENT

The changes look clean and well-scoped. Here's a summary of the two fixes:

**Bug 1: Sessions from main shown during resume**
- `findBranchCheckpoint` now returns the merge base hash
- New `findMainSessionIDs` helper walks from the merge base to find main's checkpoint and extracts its session IDs
- `resumeSession` filters out sessions whose IDs are in the main set before displaying results

**Bug 2: Wrong "most recent" ordering**
- Added `CreatedAt time.Time` to `RestoredSession`
- `RestoreLogsOnly` now populates `CreatedAt` from session metadata
- `resumeSession` sorts sessions by `CreatedAt` (ascending) so the truly most recent session is last and gets the "(most recent)" label

Both fixes are backward-compatible - `findMainSessionIDs` returns nil gracefully when there's no merge base or no main checkpoint, and the sort is stable when timestamps are equal (falls back to original order).

The most reliable signal is the transcript itself - we already use `paths.GetLastTimestampFromBytes()` elsewhere. Let me use that in `RestoreLogsOnly` since it already has the transcript content:

> AGENT

OpenCode messages have `Time` fields. And Gemini transcripts are also JSON. So `GetLastTimestampFromBytes` (JSONL-only) won't work universally. 

The simplest reliable approach: extract the last timestamp from the transcript content per-agent-type. But that adds complexity to `RestoreLogsOnly`. 

A cleaner approach: just use the transcript byte length as a tiebreaker when `CreatedAt` values are equal. The session with the most recent activity tends to have the longest transcript. But that's a heuristic.

Actually, the most robust option: let me add a generic `GetLastActivityTime` that works across formats.

No, we don't. `CommittedMetadata` only has `CreatedAt` (condensation time). `session.State` has `LastInteractionTime` but it's not persisted to checkpoint metadata.

For sessions from different commits, `CreatedAt` will differ and works fine for sorting. For sessions condensed in the same commit, they'll have roughly the same timestamp — but after filtering out main sessions (bug 1), that's the edge case of multiple concurrent branch sessions, which is rare.

The transcripts themselves have per-message timestamps but they're format-specific (JSONL for Claude, JSON with `time.created` for OpenCode, different for Gemini).

Do you want me to:
1. Keep `CreatedAt` as-is (good enough after the filtering fix)
2. Add a `LastActivity` field to `CommittedMetadata`, populated from the transcript's last message timestamp during condensation

   374→	env.GitAdd("orphan.txt")

   380→
   381→	// Switch to main

    65→func setupResumeTestRepo(t *testing.T, tmpDir string, createFeatureBranch bool) (*git.Repository, *git.Worktree, plumbing.Hash) {

    67→
    68→	repo, err := git.PlainInit(tmpDir, false)
    69→	if err != nil {

    72→

    74→	if err != nil {

    82→	if _, err := w.Add("test.txt"); err != nil {

    85→

    87→		Author: &object.Signature{
    88→			Name:  "Test User",
    89→			Email: "test@example.com",
    90→		},
    91→	})
    92→	if err != nil {
    93→		t.Fatalf("Failed to create initial commit: %v", err)
    94→	}
    95→
    96→	if createFeatureBranch {
    97→		featureRef := plumbing.NewHashReference(plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName("feature"), commit)
    98→		if err := repo.Storer.SetReference(featureRef); err != nil {
    99→			t.Fatalf("Failed to create feature branch: %v", err)
   100→		}
   101→	}
   102→
   103→	// Ensure entire/checkpoints/v1 branch exists
   104→	if err := strategy.EnsureMetadataBranch(repo); err != nil {
   105→		t.Fatalf("Failed to create metadata branch: %v", err)
   106→	}
   107→
   108→	return repo, w, commit
   109→}

    61→func runResume(branchName string, force bool) error {
    62→	// Check if we're already on this branch

    65→		// Already on the branch, skip checkout
    66→		return resumeFromCurrentBranch(branchName, force)
    67→	}
    68→
    69→	// Check if branch exists locally
    70→	exists, err := BranchExistsLocally(branchName)
    71→	if err != nil {
    72→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to check branch: %w", err)
    73→	}
    74→
    75→	if !exists {
    76→		// Branch doesn't exist locally, check if it exists on remote
    77→		remoteExists, err := BranchExistsOnRemote(branchName)
    78→		if err != nil {
    79→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to check remote branch: %w", err)
    80→		}
    81→
    82→		if !remoteExists {
    83→			return fmt.Errorf("branch '%s' not found locally or on origin", branchName)
    84→		}
    85→

    87→		shouldFetch, err := promptFetchFromRemote(branchName)
    88→		if err != nil {
    89→			return err
    90→		}

    92→			return nil
    93→		}
    94→

    96→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Fetching branch '%s' from origin...\n", branchName)
    97→		if err := FetchAndCheckoutRemoteBranch(branchName); err != nil {
    98→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Failed to checkout branch: %v\n", err)
    99→			return NewSilentError(errors.New("failed to checkout branch"))
   100→		}
   101→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Switched to branch '%s'\n", branchName)
   102→	} else {
   103→		// Branch exists locally, check for uncommitted changes before checkout
   104→		hasChanges, err := HasUncommittedChanges()
   105→		if err != nil {

   107→		}

   118→	}

   123→func resumeFromCurrentBranch(branchName string, force bool) error {
   124→	repo, err := openRepository()
   125→	if err != nil {
   126→		return fmt.Errorf("not a git repository: %w", err)
   127→	}
   128→
   129→	// Find a commit with an Entire-Checkpoint trailer, looking at branch-only commits
   130→	result, err := findBranchCheckpoint(repo, branchName)
   131→	if err != nil {
   132→		return err
   133→	}
   134→	if result.checkpointID.IsEmpty() {
   135→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "No Entire checkpoint found on branch '%s'\n", branchName)
   136→		return nil
   137→	}
   138→
   139→	// If there are newer commits without checkpoints, ask for confirmation.
   140→	// Merge commits (e.g., from merging main) don't count as "work" and are skipped silently.
   141→	if result.newerCommitsExist && !force {
   142→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Found checkpoint in an older commit.\n")
   143→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "There are %d newer commit(s) on this branch without checkpoints.\n", result.newerCommitCount)
   144→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Checkpoint from: %s %s\n\n", result.commitHash[:7], firstLine(result.commitMessage))
   145→
   146→		shouldResume, err := promptResumeFromOlderCheckpoint()
   147→		if err != nil {
   148→			return err
   149→		}
   150→		if !shouldResume {
   151→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Resume cancelled.\n")
   152→			return nil
   153→		}
   154→	}
   155→
   156→	checkpointID := result.checkpointID
   157→
   158→	// Get metadata branch tree for lookups
   159→	metadataTree, err := strategy.GetMetadataBranchTree(repo)
   160→	if err != nil {
   161→		// No local metadata branch, check if remote has it
   162→		return checkRemoteMetadata(repo, checkpointID)
   163→	}
   164→
   165→	// Look up metadata from sharded path
   166→	metadata, err := strategy.ReadCheckpointMetadata(metadataTree, checkpointID.Path())
   167→	if err != nil {
   168→		// Checkpoint exists in commit but no local metadata - check remote
   169→		return checkRemoteMetadata(repo, checkpointID)
   170→	}
   171→
   172→	// Find session IDs from main's checkpoint so we can filter them out during resume.
   173→	// Sessions that exist in a checkpoint reachable from the merge base are "from main"
   174→	// and should not be offered for resume on this branch.
   175→	mainSessionIDs := findMainSessionIDs(repo, result.mergeBaseHash, metadataTree)
   176→
   177→	return resumeSession(metadata.SessionID, checkpointID, force, mainSessionIDs)
   178→}

   180→// branchCheckpointResult contains the result of searching for a checkpoint on a branch.
   181→type branchCheckpointResult struct {
   182→	checkpointID      id.CheckpointID
   183→	commitHash        string
   184→	commitMessage     string
   185→	newerCommitsExist bool           // true if there are branch-only commits (not merge commits) without checkpoints
   186→	newerCommitCount  int            // count of branch-only commits without checkpoints
   187→	mergeBaseHash     *plumbing.Hash // merge base with default branch; nil if no merge base found
   188→}
   189→
   190→// findBranchCheckpoint finds the most recent commit with an Entire-Checkpoint trailer
   191→// among commits that are unique to this branch (not reachable from the default branch).
   192→// This handles the case where main has been merged into the feature branch.
   193→func findBranchCheckpoint(repo *git.Repository, branchName string) (*branchCheckpointResult, error) {
   194→	result := &branchCheckpointResult{}
   195→
   196→	// Get HEAD commit
   197→	head, err := repo.Head()
   198→	if err != nil {
   199→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD: %w", err)
   200→	}
   201→
   202→	headCommit, err := repo.CommitObject(head.Hash())
   203→	if err != nil {
   204→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD commit: %w", err)
   205→	}
   206→
   207→	// Compute merge base with the default branch (needed for session filtering in resume).
   208→	// This is done before the HEAD fast-path because the merge base is needed even when
   209→	// HEAD itself has the checkpoint.
   210→	defaultBranch := getDefaultBranchFromRemote(repo)
   211→	if defaultBranch == "" {
   212→		// Fallback: try common names
   213→		for _, name := range []string{"main", "master"} {
   214→			if _, err := repo.Reference(plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(name), true); err == nil {
   215→				defaultBranch = name
   216→				break
   217→			}
   218→		}
   219→	}
   220→
   221→	// Compute merge base hash (best-effort, nil if unavailable)
   222→	var mergeBaseHash *plumbing.Hash
   223→	if defaultBranch != "" && defaultBranch != branchName {
   224→		if defaultRef, err := repo.Reference(plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(defaultBranch), true); err == nil {
   225→			if defaultCommit, err := repo.CommitObject(defaultRef.Hash()); err == nil {
   226→				if mergeBase, err := headCommit.MergeBase(defaultCommit); err == nil && len(mergeBase) > 0 {
   227→					mergeBaseHash = &mergeBase[0].Hash
   228→				}
   229→			}
   230→		}
   231→	}
   232→
   233→	// First, check if HEAD itself has a checkpoint (most common case)
   234→	if cpID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(headCommit.Message); found {
   235→		result.checkpointID = cpID
   236→		result.commitHash = head.Hash().String()
   237→		result.commitMessage = headCommit.Message
   238→		result.newerCommitsExist = false
   239→		result.mergeBaseHash = mergeBaseHash
   240→		return result, nil
   241→	}
   242→
   243→	// HEAD doesn't have a checkpoint - find branch-only commits
   244→	// If we can't find a default branch, or we're on it, just walk all commits
   245→	if defaultBranch == "" || defaultBranch == branchName {
   246→		return findCheckpointInHistory(headCommit, nil), nil
   247→	}
   248→
   249→	if mergeBaseHash == nil {
   250→		// No merge base found, fall back to walking all commits
   251→		return findCheckpointInHistory(headCommit, nil), nil
   252→	}
   253→
   254→	// Walk from HEAD to merge base, looking for checkpoint
   255→	result = findCheckpointInHistory(headCommit, mergeBaseHash)
   256→	result.mergeBaseHash = mergeBaseHash
   257→	return result, nil
   258→}
   259→
   260→// findCheckpointInHistory walks commit history from start looking for a checkpoint trailer.
   261→// If stopAt is provided, stops when reaching that commit (exclusive).
   262→// Returns the first checkpoint found and info about commits between HEAD and the checkpoint.
   263→// It distinguishes between merge commits (bringing in other branches) and regular commits
   264→// (actual branch work) to avoid false warnings after merging main.
   265→func findCheckpointInHistory(start *object.Commit, stopAt *plumbing.Hash) *branchCheckpointResult {
   266→	result := &branchCheckpointResult{}
   267→	branchWorkCommits := 0 // Regular commits without checkpoints (actual work)
   268→	const maxCommits = 100 // Limit search depth
   269→	totalChecked := 0
   270→
   271→	current := start
   272→	for current != nil && totalChecked < maxCommits {
   273→		// Stop if we've reached the boundary
   274→		if stopAt != nil && current.Hash == *stopAt {
   275→			break
   276→		}
   277→
   278→		// Check for checkpoint trailer
   279→		if cpID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(current.Message); found {
   280→			result.checkpointID = cpID
   281→			result.commitHash = current.Hash.String()
   282→			result.commitMessage = current.Message
   283→			// Only warn about branch work commits, not merge commits
   284→			result.newerCommitsExist = branchWorkCommits > 0
   285→			result.newerCommitCount = branchWorkCommits
   286→			return result
   287→		}
   288→
   289→		// Only count regular commits (not merge commits) as "branch work"
   290→		if current.NumParents() <= 1 {
   291→			branchWorkCommits++
   292→		}
   293→
   294→		totalChecked++
   295→
   296→		// Move to parent (first parent for merge commits - follows the main line)
   297→		if current.NumParents() == 0 {
   298→			break
   299→		}
   300→		parent, err := current.Parent(0)
   301→		if err != nil {
   302→			// Can't get parent, treat as end of history
   303→			break
   304→		}
   305→		current = parent
   306→	}
   307→
   308→	// No checkpoint found
   309→	return result
   310→}

   312→// promptResumeFromOlderCheckpoint asks the user if they want to resume from an older checkpoint.
   313→func promptResumeFromOlderCheckpoint() (bool, error) {
   314→	var confirmed bool
   315→
   316→	form := NewAccessibleForm(
   317→		huh.NewGroup(
   318→			huh.NewConfirm().
   319→				Title("Resume from this older checkpoint?").
   320→				Value(&confirmed),
   321→		),
   322→	)

   324→	if err := form.Run(); err != nil {

   334→// checkRemoteMetadata checks if checkpoint metadata exists on origin/entire/checkpoints/v1
   335→// and automatically fetches it if available.
   336→func checkRemoteMetadata(repo *git.Repository, checkpointID id.CheckpointID) error {
   337→	// Try to get remote metadata branch tree
   338→	remoteTree, err := strategy.GetRemoteMetadataBranchTree(repo)
   339→	if err != nil {
   340→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Checkpoint '%s' found in commit but session metadata not available\n", checkpointID)
   341→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "The entire/checkpoints/v1 branch may not exist locally or on the remote.\n")
   342→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Informational message, not a fatal error
   343→	}
   344→
   345→	// Check if the checkpoint exists on the remote
   346→	metadata, err := strategy.ReadCheckpointMetadata(remoteTree, checkpointID.Path())
   347→	if err != nil {
   348→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Checkpoint '%s' found in commit but session metadata not available\n", checkpointID)
   349→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Informational message, not a fatal error
   350→	}
   351→
   352→	// Metadata exists on remote but not locally - fetch it automatically
   353→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Fetching session metadata from origin...\n")
   354→	if err := FetchMetadataBranch(); err != nil {
   355→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Failed to fetch metadata: %v\n", err)
   356→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "You can try manually: git fetch origin entire/checkpoints/v1:entire/checkpoints/v1\n")
   357→		return NewSilentError(errors.New("failed to fetch metadata"))
   358→	}
   359→
   360→	// Now resume the session with the fetched metadata
   361→	return resumeSession(metadata.SessionID, checkpointID, false, nil)
   362→}
   363→
   364→// findMainSessionIDs finds session IDs from the checkpoint at or before the merge base.
   365→// These sessions exist on the default branch and should be filtered out during resume.
   366→// Returns nil if no merge base or no checkpoint is found (graceful degradation).
   367→func findMainSessionIDs(repo *git.Repository, mergeBaseHash *plumbing.Hash, metadataTree *object.Tree) map[string]bool {
   368→	if mergeBaseHash == nil || metadataTree == nil {
   369→		return nil
   370→	}
   371→
   372→	// Walk from merge base looking for a checkpoint on main
   373→	mergeBaseCommit, err := repo.CommitObject(*mergeBaseHash)
   374→	if err != nil {
   375→		return nil
   376→	}
   377→
   378→	mainResult := findCheckpointInHistory(mergeBaseCommit, nil)
   379→	if mainResult.checkpointID.IsEmpty() {
   380→		return nil
   381→	}
   382→
   383→	// Read checkpoint metadata to get session IDs
   384→	mainMetadata, err := strategy.ReadCheckpointMetadata(metadataTree, mainResult.checkpointID.Path())
   385→	if err != nil {
   386→		return nil
   387→	}
   388→
   389→	sessionIDs := make(map[string]bool, len(mainMetadata.SessionIDs))
   390→	for _, sid := range mainMetadata.SessionIDs {
   391→		sessionIDs[sid] = true
   392→	}
   393→	// Also include the primary session ID (for single-session checkpoints where SessionIDs is empty)
   394→	if mainMetadata.SessionID != "" {
   395→		sessionIDs[mainMetadata.SessionID] = true
   396→	}
   397→	return sessionIDs
   398→}

   400→// resumeSession restores and displays the resume command for a specific session.
   401→// For multi-session checkpoints, restores ALL sessions and shows commands for each.
   402→// If force is false, prompts for confirmation when local logs have newer timestamps.
   403→// mainSessionIDs, when non-nil, filters out sessions that also exist on the default branch.
   404→func resumeSession(sessionID string, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, force bool, mainSessionIDs map[string]bool) error {
   405→	// Read checkpoint metadata first to get agent type (matching rewind pattern)
   406→	repo, err := openRepository()
   407→	if err != nil {
   408→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to open repository: %w", err)
   409→	}

   417→	if err != nil {
   418→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to read checkpoint metadata: %w", err)
   419→	}
   420→
   421→	// Resolve agent from checkpoint metadata (same as rewind)
   422→	ag, err := strategy.ResolveAgentForRewind(metadata.Agent)
   423→	if err != nil {
   424→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to resolve agent: %w", err)
   425→	}
   426→
   427→	// Initialize logging context with agent
   428→	ctx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "resume"), ag.Name())
   429→
   430→	logging.Debug(ctx, "resume session started",
   431→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   432→		slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   433→	)
   434→
   435→	// Get repo root for session directory lookup
   436→	repoRoot, err := paths.RepoRoot()
   437→	if err != nil {
   438→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get repository root: %w", err)
   439→	}
   440→
   441→	sessionDir, err := ag.GetSessionDir(repoRoot)
   442→	if err != nil {
   443→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to determine session directory: %w", err)
   444→	}
   445→
   446→	// Create directory if it doesn't exist
   447→	if err := os.MkdirAll(sessionDir, 0o700); err != nil {
   448→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create session directory: %w", err)
   449→	}
   450→
   451→	// Get strategy and restore sessions using full checkpoint data
   452→	strat := GetStrategy()
   453→
   454→	// Use RestoreLogsOnly via LogsOnlyRestorer interface for multi-session support
   455→	if restorer, ok := strat.(strategy.LogsOnlyRestorer); ok {
   456→		// Create a logs-only rewind point with Agent populated (same as rewind)
   457→		point := strategy.RewindPoint{
   458→			IsLogsOnly:   true,
   459→			CheckpointID: checkpointID,
   460→			Agent:        metadata.Agent,
   461→		}
   462→
   463→		sessions, restoreErr := restorer.RestoreLogsOnly(point, force)
   464→		if restoreErr != nil || len(sessions) == 0 {
   465→			// Fall back to single-session restore (e.g., old checkpoints without agent metadata)
   466→			return resumeSingleSession(ctx, ag, sessionID, checkpointID, repoRoot, force)
   467→		}
   468→
   469→		// Filter out sessions that also exist on the default branch.
   470→		// These were condensed into the branch checkpoint alongside branch-specific
   471→		// sessions but are not unique to this branch.
   472→		if len(mainSessionIDs) > 0 {
   473→			filtered := sessions[:0]
   474→			for _, sess := range sessions {
   475→				if !mainSessionIDs[sess.SessionID] {
   476→					filtered = append(filtered, sess)
   477→				}
   478→			}
   479→			sessions = filtered
   480→			if len(sessions) == 0 {
   481→				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "No branch-specific sessions found in checkpoint '%s'\n", checkpointID)
   482→				return nil
   483→			}
   484→		}
   485→
   486→		// Sort sessions by CreatedAt so the most recent is last (for display).
   487→		// This fixes ordering when subdirectory index doesn't reflect activity order.
   488→		sort.Slice(sessions, func(i, j int) bool {
   489→			return sessions[i].CreatedAt.Before(sessions[j].CreatedAt)
   490→		})
   491→
   492→		logging.Debug(ctx, "resume session completed",
   493→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   494→			slog.Int("session_count", len(sessions)),
   495→		)
   496→
   497→		// Print per-session resume commands using returned sessions
   498→		if len(sessions) > 1 {
   499→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "\nRestored %d sessions. To continue, run:\n", len(sessions))
   500→		} else if len(sessions) == 1 {
   501→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Session: %s\n", sessions[0].SessionID)
   502→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "\nTo continue this session, run:\n")
   503→		}
   504→		for i, sess := range sessions {
   505→			sessionAgent, err := strategy.ResolveAgentForRewind(sess.Agent)
   506→			if err != nil {
   507→				return fmt.Errorf("failed to resolve agent for session %s: %w", sess.SessionID, err)
   508→			}
   509→			cmd := sessionAgent.FormatResumeCommand(sess.SessionID)
   510→
   511→			if len(sessions) > 1 {
   512→				if i == len(sessions)-1 {
   513→					if sess.Prompt != "" {
   514→						fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  %s  # %s (most recent)\n", cmd, sess.Prompt)
   515→					} else {
   516→						fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  %s  # (most recent)\n", cmd)
   517→					}
   518→				} else {
   519→					if sess.Prompt != "" {
   520→						fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  %s  # %s\n", cmd, sess.Prompt)
   521→					} else {
   522→						fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  %s\n", cmd)
   523→					}
   524→				}
   525→			} else {
   526→				if sess.Prompt != "" {
   527→					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  %s  # %s\n", cmd, sess.Prompt)
   528→				} else {
   529→					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  %s\n", cmd)
   530→				}
   531→			}
   532→		}
   533→
   534→		return nil
   535→	}
   536→
   537→	// Strategy doesn't support LogsOnlyRestorer, fall back to single session
   538→	return resumeSingleSession(ctx, ag, sessionID, checkpointID, repoRoot, force)
   539→}
   540→
   541→// resumeSingleSession restores a single session (fallback when multi-session restore fails).
   542→// Always overwrites existing session logs to ensure consistency with checkpoint state.
   543→// If force is false, prompts for confirmation when local log has newer timestamps.
   544→func resumeSingleSession(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, sessionID string, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, repoRoot string, force bool) error {
   545→	sessionLogPath, err := resolveTranscriptPath(sessionID, ag)
   546→	if err != nil {
   547→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to resolve transcript path: %w", err)
   548→	}
   549→
   550→	if checkpointID.IsEmpty() {
   551→		logging.Debug(ctx, "resume session: empty checkpoint ID",
   552→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   553→		)
   554→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Session '%s' found in commit trailer but session log not available\n", sessionID)
   555→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "\nTo continue this session, run:\n")
   556→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  %s\n", ag.FormatResumeCommand(sessionID))
   557→		return nil
   558→	}
   559→
   560→	logContent, _, err := checkpoint.LookupSessionLog(checkpointID)
   561→	if err != nil {
   562→		if errors.Is(err, checkpoint.ErrCheckpointNotFound) || errors.Is(err, checkpoint.ErrNoTranscript) {
   563→			logging.Debug(ctx, "resume session completed (no metadata)",
   564→				slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   565→				slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   566→			)
   567→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Session '%s' found in commit trailer but session log not available\n", sessionID)
   568→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "\nTo continue this session, run:\n")
   569→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  %s\n", ag.FormatResumeCommand(sessionID))
   570→			return nil
   571→		}
   572→		logging.Error(ctx, "resume session failed",
   573→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   574→			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   575→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   576→		)
   577→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get session log: %w", err)
   578→	}
   579→
   580→	// Check if local file has newer timestamps than checkpoint
   581→	if !force {
   582→		localTime := paths.GetLastTimestampFromFile(sessionLogPath)
   583→		checkpointTime := paths.GetLastTimestampFromBytes(logContent)
   584→		status := strategy.ClassifyTimestamps(localTime, checkpointTime)
   585→
   586→		if status == strategy.StatusLocalNewer {
   587→			sessions := []strategy.SessionRestoreInfo{{
   588→				SessionID:      sessionID,
   589→				Status:         status,
   590→				LocalTime:      localTime,
   591→				CheckpointTime: checkpointTime,
   592→			}}
   593→			shouldOverwrite, promptErr := strategy.PromptOverwriteNewerLogs(sessions)
   594→			if promptErr != nil {
   595→				return fmt.Errorf("failed to get confirmation: %w", promptErr)
   596→			}
   597→			if !shouldOverwrite {
   598→				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Resume cancelled. Local session log preserved.\n")
   599→				return nil
   600→			}
   601→		}
   602→	}
   603→
   604→	// Ensure parent directory exists
   605→	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(sessionLogPath), 0o750); err != nil {
   606→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create session directory: %w", err)
   607→	}
   608→
   609→	// Create an AgentSession with the native data.
   610→	// The transcript IS the export data — for agents that need import (OpenCode),
   611→	// WriteSession uses ExportData; for others (Claude, Gemini), it's ignored.
   612→	agentSession := &agent.AgentSession{
   613→		SessionID:  sessionID,
   614→		AgentName:  ag.Name(),
   615→		RepoPath:   repoRoot,
   616→		SessionRef: sessionLogPath,
   617→		NativeData: logContent,
   618→		ExportData: logContent,
   619→	}
   620→
   621→	// Write the session using the agent's WriteSession method
   622→	if err := ag.WriteSession(agentSession); err != nil {
   623→		logging.Error(ctx, "resume session failed during write",
   624→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   625→			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   626→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   627→		)
   628→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write session: %w", err)
   629→	}
   630→
   631→	logging.Debug(ctx, "resume session completed",
   632→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   633→		slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   634→	)
   635→
   636→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Session restored to: %s\n", sessionLogPath)
   637→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Session: %s\n", sessionID)
   638→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "\nTo continue this session, run:\n")
   639→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  %s\n", ag.FormatResumeCommand(sessionID))
   640→
   641→	return nil
   642→}

   644→func promptFetchFromRemote(branchName string) (bool, error) {
   645→	var confirmed bool
   646→
   647→	form := NewAccessibleForm(
   648→		huh.NewGroup(
   649→			huh.NewConfirm().
   650→				Title(fmt.Sprintf("Branch '%s' not found locally. Fetch from origin?", branchName)).
   651→				Value(&confirmed),
   652→		),
   653→	)
   654→
   655→	if err := form.Run(); err != nil {
   656→		if errors.Is(err, huh.ErrUserAborted) {
   657→			return false, nil
   658→		}
   659→		return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to get confirmation: %w", err)
   660→	}
   661→
   662→	return confirmed, nil
   663→}
   664→
   665→// firstLine returns the first line of a string
   666→func firstLine(s string) string {
   667→	for i, c := range s {
   668→		if c == '\n' {
   669→			return s[:i]
   670→		}
   671→	}
   672→	return s
   673→}

    13→// CheckpointID is a 12-character hex identifier for checkpoints.
    14→// It's used to link code commits to metadata on the entire/checkpoints/v1 branch.
    15→//
    16→//nolint:recvcheck // UnmarshalJSON requires pointer receiver, others use value receiver - standard pattern
    17→type CheckpointID string
    18→
    19→// EmptyCheckpointID represents an unset or invalid checkpoint ID.
    20→const EmptyCheckpointID CheckpointID = ""
    21→
    22→// Pattern is the regex pattern for a valid checkpoint ID: exactly 12 lowercase hex characters.
    23→// Exported for use in other packages (e.g., trailers) to avoid pattern duplication.
    24→const Pattern = `[0-9a-f]{12}`
    25→
    26→// ShortIDLength is the standard length for truncating IDs for display purposes.
    27→// Used for tool use IDs, session IDs, and commit hashes in logs and messages.
    28→const ShortIDLength = 12
    29→
    30→// checkpointIDRegex validates the format: exactly 12 lowercase hex characters.

**5 regression tests added** to `resume_test.go`:

1. **`TestFindBranchCheckpoint_MergeBaseAlwaysSet`** — Verifies the HEAD fast-path bug fix: `mergeBaseHash` is populated even when HEAD itself has the checkpoint trailer.

2. **`TestFindMainSessionIDs_ReturnsSessionsFromMain`** — Verifies that when main has a multi-session checkpoint, `findMainSessionIDs` returns those session IDs.

3. **`TestFindMainSessionIDs_NilWhenNoMergeBase`** — Graceful degradation when no merge base is available.

4. **`TestFindMainSessionIDs_NilWhenNoCheckpointOnMain`** — Graceful degradation when main has no checkpoint.

5. **`TestFindBranchCheckpoint_FullFilteringScenario`** — End-to-end scenario: main has sessions A+B, branch adds session C. Verifies `findMainSessionIDs` returns A+B and NOT C.

All tests pass and lint is clean. To debug the filtering issue in your test repo, run `entire resume soph/test-branch` and then check `.entire/logs/` for the `findMainSessionIDs` debug lines — they'll show exactly where the filtering breaks down.

**Main checkpoint** (at merge base `422835c`): 1 session → `ses_384554d4bffehz0CDsk4fLKBTK`

**Branch checkpoint** (at `aeab554`): 3 sessions → `ses_3841bcb74ffe...`, `ses_384367e33ffe...`, `ses_3845405bbffe...`

**None of the session IDs match.** The 3 branch sessions are genuinely different sessions — they were started on the branch AFTER the merge base commit and never condensed into any main checkpoint. The current filtering code correctly finds no overlap.

All sessions came from the same shadow branch (`entire/422835c-e3b0c4`). The condensation already filtered out the old main session (`ses_384554d4bffe...`). The 3 remaining sessions are new to the branch.

Yes, that's essentially what the current code does. Let me trace through your test case:

**Branch**: `...422835c → aeab554` (HEAD)
**Main**: `...422835c → b051970`
**Merge base**: `422835c`

`findBranchCheckpoint` does:
1. Check if HEAD (`aeab554`) has a checkpoint → YES → returns it (fast-path)
2. If HEAD didn't have one, it would walk from HEAD to merge base, skipping merge commits, looking for the first checkpoint on a branch-only commit

So the commit selection is correct — `aeab554` is the only branch-unique commit and it's what gets picked.

The problem is that `aeab554`'s checkpoint (`2d67e52918ce`) contains **3 sessions** because the condensation bundled all shadow branch sessions together when that commit was made. The checkpoint itself has all 3 sessions baked in — there's no way to filter at resume time since all 3 genuinely belong to that one commit.

The fix needs to be in **condensation**: when the user commits on the branch, the condensation should only include sessions that are NEW since the last condensed checkpoint, not carry forward old sessions that were already condensed at earlier commits (like `422835c`). That way `aeab554`'s checkpoint would only have the 1 new session.

   272→
   273→func calculateSessionAttributions(repo *git.Repository, shadowRef *plumbing.Reference, sessionData *ExtractedSessionData, state *SessionState) *cpkg.InitialAttribution {
   274→	// Calculate initial attribution using accumulated prompt attribution data.
   275→	// This uses user edits captured at each prompt start (before agent works),
   276→	// plus any user edits after the final checkpoint (shadow → head).
   277→	//
   278→	// When shadowRef is nil (agent committed mid-turn before SaveStep),
   279→	// HEAD is used as the shadow tree. This is correct because the agent's
   280→	// commit IS HEAD — there are no user edits between agent work and commit.
   281→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "attribution")
   282→
   283→	headRef, headErr := repo.Head()
   284→	if headErr != nil {
   285→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get HEAD",
   286→			slog.String("error", headErr.Error()))
   287→		return nil
   288→	}
   289→
   290→	headCommit, commitErr := repo.CommitObject(headRef.Hash())
   291→	if commitErr != nil {
   292→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get HEAD commit",
   293→			slog.String("error", commitErr.Error()))
   294→		return nil
   295→	}
   296→
   297→	headTree, treeErr := headCommit.Tree()
   298→	if treeErr != nil {
   299→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get HEAD tree",
   300→			slog.String("error", treeErr.Error()))
   301→		return nil
   302→	}
   303→
   304→	// Get shadow tree: from shadow branch if available, otherwise HEAD (agent committed directly).
   305→	var shadowTree *object.Tree
   306→	if shadowRef != nil {
   307→		shadowCommit, shadowErr := repo.CommitObject(shadowRef.Hash())
   308→		if shadowErr != nil {
   309→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get shadow commit",
   310→				slog.String("error", shadowErr.Error()),
   311→				slog.String("shadow_ref", shadowRef.Hash().String()))
   312→			return nil
   313→		}
   314→		var shadowTreeErr error
   315→		shadowTree, shadowTreeErr = shadowCommit.Tree()
   316→		if shadowTreeErr != nil {
   317→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get shadow tree",
   318→				slog.String("error", shadowTreeErr.Error()))
   319→			return nil
   320→		}
   321→	} else {
   322→		// No shadow branch: agent committed mid-turn. Use HEAD as shadow
   323→		// because the agent's work is the commit itself.
   324→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution: using HEAD as shadow (no shadow branch)")
   325→		shadowTree = headTree
   326→	}
   327→
   328→	// Get base tree (state before session started)
   329→	var baseTree *object.Tree
   330→	attrBase := state.AttributionBaseCommit
   331→	if attrBase == "" {
   332→		attrBase = state.BaseCommit // backward compat
   333→	}
   334→	if baseCommit, baseErr := repo.CommitObject(plumbing.NewHash(attrBase)); baseErr == nil {
   335→		if tree, baseTErr := baseCommit.Tree(); baseTErr == nil {
   336→			baseTree = tree
   337→		} else {
   338→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution: base tree unavailable",
   339→				slog.String("error", baseTErr.Error()))
   340→		}
   341→	} else {
   342→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution: base commit unavailable",
   343→			slog.String("error", baseErr.Error()),
   344→			slog.String("attribution_base", attrBase))
   345→	}
   346→
   347→	// Log accumulated prompt attributions for debugging
   348→	var totalUserAdded, totalUserRemoved int
   349→	for i, pa := range state.PromptAttributions {
   350→		totalUserAdded += pa.UserLinesAdded
   351→		totalUserRemoved += pa.UserLinesRemoved
   352→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prompt attribution data",
   353→			slog.Int("checkpoint", pa.CheckpointNumber),
   354→			slog.Int("user_added", pa.UserLinesAdded),
   355→			slog.Int("user_removed", pa.UserLinesRemoved),
   356→			slog.Int("agent_added", pa.AgentLinesAdded),
   357→			slog.Int("agent_removed", pa.AgentLinesRemoved),
   358→			slog.Int("index", i))
   359→	}
   360→
   361→	attribution := CalculateAttributionWithAccumulated(
   362→		baseTree,
   363→		shadowTree,
   364→		headTree,
   365→		sessionData.FilesTouched,
   366→		state.PromptAttributions,
   367→	)
   368→
   369→	if attribution != nil {
   370→		logging.Info(logCtx, "attribution calculated",
   371→			slog.Int("agent_lines", attribution.AgentLines),
   372→			slog.Int("human_added", attribution.HumanAdded),
   373→			slog.Int("human_modified", attribution.HumanModified),
   374→			slog.Int("human_removed", attribution.HumanRemoved),
   375→			slog.Int("total_committed", attribution.TotalCommitted),
   376→			slog.Float64("agent_percentage", attribution.AgentPercentage),
   377→			slog.Int("accumulated_user_added", totalUserAdded),
   378→			slog.Int("accumulated_user_removed", totalUserRemoved),
   379→			slog.Int("files_touched", len(sessionData.FilesTouched)))
   380→	}
   381→
   382→	return attribution
   383→}
   384→
   385→// extractSessionData extracts session data from the shadow branch.
   386→// filesTouched is the list of files tracked during the session (from SessionState.FilesTouched).
   387→// agentType identifies the agent (e.g., "Gemini CLI", "Claude Code") to determine transcript format.
   388→// liveTranscriptPath, when non-empty and readable, is preferred over the shadow branch copy.
   389→// This handles the case where SaveStep was skipped (no code changes) but the transcript
   390→// continued growing — the shadow branch copy would be stale.
   391→// checkpointTranscriptStart is the line offset (Claude) or message index (Gemini) where the current checkpoint began.
   392→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) extractSessionData(repo *git.Repository, shadowRef plumbing.Hash, sessionID string, filesTouched []string, agentType agent.AgentType, liveTranscriptPath string, checkpointTranscriptStart int) (*ExtractedSessionData, error) {
   393→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(shadowRef)
   394→	if err != nil {
   395→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit object: %w", err)
   396→	}
   397→
   398→	tree, err := commit.Tree()
   399→	if err != nil {
   400→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit tree: %w", err)
   401→	}
   402→
   403→	data := &ExtractedSessionData{}
   404→	// sessionID is already an "entire session ID" (with date prefix)
   405→	metadataDir := paths.SessionMetadataDirFromSessionID(sessionID)
   406→
   407→	// Extract transcript — prefer the live file when available, fall back to shadow branch.
   408→	// The shadow branch copy may be stale if the last turn ended without code changes
   409→	// (SaveStep is only called when there are file modifications).
   410→	var fullTranscript string
   411→	if liveTranscriptPath != "" {
   412→		if liveData, readErr := os.ReadFile(liveTranscriptPath); readErr == nil && len(liveData) > 0 { //nolint:gosec // path from session state
   413→			fullTranscript = string(liveData)
   414→		}
   415→	}
   416→	if fullTranscript == "" {
   417→		// Fall back to shadow branch copy
   418→		if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileName); fileErr == nil {
   419→			if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   420→				fullTranscript = content
   421→			}
   422→		} else if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy); fileErr == nil {
   423→			if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   424→				fullTranscript = content
   425→			}
   426→		}
   427→	}
   428→
   429→	// Process transcript based on agent type
   430→	if fullTranscript != "" {
   431→		data.Transcript = []byte(fullTranscript)
   432→		data.FullTranscriptLines = countTranscriptItems(agentType, fullTranscript)
   433→		data.Prompts = extractUserPrompts(agentType, fullTranscript)
   434→		data.Context = generateContextFromPrompts(data.Prompts)
   435→	}
   436→
   437→	// Use tracked files from session state (not all files in tree)
   438→	data.FilesTouched = filesTouched
   439→
   440→	// Calculate token usage from the extracted transcript portion
   441→	if len(data.Transcript) > 0 {
   442→		data.TokenUsage = calculateTokenUsage(agentType, data.Transcript, checkpointTranscriptStart)
   443→	}
   444→
   445→	return data, nil
   446→}
   447→
   448→// extractSessionDataFromLiveTranscript extracts session data directly from the live transcript file.
   449→// This is used for mid-session commits where no shadow branch exists yet.
   450→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) extractSessionDataFromLiveTranscript(state *SessionState) (*ExtractedSessionData, error) {
   451→	data := &ExtractedSessionData{}
   452→
   453→	// Read the live transcript
   454→	if state.TranscriptPath == "" {
   455→		return nil, errors.New("no transcript path in session state")
   456→	}
   457→
   458→	liveData, err := os.ReadFile(state.TranscriptPath)
   459→	if err != nil {
   460→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read live transcript: %w", err)
   461→	}
   462→
   463→	if len(liveData) == 0 {
   464→		return nil, errors.New("live transcript is empty")
   465→	}
   466→
   467→	fullTranscript := string(liveData)
   468→	data.Transcript = liveData
   469→	data.FullTranscriptLines = countTranscriptItems(state.AgentType, fullTranscript)
   470→	data.Prompts = extractUserPrompts(state.AgentType, fullTranscript)
   471→	data.Context = generateContextFromPrompts(data.Prompts)
   472→
   473→	// Extract files from transcript since state.FilesTouched may be empty for mid-session commits
   474→	// (no SaveStep/Stop has been called yet to populate it)
   475→	if len(state.FilesTouched) > 0 {
   476→		data.FilesTouched = state.FilesTouched
   477→	} else {
   478→		// Use the shared helper which includes subagent transcripts
   479→		data.FilesTouched = s.extractModifiedFilesFromLiveTranscript(state, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   480→	}
   481→
   482→	// Calculate token usage from the extracted transcript portion
   483→	if len(data.Transcript) > 0 {
   484→		data.TokenUsage = calculateTokenUsage(state.AgentType, data.Transcript, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   485→	}
   486→
   487→	return data, nil
   488→}
   489→
   490→// countTranscriptItems counts lines (JSONL) or messages (JSON) in a transcript.
   491→// For Claude Code and JSONL-based agents, this counts lines.
   492→// For Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and JSON-based agents, this counts messages.
   493→// Returns 0 if the content is empty or malformed.
   494→func countTranscriptItems(agentType agent.AgentType, content string) int {
   495→	if content == "" {
   496→		return 0
   497→	}
   498→
   499→	// OpenCode uses export JSON format with {"info": {...}, "messages": [...]}
   500→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeOpenCode {
   501→		session, err := opencode.ParseExportSession([]byte(content))
   502→		if err == nil && session != nil {
   503→			return len(session.Messages)
   504→		}
   505→		return 0
   506→	}
   507→
   508→	// Try Gemini format first if agentType is Gemini, or as fallback if Unknown
   509→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini || agentType == agent.AgentTypeUnknown {
   510→		transcript, err := geminicli.ParseTranscript([]byte(content))
   511→		if err == nil && transcript != nil && len(transcript.Messages) > 0 {
   512→			return len(transcript.Messages)
   513→		}
   514→		// If agentType is explicitly Gemini but parsing failed, return 0
   515→		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini {
   516→			return 0
   517→		}
   518→		// Otherwise fall through to JSONL parsing for Unknown type
   519→	}
   520→
   521→	// Claude Code and other JSONL-based agents
   522→	allLines := strings.Split(content, "\n")
   523→	// Trim trailing empty lines (from final \n in JSONL)
   524→	for len(allLines) > 0 && strings.TrimSpace(allLines[len(allLines)-1]) == "" {
   525→		allLines = allLines[:len(allLines)-1]
   526→	}
   527→	return len(allLines)
   528→}
   529→
   530→// extractUserPrompts extracts all user prompts from transcript content.
   531→// Returns prompts with IDE context tags stripped (e.g., <ide_opened_file>).
   532→func extractUserPrompts(agentType agent.AgentType, content string) []string {
   533→	if content == "" {
   534→		return nil
   535→	}
   536→
   537→	// OpenCode uses JSONL with a different per-line schema than Claude Code
   538→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeOpenCode {
   539→		prompts, err := opencode.ExtractAllUserPrompts([]byte(content))
   540→		if err == nil && len(prompts) > 0 {
   541→			cleaned := make([]string, 0, len(prompts))
   542→			for _, prompt := range prompts {
   543→				if stripped := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(prompt); stripped != "" {
   544→					cleaned = append(cleaned, stripped)
   545→				}
   546→			}
   547→			return cleaned
   548→		}
   549→		return nil
   550→	}
   551→
   552→	// Try Gemini format first if agentType is Gemini, or as fallback if Unknown
   553→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini || agentType == agent.AgentTypeUnknown {
   554→		prompts, err := geminicli.ExtractAllUserPrompts([]byte(content))
   555→		if err == nil && len(prompts) > 0 {
   556→			// Strip IDE context tags for consistency with Claude Code handling
   557→			cleaned := make([]string, 0, len(prompts))
   558→			for _, prompt := range prompts {
   559→				if stripped := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(prompt); stripped != "" {
   560→					cleaned = append(cleaned, stripped)
   561→				}
   562→			}
   563→			return cleaned
   564→		}
   565→		// If agentType is explicitly Gemini but parsing failed, return nil
   566→		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini {
   567→			return nil
   568→		}
   569→		// Otherwise fall through to JSONL parsing for Unknown type
   570→	}
   571→
   572→	// Claude Code and other JSONL-based agents
   573→	return extractUserPromptsFromLines(strings.Split(content, "\n"))
   574→}
   575→
   576→// calculateTokenUsage calculates token usage from raw transcript data.
   577→// startOffset is the line number (Claude Code) or message index (Gemini CLI)
   578→// where the current checkpoint began, allowing calculation for only the portion
   579→// of the transcript since the last checkpoint.
   580→func calculateTokenUsage(agentType agent.AgentType, data []byte, startOffset int) *agent.TokenUsage {
   581→	if len(data) == 0 {
   582→		return &agent.TokenUsage{}
   583→	}
   584→
   585→	// OpenCode uses JSONL with token info on assistant messages (different schema from Claude Code)
   586→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeOpenCode {
   587→		return opencode.CalculateTokenUsageFromBytes(data, startOffset)
   588→	}
   589→
   590→	// Try Gemini format first if agentType is Gemini, or as fallback if Unknown
   591→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini || agentType == agent.AgentTypeUnknown {
   592→		// Attempt to parse as Gemini JSON
   593→		transcript, err := geminicli.ParseTranscript(data)
   594→		if err == nil && transcript != nil && len(transcript.Messages) > 0 {
   595→			return geminicli.CalculateTokenUsage(data, startOffset)
   596→		}
   597→		// If agentType is explicitly Gemini but parsing failed, return empty usage
   598→		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini {
   599→			return &agent.TokenUsage{}
   600→		}
   601→		// Otherwise fall through to JSONL parsing for Unknown type
   602→	}
   603→
   604→	// Claude Code and other JSONL-based agents
   605→	lines, err := transcript.ParseFromBytes(data)
   606→	if err != nil || len(lines) == 0 {
   607→		return &agent.TokenUsage{}
   608→	}
   609→	// Slice transcript lines to only include checkpoint portion
   610→	if startOffset > 0 && startOffset < len(lines) {
   611→		lines = lines[startOffset:]
   612→	}
   613→	return claudecode.CalculateTokenUsage(lines)
   614→}
   615→
   616→// extractUserPromptsFromLines extracts user prompts from JSONL transcript lines.
   617→// IDE-injected context tags (like <ide_opened_file>) are stripped from the results.
   618→func extractUserPromptsFromLines(lines []string) []string {
   619→	var prompts []string
   620→	for _, line := range lines {
   621→		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
   622→		if line == "" {
   623→			continue
   624→		}
   625→
   626→		var entry map[string]interface{}
   627→		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &entry); err != nil {
   628→			continue
   629→		}
   630→
   631→		// Check for user message (supports both "human" and "user" types)
   632→		msgType, ok := entry["type"].(string)
   633→		if !ok || (msgType != "human" && msgType != "user") {
   634→			continue
   635→		}
   636→
   637→		// Extract message content
   638→		message, ok := entry["message"].(map[string]interface{})
   639→		if !ok {
   640→			continue
   641→		}
   642→
   643→		// Handle string content
   644→		if content, ok := message["content"].(string); ok && content != "" {
   645→			cleaned := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(content)
   646→			if cleaned != "" {
   647→				prompts = append(prompts, cleaned)
   648→			}
   649→			continue
   650→		}
   651→
   652→		// Handle array content (e.g., multiple text blocks from VSCode)
   653→		if arr, ok := message["content"].([]interface{}); ok {
   654→			var texts []string
   655→			for _, item := range arr {
   656→				if m, ok := item.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
   657→					if m["type"] == "text" {
   658→						if text, ok := m["text"].(string); ok {
   659→							texts = append(texts, text)
   660→						}
   661→					}
   662→				}
   663→			}
   664→			if len(texts) > 0 {
   665→				cleaned := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(strings.Join(texts, "\n\n"))
   666→				if cleaned != "" {
   667→					prompts = append(prompts, cleaned)
   668→				}
   669→			}
   670→		}
   671→	}
   672→	return prompts
   673→}
   674→
   675→// generateContextFromPrompts generates context.md content from a list of prompts.
   676→func generateContextFromPrompts(prompts []string) []byte {
   677→	if len(prompts) == 0 {
   678→		return nil
   679→	}
   680→
   681→	var buf strings.Builder
   682→	buf.WriteString("# Session Context\n\n")
   683→	buf.WriteString("## User Prompts\n\n")
   684→
   685→	for i, prompt := range prompts {
   686→		// Truncate very long prompts for readability
   687→		displayPrompt := prompt
   688→		if len(displayPrompt) > 500 {
   689→			displayPrompt = displayPrompt[:500] + "..."
   690→		}
   691→		buf.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("### Prompt %d\n\n", i+1))
   692→		buf.WriteString(displayPrompt)
   693→		buf.WriteString("\n\n")
   694→	}
   695→
   696→	return []byte(buf.String())
   697→}

   699→// CondenseSessionByID force-condenses a session by its ID and cleans up.
   700→// This is used by "entire doctor" to salvage stuck sessions.
   701→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CondenseSessionByID(sessionID string) error {
   702→	ctx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "condense-by-id")
   703→
   704→	// Load session state
   705→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   706→	if err != nil {
   707→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load session state: %w", err)
   708→	}
   709→	if state == nil {
   710→		return fmt.Errorf("session not found: %s", sessionID)
   711→	}
   712→
   713→	// Open repository
   714→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
   715→	if err != nil {
   716→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to open repository: %w", err)
   717→	}
   718→
   719→	// Generate a checkpoint ID
   720→	checkpointID, err := id.Generate()
   721→	if err != nil {
   722→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to generate checkpoint ID: %w", err)
   723→	}
   724→
   725→	// Check if shadow branch exists (required for condensation)
   726→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   727→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   728→	_, refErr := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   729→	hasShadowBranch := refErr == nil
   730→
   731→	if !hasShadowBranch {
   732→		// No shadow branch means no checkpoint data to condense.
   733→		// Just clean up the state file.
   734→		logging.Info(ctx, "no shadow branch for session, clearing state only",
   735→			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   736→			slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   737→		)
   738→		if err := s.clearSessionState(sessionID); err != nil {
   739→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to clear session state: %w", err)
   740→		}
   741→		return nil
   742→	}
   743→
   744→	// Condense the session
   745→	result, err := s.CondenseSession(repo, checkpointID, state, nil)
   746→	if err != nil {
   747→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to condense session: %w", err)
   748→	}
   749→
   750→	logging.Info(ctx, "session condensed by ID",
   751→		slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   752→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", result.CheckpointID.String()),
   753→		slog.Int("checkpoints_condensed", result.CheckpointsCount),
   754→	)
   755→
   756→	// Update session state: reset step count and transition to idle
   757→	state.StepCount = 0
   758→	state.CheckpointTranscriptStart = result.TotalTranscriptLines
   759→	state.Phase = session.PhaseIdle
   760→	state.LastCheckpointID = checkpointID
   761→	state.AttributionBaseCommit = state.BaseCommit
   762→	state.PromptAttributions = nil
   763→	state.PendingPromptAttribution = nil
   764→
   765→	if err := s.saveSessionState(state); err != nil {
   766→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save session state: %w", err)
   767→	}
   768→
   769→	// Clean up shadow branch if no other sessions need it
   770→	if err := s.cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused(repo, shadowBranchName, sessionID); err != nil {
   771→		logging.Warn(ctx, "failed to clean up shadow branch",
   772→			slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   773→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   774→		)
   775→		// Non-fatal: condensation succeeded, shadow branch cleanup is best-effort
   776→	}
   777→
   778→	return nil
   779→}
   780→
   781→// cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused deletes a shadow branch if no other active sessions reference it.
   782→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused(_ *git.Repository, shadowBranchName, excludeSessionID string) error {
   783→	// List all session states to check if any other session uses this shadow branch
   784→	allStates, err := s.listAllSessionStates()
   785→	if err != nil {
   786→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to list session states: %w", err)
   787→	}
   788→
   789→	for _, state := range allStates {
   790→		if state.SessionID == excludeSessionID {
   791→			continue
   792→		}
   793→		otherShadow := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   794→		if otherShadow == shadowBranchName && state.StepCount > 0 {
   795→			// Another session still needs this shadow branch
   796→			return nil
   797→		}
   798→	}
   799→
   800→	// No other sessions need it, delete the shadow branch via CLI
   801→	// (go-git v5's RemoveReference doesn't persist with packed refs/worktrees)
   802→	if err := DeleteBranchCLI(shadowBranchName); err != nil {
   803→		// Branch already gone is not an error
   804→		if errors.Is(err, ErrBranchNotFound) {
   805→			return nil
   806→		}
   807→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to remove shadow branch: %w", err)
   808→	}
   809→	return nil
   810→}

   767→		}

   776→	// Clean up shadow branches — only delete when ALL sessions on the branch are non-active

   778→	for shadowBranchName := range shadowBranchesToDelete {

   782→			)

   785→		if err := deleteShadowBranch(repo, shadowBranchName); err != nil {

   787→		} else {

   790→				slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   791→				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   792→			)
   793→		}
   794→	}

   796→	return nil
   797→}

The sessions are stored in numbered subdirectories (0, 1, 2) where the highest number is the most recently added. So the last one in `RestoreLogsOnly`'s result is the most recent.

    29→func PhaseFromString(s string) Phase {
